skills.name: "Brace Yourself!"
skills.description: For 5...15 seconds, the next time target other ally would be knocked down, all nearby foes take 15...75 damage instead.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.) Prevents the next knock-down and deals 15...75 damage to all foes near target ally. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: "By Ural's Hammer!"
skills.description: For 30 seconds, all dead party members in earshot are resurrected with full Health and Energy. Resurrected party members deal 25...33% more damage. When this effect ends, affected party members die. This skill does not incur a death penalty.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Resurrect all dead party members in earshot with full Health and Energy. Affected party members deal 25...33% more damage. Affected party members die when it ends, but do not receive a death penalty.

skills.name: "Can't Touch This!"
skills.description: For 20 seconds, the next 1...5 touch skill[s] used against allies <sic/> within earshot fail[s].
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) The next 1...5 touch-range skill[s] used against allies <sic/> within earshot fail[s].

skills.name: "Charge!"
skills.description: Allies in earshot lose the Crippled condition. For 5...13 seconds, these allies move 33% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...13 seconds.) Allies in earshot move 33% faster. Initial effect: these allies lose the Crippled condition.

skills.name: "Coward!"
skills.description: If target foe is moving, that foe is knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Causes knock-down if target foe is moving.

skills.name: "Dodge This!"
skills.description: For 16...20 seconds, your next attack cannot be blocked and does +14...20 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (16...20 seconds.) Your next attack is unblockable and deals +14...20 damage.

skills.name: "Don't Trip!"
skills.description: For 3...5 seconds, party members within earshot cannot be knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...5 seconds.) Prevents knock-down; affects party members within earshot.

skills.name: "Fall Back!"
skills.description: For 4...10 seconds, all allies within earshot gain 5...15 Health per second while moving and move 33% faster. "Fall Back!" ends on an ally affected by this shout when that ally successfully hits with an attack.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...10 seconds.) Allies in earshot gain 5...15 Health per second while moving and move 33% faster. <gray>Ends for an ally if that ally hits with an attack.</gray>

skills.name: "Fear Me!"
skills.description: All nearby foes lose 2...6 Energy. For 1...15 second[s], your melee attacks gain +5...30% chance of a critical hit against stationary foes.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...15 second[s].) You have +5...30% chance of a critical hit with melee attacks against stationary foes. Initial effect: nearby foes lose 2...6 Energy.

skills.name: "Find Their Weakness!"
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, the next time target ally attacks, that ally deals +5...50 damage and inflicts a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Target ally deals +5...50 damage and inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds) with the next attack.

skills.name: "Finish Him!"
skills.description: If target foe has less than 50% Health, that foe takes 44...80 damage and suffers from Cracked Armor and a Deep Wound for 12...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 44...80 damage and inflicts Cracked Armor and Deep Wound conditions (12...20 seconds). <gray>No effect unless target foe has less than 50% Health.</gray>

skills.name: "For Great Justice!"
skills.description: For 20 seconds, whenever you gain adrenaline, you gain 100% more.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) You gain 100% more adrenaline.

skills.name: "Go for the Eyes!"
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot makes an attack, that attack has an additional 30...100% chance to critical.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot have +30...100% to land a critical hit with their next attack.

skills.name: "Help!"
skills.description: Target non-spirit ally gains 15...90 Health. For 1...10 seconds, other allies' spells targeting that ally cast 50% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...10 seconds.) Target non-spirit ally gains 15...90 health, allied spells targeting them cast 50% faster.

skills.name: "I Am the Strongest!"
skills.description: Your next 5...8 attacks do an additional +14...20 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Your next 5...8 attacks deal +14...20 damage.

skills.name: "I Am Unstoppable!"
skills.description: For 16...20 seconds, you have +24 armor and cannot be knocked down or Crippled.
skills.conciseDescription: (16...20 seconds.) You have +24 armor and cannot be knocked-down or Crippled.

skills.name: "I Meant to Do That!"
skills.description: If you are knocked down, you gain 1...6 strikes of adrenaline.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 1...6 strikes of adrenaline if you are knocked-down.

skills.name: "I Will Avenge You!"
skills.description: For each dead ally, you gain 10 seconds of +3...7 Health regeneration and your attack speed increases by 25%.
skills.conciseDescription: You have +3...7 Health regeneration and attack 25% faster (10 seconds for each dead ally).

skills.name: "I Will Survive!"
skills.description: You gain +3 Health regeneration for each condition you are suffering. This regeneration expires after 5...11 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) You have +3 Health regeneration for each condition on you.

skills.name: "Incoming!"
skills.description: For 4...10 seconds, all allies within earshot move 33% faster, and gain 5...15 Health while moving.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...10 seconds) Allies in earshot move 33% faster and gain 5...15 Health while moving.

skills.name: "It's Just a Flesh Wound."
skills.description: Target other ally loses all conditions. If a condition was removed in this way, that ally moves 25% faster for 1...10 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Remove all conditions from target ally. That ally moves 25% faster (1...10 second[s]) if a condition was removed. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: "Lead the Way!"
skills.description: Target ally moves 25% faster for 1...5 seconds for each ally within earshot (maximum of 30 seconds).
skills.conciseDescription: Target ally moves 25% faster for 1...5 seconds (maximum of 30 seconds) for each ally in earshot.

skills.name: "Make Haste!"
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, target other ally moves 33% faster. This skill ends if that ally successfully hits with an attack.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Target ally moves 33% faster. <gray>Ends if target ally hits with an attack. Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: "Make Your Time!"
skills.description: You gain 2 strikes of adrenaline for each party member within earshot (maximum 1...8 adrenaline).
skills.conciseDescription: You gain two adrenaline (maximum 1...8) for each party member in earshot.

skills.name: "Never Give Up!"
skills.description: All allies within earshot and below 75% Health gain 1...10 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Allies in earshot gain 1...10 Energy. <gray>Only affects allies below 75% Health.</gray>

skills.name: "Never Surrender!"
skills.description: For 15 seconds, all party members within earshot and below 75% Health gain +1...5 Health regeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain +1...5 Health regeneration. <gray>Only affects party members below 75% Health.</gray>

skills.name: "None Shall Pass!"
skills.description: All nearby foes that are moving are knocked down. This skill recharges 1...8 second[s] faster for each foe knocked down (maximum 25 seconds).
skills.conciseDescription: Knocks down all nearby moving foes. Recharges 1...8 second[s] faster for each affected foe (maximum 25 seconds).

skills.name: "On Your Knees!"
skills.description: Lose all adrenaline. If any adjacent foes are knocked down, all of your stances are recharged.
skills.conciseDescription: Recharges all your stances if you are adjacent to a knocked-down foe. <gray>You lose all adrenaline.</gray>

skills.name: "Retreat!"
skills.description: If there are any dead allies within earshot, your party moves 33% faster for 5...11 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) Party members in earshot move 33% faster. <gray>No effect unless there are dead allies within earshot.</gray>

skills.name: "Save Yourselves!" (Kurzick)
skills.description: For 4...6 seconds, all other party members gain +100 armor.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...6 seconds.) All other party members gain +100 armor.

skills.name: "Save Yourselves!" (Luxon)
skills.description: For 4...6 seconds, all other party members gain +100 armor.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...6 seconds.) All other party members gain +100 armor.

skills.name: "Shields Up!"
skills.description: For 5...11 seconds, you and all party members within earshot gain +60 armor against incoming projectile attacks.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) Party members in earshot have +60 armor against projectile attacks.

skills.name: "Stand Your Ground!"
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, all party members within earshot receive +24 armor when not moving.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain +24 armor when not moving.

skills.name: "The Power Is Yours!"
skills.description: For 2...4 seconds, all allies within earshot gain 1...2 Energy regeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (2...4 seconds.) Allies within earshot gain 1...2 Energy regeneration.

skills.name: "There's Nothing to Fear!"
skills.description: For 4 seconds and 1 second for every 2 ranks in Leadership, all party members within earshot take 20...35% less damage. Affected party members are healed for 35...60 Health when this shout ends.
skills.conciseDescription: (4 seconds plus 1 second for every 2 ranks in Leadership.) Reduces damage by 20...35% for party members in earshot. End effect: heals for 35...60 Health.

skills.name: "They're on Fire!"
skills.description: For 10 seconds, party members within earshot take 5...35% less damage from foes suffering from Burning.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot take 5...35% less damage from Burning foes.

skills.name: "To the Limit!"
skills.description: For each foe within earshot (maximum 1...6), you gain one strike of adrenaline. For 10...20 seconds, your maximum Health is increased by 10...60.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...20 seconds.) You have +10...60 maximum Health. Initial effect: you gain one strike of adrenaline for each foe within earshot (maximum 1...6).

skills.name: "Together as One!"
skills.description: For 3...15 seconds, all party members near you or near your pet deal +5...15 additional damage with attacks and gain +1...7 Health regeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...15 seconds.) All party members near you or your pet deal +5...15 damage <sic/> and gain +1...7 Health regeneration.

skills.name: "Victory Is Mine!"
skills.description: You gain 10...68 Health and 3...7 Energy for each condition suffered by target foe.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 10...68 Health and 3...7 Energy for each condition on target foe.

skills.name: "Watch Yourself!"
skills.description: Party members within earshot gain +5...25 armor for 10 seconds. This shout ends after 10 incoming attacks.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot have +5...25 armor. <gray>Ends after 10 incoming attacks.</gray>

skills.name: "We Shall Return!"
skills.description: All party members in earshot are resurrected with 25...50% Health and 5...20% Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: All party members in earshot are resurrected (25...50% Health and 5...20% Energy).

skills.name: "You Are All Weaklings!"
skills.description: Target foe and foes adjacent to target are Weakened for 8...12 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Weakness condition (8...12 seconds). Also affects adjacent foes.

skills.name: "You Move Like a Dwarf!"
skills.description: Target foe is knocked down and takes 44...80 damage. That foe is also Crippled for 8...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 44...80 damage, causes knock-down, and inflicts Crippled condition (8...15 seconds).

skills.name: "You Will Die!"
skills.description: If target foe is below 90% Health, you gain 1...3 strike[s] of adrenaline.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 1...3 strike[s] of adrenaline. <gray>No effect unless target foe is under 90% Health.</gray>

skills.name: "You're All Alone!"
skills.description: If target foe isn't near an ally, that foe suffers from Cripple and Weakness for 8 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Cripple and Weakness conditions (8 seconds). <gray>No effect if target foe is near one of its allies.</gray>

skills.name: A Touch of Guile
skills.description: Target touched foe takes 44...80 damage. If target foe was knocked down, that foe cannot attack for 5...8 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Hex Spell. Deals 44...80 damage. Target foe cannot attack (5...8 seconds) if it was knocked-down.

skills.name: Accumulated Pain
skills.description: Target foe takes 15...75 damage. If target foe is suffering from 2 or more hexes, that foe suffers a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 15...75 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds) if target foe has 2 or more hexes.

skills.name: Aegis
skills.description: For 6...15 seconds, all party members within earshot have a 50% chance to block attacks.
skills.conciseDescription: Enchants all party members within earshot (6...15 seconds). 50% chance to block.

skills.name: Aftershock
skills.description: Nearby foes are struck for 15...85 earth damage. Knocked down foes are struck for 15...85 additional earth damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 15...85 earth damage to nearby foes. Deals 15...85 more earth damage to knocked down foes.

skills.name: Aggressive Refrain
skills.description: For 5...25 seconds, you attack 25% faster but have -20 armor. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on you.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...25 seconds.) You attack 25% faster. Renewal: whenever a chant or shout ends on you. <gray>You have -20 armor.</gray>

skills.name: Agonizing Chop
skills.description: When this attack hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If target foe is suffering from a Deep Wound, you interrupt that foe's action.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Interrupts an action if target foe has a Deep Wound.

skills.name: Agony
skills.description: Create a level 1...12 spirit. This spirit causes 3...10 Health loss each second to foes within earshot. This spirit loses 3...10 Health for each foe hurt in this way. This spirit dies after 30...90 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...12 spirit (30...90 second lifespan). Causes 3...10 Health loss each second to foes in earshot. <gray>This spirit loses 3...10 Health for each foe that loses Health.</gray>

skills.name: Air Attunement
skills.description: For 36...60 seconds, you are attuned to Air. You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the base Energy cost of the skill whenever you use Air Magic.
skills.conciseDescription: (36...60 seconds.) You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the Energy cost whenever you use an Air Magic skill.

skills.name: Air of Disenchantment
skills.description: Remove one enchantment from target foe and all nearby foes. For 5...20 seconds, enchantments expire 150...300% faster on those foes.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes near your target (5...20 seconds). Remove one enchantment from target and nearby foes. Enchantments expire 150...300% faster on those foes.

skills.name: Air of Enchantment
skills.description: For 4...10 seconds, enchantments cast on target other ally cost 10 less Energy (minimum 1 Energy).
skills.conciseDescription: (4...10 seconds.) Enchantments cast on target ally cost 10 less Energy (minimum 1 Energy). <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Air of Superiority
skills.description: For 20...30 seconds you gain a random Asura benefit every time you earn experience from killing an enemy.
skills.conciseDescription: (20...30 seconds). Gain a random Asura benefit every time you earn experience from killing an enemy.

skills.name: Alkar's Alchemical Acid
skills.description: Throw Alkar's Alchemical Acid at target foe. Target and adjacent foes are struck for 40...50 damage. Destroyers take an additional 45...70 damage and they have Cracked Armor for 14...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Projectile: deals 40...50 damage to target and adjacent foes. Deals 45...70 more damage and inflicts Cracked Armor condition (14...20 seconds) to Destroyers.

skills.name: Amity
skills.description: For 4...12 seconds, adjacent foes cannot attack. For each foe, Amity ends if that foe takes damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...12 seconds.) Foes adjacent to you cannot attack. <gray>Ends on any foes that take damage.</gray>

skills.name: Ancestor's Visage
skills.description: For 4...10 seconds, whenever target ally is hit by a melee attack, all adjacent foes lose all adrenaline and 3 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...10 seconds.) All adjacent foes lose all adrenaline and 3 Energy whenever a melee attack hits target ally.

skills.name: Ancestors' Rage
skills.description: For 1 second, nothing happens. When this skill ends, all foes adjacent to target ally are struck for 5...110 lightning damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (1 second.) End Effect: deals 5...110 lightning damage to foes adjacent to target ally.

skills.name: Aneurysm
skills.description: Target foe regains all Energy. For each point of Energy gained in this way, that foe takes 1...3 damage and all adjacent foes lose 1 Energy. (Maximum 1...30).
skills.conciseDescription: Target foe regains all Energy. For each point of Energy gained, target takes 1...3 damage and all adjacent foes lose 1 Energy (maximum 1...30).

skills.name: Angelic Bond
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next time an ally within earshot would take fatal damage, that damage is negated and that ally is healed for 20...200 Health. Angelic Bond ends on all other allies.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) The next time an ally within earshot would take fatal damage, that damage is negated and that ally is healed for 20...200. <gray>Ends on other allies.</gray>

skills.name: Angelic Protection
skills.description: For 10 seconds, any time target other ally takes more than 250...80 damage per second, that ally is healed for any damage over that amount.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Each second that target ally takes damage over 250...80, that ally is healed for any damage over that amount. <gray>Cannot self target.</gray>

skills.name: Angorodon's Gaze
skills.description: Steal 10...50 Health from target foe. If you are suffering from a condition, you gain 3...12 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Steals 10...50 Health. You gain 3...12 Energy if you have a condition.

skills.name: Anguish
skills.description: Create a level 1...11 spirit. This spirit's attacks deal 5...20 damage and deal double damage to hexed foes. This spirit dies after 15...45 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...11 spirit (15...45 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5...20 damage. Double damage to hexed foes.

skills.name: Anguished Was Lingwah
skills.description: Hold Lingwah's ashes for up to 10...60 seconds. While you hold her ashes, your Ritualist hexes cost 1...5 less energy and last 50% longer. When you drop her ashes all your Ritualist hexes are recharged.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...60 seconds.) Your Ritualist hexes cost 1...5 less energy and last 50% longer. Drop effect: all your Ritualist hexes are recharged.

skills.name: Animate Bone Fiend
skills.description: Exploit nearest corpse to animate a level 1...17 bone fiend. Bone fiends can attack at range.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...17 bone fiend that can attack at range. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse.</gray>

skills.name: Animate Bone Horror
skills.description: Exploit nearest corpse to animate a level 1...17 bone horror.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...17 bone horror. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse.</gray>

skills.name: Animate Bone Minions
skills.description: Exploit nearest corpse to animate two level 0...12 bone minions.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates two level 0...12 bone minions. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse.</gray>

skills.name: Animate Flesh Golem
skills.description: Exploit nearest corpse to animate a level 3...25 Flesh Golem. The Flesh Golem leaves 1...4 exploitable corpse[s]. You can have only one Flesh Golem at a time.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 3...25 flesh golem which leaves 1...4 fresh corpse[s] when it dies. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse. You can have only one flesh golem at a time.</gray>

skills.name: Animate Shambling Horror
skills.description: Exploit nearest corpse to create a level 1...17 shambling horror. When the shambling horror dies, it is replaced by a level 0...15 jagged horror that causes Bleeding with each of its attacks.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...17 shambling horror. When the shambling horror dies, it is replaced by a level 0...15 jagged horror that causes Bleeding with each of its attacks. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse.</gray>

skills.name: Animate Vampiric Horror
skills.description: Exploit nearest corpse to animate a level 1...17 Vampiric Horror. Whenever a Vampiric Horror you control deals damage, you gain the same amount of Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...17 vampiric horror. You gain Health equal to the damage it deals. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse.</gray>

skills.name: Anthem of Disruption
skills.description: For 1...10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each ally within earshot also interrupts an action.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...10 seconds.) Allies in earshot interrupt an action with their next attack skill.

skills.name: Anthem of Envy
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each ally within earshot deals +10...25 damage against foes with more than 50% Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot do +10...25 damage with their next attack skill. <gray>Damage bonus only applies to foes with more than 50% Health.</gray>

skills.name: Anthem of Flame
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each party member within earshot also causes Burning for 1...5 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot inflict Burning condition (1...5 second[s]) with their next attack skill.

skills.name: Anthem of Fury
skills.description: For 10 seconds, all party members within earshot gain 2...5 strikes of adrenaline the next time they use an attack skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain 2...5 adrenaline with their next attack skill.

skills.name: Anthem of Guidance
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each party member within earshot cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot are unblockable with their next attack skill.

skills.name: Anthem of Weariness
skills.description: For 8 seconds, the next attack skill used by each ally within earshot also causes Weakness for 1...16 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) Allies in earshot inflict Weakness (1...16 second[s]) with their next attack skill.

skills.name: Antidote Signet
skills.description: Cleanse yourself of Poison, Disease, and Blindness, and one additional condition.
skills.conciseDescription: Remove Poison, Disease, and Blindness from yourself, and one additional condition.

skills.name: Apply Poison
skills.description: For 24 seconds, foes struck by your physical attacks become Poisoned for 3...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (24 seconds.) Your physical attacks inflict Poisoned condition (3...15 seconds).

skills.name: Arc Lightning
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 5...40 lightning damage. If you are Overcast, two foes near your target are struck for 15...85 lightning damage. Damage from Arc Lightning has 25% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 5...40 lightning damage. Deals 15...85 lightning damage to two nearby foes if you are Overcast. 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Arcane Conundrum
skills.description: For 5...15 seconds, spells cast by target foe and all adjacent foes take twice as long to cast. When this hex ends, you gain 1...7 energy. <sic/>
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes adjacent to target (5...15 seconds). Doubles spell casting time. End effect: you gain 1...7 energy. <sic/>

skills.name: Arcane Echo
skills.description: If you cast a spell in the next 20 seconds, Arcane Echo is replaced with that spell for 20 seconds. Arcane Echo ends prematurely if you use a non-spell skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) Arcane Echo becomes the next spell you use (20 seconds). <gray>This enchantment ends if you use any skill that is not a spell.</gray>

skills.name: Arcane Languor
skills.description: For 1...10 second[s], all spells cast by the target foe cause 10 Overcast.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...10 second[s].) Target foe's spells cause 10 Overcast.

skills.name: Arcane Larceny
skills.description: For 5...35 seconds, one random spell is disabled for target foe and Arcane Larceny is replaced by that spell.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...35 seconds.) Disables one random spell. This skill becomes that spell.

skills.name: Arcane Mimicry
skills.description: For 20 seconds, Arcane Mimicry becomes the non-form elite skill from target other ally.
skills.conciseDescription: This skill becomes target ally's elite skill (20 seconds). <gray>Cannot self-target. No effect if target's elite skill is a form.</gray>

skills.name: Arcane Thievery
skills.description: For 5...35 seconds, one random spell is disabled for target foe, and Arcane Thievery is replaced by that spell.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...35 seconds.) Disables one random spell. This skill becomes that spell.

skills.name: Arcane Zeal
skills.description: For 10 seconds, whenever you cast a spell, you gain 2 Energy for each enchantment on you (maximum 2...7 Energy).
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) You gain 2 Energy (maximum 2...7) for each enchantment on you whenever you cast a spell.

skills.name: Archer's Signet
skills.description: For 1...24 second[s], conditions you apply while wielding a bow last 150% longer.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...24 second[s].) Conditions you apply while wielding a bow last 150% longer.

skills.name: Arcing Shot
skills.description: If this arrow hits, it strikes for +10...35 damage. This arrow cannot be blocked, but it moves 50% slower.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...35 damage. Unblockable. <gray>This arrow moves 50% slower.</gray>

skills.name: Aria of Restoration
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next time each party member within earshot uses a spell, that party member gains 30...90 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain 30...90 Health with their next spell.

skills.name: Aria of Zeal
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses a Spell, that ally gains 1...6 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot gain 1...6 Energy with their next spell.

skills.name: Armor of Earth
skills.description: For 30 seconds, you gain 24...60 armor, but move 50...14% slower.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) You have +24...60 armor. You move 50...14% slower.

skills.name: Armor of Frost
skills.description: For 10...34 seconds, you gain +40 armor against physical damage and have +1 Water Magic.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...34 seconds.) You have +40 armor against physical damage and have +1 Water Magic.

skills.name: Armor of Mist
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, you gain +10...40 armor and move 33% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) You have +10...40 armor and move 33% faster.

skills.name: Armor of Sanctity
skills.description: All adjacent foes suffer from Weakness for 5...15 seconds. For 15 seconds, you take 5...20 less damage from foes suffering from a condition.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Weakness condition on all adjacent foes (5...15). You take 5...20 less damage from foes with a condition. (15 seconds.)

skills.name: Armor of Unfeeling
skills.description: For 10...35 seconds, your spirits within earshot take 50% less damage and are immune to critical attacks.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) Your spirits within earshot take 50% less damage and are immune to critical attacks.

skills.name: Ash Blast
skills.description: Target and adjacent foes are struck for 35...65 earth damage. Burning foes struck by Ash Blast are hexed for 5 seconds and have a 20...75% chance to miss with attacks.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 35...65 earth damage. Burning foes are hexed for 5 seconds and miss 20...75% of attacks. Also strikes adjacent.

skills.name: Assassin's Promise
skills.description: For 5...15 seconds, if target foe dies, you gain 5...20 Energy and all your skills are recharged.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.) You gain 5...20 Energy and all your skills recharge if target foe dies.

skills.name: Assassin's Remedy
skills.description: For 30 seconds, the next 1...10 attack skills you use remove one condition.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Your next 1...10 attack skills each remove one condition.

skills.name: Assault Enchantments
skills.description: Must follow a dual attack. Target foe loses all enchantments.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes all enchantments. <gray>Must follow a dual attack.</gray>

skills.name: Asuran Scan
skills.description: For 9...12 seconds your attacks cannot miss target foe. Killing a foe hexed with Asuran Scan removes 5% Death Penalty.
skills.conciseDescription: (9...12 seconds.) You cannot miss target foe. If you kill this foe, you lose 5% Death Penalty.

skills.name: Atrophy
skills.description: For 3...7 seconds, target foe's primary attribute is reduced to 0.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...7 seconds.) Reduces this foe's primary attribute to 0.

skills.name: Attacker's Insight
skills.description: For 3...10 seconds you have a 50% chance to block while attacking. When this enchantment ends, you inflict Weakness on all adjacent foes for 3...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...10 seconds.) Gives 50% block chance while attacking. End Effect: Causes Weakness 3...15 seconds to adjacent foes.

skills.name: Attuned Was Songkai
skills.description: Hold Songkai's ashes for up to 45 seconds. While you hold her ashes, your spells and binding rituals cost -5...50% of the base Energy to cast.
skills.conciseDescription: (45 seconds.) Your spells and binding rituals cost -5...50% of the base Energy.

skills.name: Augury of Death
skills.description: For 5...35 seconds, the next time damage would drop target foe's Health below 50%, you inflict a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds and Shadow Step to that foe. This spell has half the normal range.
skills.conciseDescription: Half Range Hex Spell. (5...35 seconds.) Inflict Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds) and Shadow Step to target foe the next time damage would drop this foe's Health below 50%.

skills.name: Aura of Displacement
skills.description: When you cast Aura of Displacement, Shadow Step to target foe. When you stop maintaining Aura of Displacement you return to your original location.
skills.conciseDescription: Shadow Step to target foe. End effect: return to your original location.

skills.name: Aura of Faith
skills.description: For 3 seconds, target ally gains 50...100% more Health when healed and takes 5...50% less damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (3 seconds.) Target ally gains 50...100% more Health when healed and takes 5...50% less damage.

skills.name: Aura of Holy Might (Kurzick)
skills.description: For 45 seconds, you deal 20...25 holy damage to all adjacent foes whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment.
skills.conciseDescription: (45 seconds.) Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, adjacent foes take 20...25 holy damage.

skills.name: Aura of Holy Might (Luxon)
skills.description: For 45 seconds, you deal 20...25 holy damage to all adjacent foes whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment.
skills.conciseDescription: (45 seconds.) Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, adjacent foes take 20...25 holy damage.

skills.name: Aura of Restoration
skills.description: For 60 seconds, you gain 0...1 Energy and are healed for 200...500% of the Energy cost each time you cast a spell.
skills.conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) You gain 0...1 Energy and are healed for 200...500% of the Energy cost each time you cast a spell.

skills.name: Aura of Stability
skills.description: For 3...8 seconds, target other ally cannot be knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...8 seconds.) Target ally cannot be knocked-down. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Aura of the Lich
skills.description: All corpses within earshot are exploited and you animate a level 1...17 bone horror plus one for each corpse exploited in this way. For 5...45 seconds, your Death Magic attribute is increased by +1.
skills.conciseDescription: Exploit all corpses in earshot. Animates a level 1...17 bone horror, plus one for each exploited corpse. You have +1 Death Magic (5...45 seconds).

skills.name: Aura of Thorns
skills.description: All nearby foes begin Bleeding for 5...15 seconds. For 30 seconds, this enchantment does nothing. When this enchantment ends, all nearby foes are Crippled for 3...8 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Initial effect: inflicts Bleeding condition (5...15 seconds) on nearby foes. End effect: inflicts Crippled condition (3...8 seconds) on nearby foes.

skills.name: Aura Slicer
skills.description: If this attack hits, you inflict Bleeding for 5...15 seconds. If you are enchanted, you also inflict Cracked Armor for 1...10 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.)Inflicts <sic/> Bleeding condition. Also inflicts Cracked Armor (1...10 second[s]) if you are enchanted.

skills.name: Auspicious Blow
skills.description: If Auspicious Blow hits, you strike for +5...20 damage and gain 3...8 Energy. If target foe is suffering from Weakness, this attack is unblockable.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage and you gain 3...8 Energy. Unblockable if target foe is Weakened.

skills.name: Auspicious Incantation
skills.description: For 20 seconds, the next spell you cast is disabled for an additional 10...5 seconds, and you gain 110...200% of that spell's Energy cost.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) Your next spell gives you 110...200% of its Energy cost. <gray>That spell takes 10...5 seconds longer to recharge.</gray>

skills.name: Auspicious Parry
skills.description: For 8 seconds, the next attack against you is blocked. You gain 1...4 strike[s] of adrenaline when this stance ends.
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) Blocks one attack. End effect: you gain 1...4 strike[s] of adrenaline.

skills.name: Avatar of Balthazar
skills.description: For 10...90 seconds, you gain +20 armor against physical damage, you gain adrenaline 25% faster, your attacks deal holy damage, and whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, nearby foes are set on fire for 1...3 second[s]. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...90 seconds.) You gain +20 armor against physical damage, you gain adrenaline 25% faster, your attacks deal holy damage, you inflict Burning (1...3 second[s]) on nearby foes whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.

skills.name: Avatar of Dwayna
skills.description: For 10...90 seconds, your attacks deal holy damage. Whenever you use a Dervish attack skill, you lose 1 hex. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, all allies in earshot are healed for 5...50 Health. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...90 seconds.) You deal holy damage. Whenever you use a Dervish attack skill, you lose 1 hex. Heal allies in earshot for 5...50 Health when you lose a Dervish enchantment. <gray>This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.</gray>

skills.name: Avatar of Grenth
skills.description: For 10...90 seconds, your scythe attacks deal dark damage, and steal 0...12 Health. You are immune to Disease, and inflict Disease on all adjacent foes for 3 seconds whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...90 seconds.) Your scythe attacks deal dark damage and steal 0...12 Health. You are immune to Disease. Apply Disease to all adjacent foes (3 seconds) when you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.

skills.name: Avatar of Lyssa
skills.description: For 10...90 seconds, your Dervish enchantments recharge 50% faster and your attacks deal chaos damage. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, steal 1 Energy from all nearby foes. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...90 seconds.) Your Dervish enchantments recharge 50% faster and deal chaos damage with attacks. Steal 1 Energy from nearby foes when you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.

skills.name: Avatar of Melandru
skills.description: For 10...90 seconds, you have +150 Health, +30 elemental armor, and your attacks deal earth damage. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, all party members in earshot lose 1 condition. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...90 seconds.) You have +150 maximum Health, +30 elemental armor, and your attacks deal earth damage. Cure 1 condition from all party members in earshot whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. <gray>This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.</gray>

skills.name: Awaken the Blood
skills.description: For 20...44 seconds, you gain +2 Blood Magic and +2 Curses, but whenever you sacrifice Health, you sacrifice 50% more than the normal amount.
skills.conciseDescription: (20...44 seconds.) You have +2 Blood Magic and Curses. <gray>Sacrifice 50% more Health than normal.</gray>

skills.name: Awe
skills.description: If this skill hits a knocked-down foe, that foe becomes Dazed for 5...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Dazed condition (5...15 seconds). <gray>No effect unless target is knocked-down.</gray>

skills.name: Axe Rake
skills.description: If this attack hits a foe suffering from a Deep Wound, you strike for +4...16 damage, and that foe becomes Crippled for 15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +4...16 damage and inflicts Crippled condition (15 seconds) if target foe has a Deep Wound.

skills.name: Axe Twist
skills.description: If this attack hits a foe suffering from a Deep Wound, you strike for 5...25 more damage and that foe suffers from Weakness for 20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...25 damage and inflicts Weakness condition (20 seconds) if target foe has a Deep Wound.

skills.name: Backbreaker
skills.description: If Backbreaker hits, you strike for +1...20 damage and your target is knocked down. If you have 8 Strength or higher, this knockdown lasts 4 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +1...20 damage. Causes knockdown. <gray>Knockdown lasts 4 seconds with Strength 8 or higher.</gray>

skills.name: Backfire
skills.description: For 10 seconds, whenever target foe casts a spell, that foe takes 35...140 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Target foe takes 35...140 damage whenever it casts a spell.

skills.name: Balanced Stance
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, you cannot be knocked down and you do not suffer extra damage from a critical attack.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) You cannot be knocked-down and do not take extra damage from critical hits.

skills.name: Ballad of Restoration
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next time each party member within earshot takes damage, that party member gains 15...75 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain 15...75 Health the next time they take damage.

skills.name: Balthazar's Aura
skills.description: For 8 seconds, foes adjacent to target ally take 10...30 holy damage each second.
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) Deals 10...30 holy damage each second to foes adjacent to target ally.

skills.name: Balthazar's Pendulum
skills.description: For 5...25 seconds, the next time target ally would be knocked down by a foe, that foe is knocked down instead.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...25 seconds.) Causes knock-down to the next foe attempting to knock-down target ally.

skills.name: Balthazar's Rage
skills.description: All nearby foes are set on fire for 1...3 second[s]. For 20 seconds afterward, this enchantment does nothing. When this enchantment ends, you gain 1...2 strike[s] of adrenaline if any foes are within earshot.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) Initial Effect: Inflicts burning (1...3 second[s]) on nearby foes. End effect: gain 1...2 strike[s] of adrenaline if any foes are within earshot.

skills.name: Balthazar's Spirit
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, target ally gains adrenaline and 1 Energy after taking damage. (The amount of adrenaline gained increases depending on your rank in Smiting Prayers.)
skills.conciseDescription: Target ally gains adrenaline and 1 Energy when taking damage.

skills.name: Bane Signet
skills.description: Target foe takes 30...60 holy damage. If target foe was attacking, that foe is knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 30...60 holy damage. Causes knock-down if target foe is attacking.

skills.name: Banish
skills.description: Target foe takes 20...65 holy damage. This spell does double damage to summoned creatures.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 20...65 holy damage. Deals double damage to summoned creatures.

skills.name: Banishing Strike
skills.description: If it hits, this attack deals 10...60 holy damage. It deals double damage to summoned creatures.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...60 holy damage. Deals double damage to summoned creatures.

skills.name: Barbarous Slice
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +5...30 damage. If you are currently not in a stance, you also inflict Bleeding for 5...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...30 damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition (5...15 seconds) if you are not in a stance.

skills.name: Barbed Arrows
skills.description: For 24 seconds, your arrows cause Bleeding for 3...15 seconds. You have -40 armor while activating this skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (24 seconds.) Your arrows inflict Bleeding condition (3...15 seconds). <gray>You have -40 armor while activating this skill.</gray>

skills.name: Barbed Signet
skills.description: You inflict Bleeding for 3...15 seconds on target foe and all adjacent foes.
skills.conciseDescription: Target and adjacent foes suffer from Bleeding (3...15 seconds).

skills.name: Barbed Spear
skills.description: If this attack hits, your target begins Bleeding for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Bleeding condition (5...20 seconds).

skills.name: Barbed Trap
skills.description: When Barbed Trap is triggered, all nearby foes are struck for 7...23 piercing damage, become Crippled, and begin Bleeding for 3...25 seconds. Barbed Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals 7...23 piercing damage. Inflicts Crippled and Bleeding conditions (3...25 seconds). <gray>Easily interrupted.</gray>

skills.name: Barbs
skills.description: For 30 seconds, target foe takes 4...16 more damage when hit by physical damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Target foe takes 4...16 damage whenever it takes physical damage.

skills.name: Barrage
skills.description: All your preparations are removed. Shoot arrows at target foe and up to 5 foes adjacent to your target. These arrows strike for +5...20 damage if they hit.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Hits 5 foes adjacent to your target. <gray>All your preparations are removed.</gray>

skills.name: Battle Rage
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, you move 33% faster and gain double adrenaline from attacks. Battle Rage ends if you use any non-adrenal skills.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) You move 33% faster and gain double adrenaline from your attacks. <gray>Ends if you use any non-adrenal skills.</gray>

skills.name: Bed of Coals
skills.description: Create a Bed of Coals at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, foes adjacent to target foe are struck for 5...29 fire damage each second. Any foe knocked down on the Bed of Coals is set on fire for 3...7 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 5...29 fire damage each second (5 seconds) to location of target foe. Hits foes adjacent to your target. Inflicts Burning condition (3...7 seconds) on knocked down foes.

skills.name: Beguiling Haze
skills.description: Shadow Step to target foe. That foe becomes Dazed for 3...9 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: You Shadow Step to this foe. Inflicts Dazed condition (3...9 seconds).

skills.name: Belly Smash
skills.description: If this attack strikes a foe who is knocked down, the resulting dust cloud will blind adjacent foes for 3...7 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Blindness condition to adjacent foes (3...7 seconds) if target foe is knocked down.

skills.name: Berserker Stance
skills.description: For 8...14 seconds, you attack 33% faster and gain 100% more adrenaline. Berserker Stance ends if you use a skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...14 seconds.) You attack 33% faster and gain 100% more adrenaline. <gray>Ends if you use a skill.</gray>

skills.name: Bestial Fury
skills.description: All your non-attack skills are disabled for 5 seconds. For 5...11 seconds, you attack 25% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) You attack 25% faster. <gray>Your non-attack skills are disabled (5 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Bestial Mauling
skills.description: Your animal companion attempts a Bestial Mauling that deals +5...20 damage. If the attack strikes a knocked-down foe, that foe is Dazed for 4...10 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Inflicts Dazed condition (4...10 seconds) if target foe is knocked-down.

skills.name: Bestial Pounce
skills.description: Your animal companion attempts a Bestial Pounce that deals +5...20 damage. If the attack strikes a foe who is casting a spell, that foe is knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Causes knock-down if target foe is casting a spell.

skills.name: Binding Chains
skills.description: For 3 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes move 90% slower and take 1...30 damage each second while moving.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes near your target. (3 seconds.) These foes move 90% slower and takes 1...30 damage each second while moving.

skills.name: Bitter Chill
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 15...60 cold damage. If that foe had more Health than you, Bitter Chill recharges instantly.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 15...60 cold damage. Recharges instantly if target foe had more Health than you.

skills.name: Black Lotus Strike
skills.description: If it hits, Black Lotus Strike strikes for +10...31 damage. If target foe is suffering from a Hex, you gain 5...13 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...31 damage. You gain 5...13 Energy if target foe is hexed.

skills.name: Black Mantis Thrust
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +8...20 damage. If target foe is suffering from a Hex, that foe is Crippled for 3...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +8...20 damage. Inflicts Crippled condition (3...15 seconds) if target foe is hexed.

skills.name: Black Powder Mine
skills.description: When Black Powder Mine is triggered, all nearby foes are struck for 20...30 damage, become Blinded, and begin Bleeding for 7...10 seconds. Black Powder Mine ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals 20...30 damage. Inflicts Blindness and Bleeding conditions (7...10 seconds). <gray>Easily interrupted.</gray>

skills.name: Black Spider Strike
skills.description: Must strike a hexed foe. If it hits, this attack strikes for +5...20 damage and target foe is Poisoned for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Inflicts Poisoned condition (5...20 seconds). <gray>Must strike a hexed foe.</gray>

skills.name: Blackout
skills.description: For 2...8 seconds, all of touched target foe's skills are disabled, and all of your skills are disabled for 5 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. (2...8 seconds.) Disables skills. <gray>Your skills are disabled (5 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Blades of Steel
skills.description: Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, this attack strikes for +5...16 damage (maximum bonus 60) for each recharging dagger attack.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...16 damage (maximum 60) for each recharging dagger attack. <gray>Must follow an off-hand attack.</gray>

skills.name: Bladeturn Refrain
skills.description: For 20 seconds, target non-spirit ally has a 5...20% chance to block incoming attacks. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on that ally.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) Target ally has 5...20% chance to block. Renewal: Whenever a chant or shout ends on that ally. <gray>Cannot target spirits.</gray>

skills.name: Blazing Finale
skills.description: For 10...35 seconds, whenever a chant or shout ends on target non-spirit ally, all foes adjacent to that ally are set on Fire for 1...7 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) Inflicts Burning condition (1...7 second[s]) to adjacent foes whenever a chant or shout ends on target ally. <gray>Cannot target spirits.</gray>

skills.name: Blazing Spear
skills.description: If this attack hits, it deals +5...25 damage and sets target foe on Fire <sic/> for 1...3 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...25 damage. Inflicts Burning condition (1...3 second[s]).

skills.name: Blessed Aura
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, Monk enchantments you cast last 10...35% longer.
skills.conciseDescription: Monk enchantments you cast last 10...35% longer.

skills.name: Blessed Light
skills.description: Heal target ally for 10...120 Health and remove one condition and one hex.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 10...120. Removes one condition and one hex.

skills.name: Blessed Signet
skills.description: For each enchantment you are maintaining, you gain 3 Energy. You cannot gain more than 3...24 Energy in this way.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 3 Energy for each enchantment you are maintaining. <gray>You cannot gain more than 3...24 Energy in this way.</gray>

skills.name: Blind Was Mingson
skills.description: Hold Mingson's ashes for up to 15...60 seconds. When you drop his ashes, all nearby foes are Blinded for 3...8 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (15...60 seconds.) Drop effect: inflicts Blindness condition (3...8 seconds) on all nearby foes.

skills.name: Blinding Flash
skills.description: Target foe is Blinded for 3...8 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Blindness condition (3...8 seconds).

skills.name: Blinding Powder
skills.description: Must follow an off-hand attack. Target foe and all adjacent foes become Blinded for 3...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Blindness condition (3...15 seconds) on target and adjacent foes. <gray>Must follow an off-hand attack.</gray>

skills.name: Blinding Surge
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 5...50 lightning damage. That foe and all adjacent foes are Blinded for 3...8 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration. If this spell strikes an attacking foe, all adjacent foes are also struck and this spell deals 50% more damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 5...50 lightning damage. Inflicts Blindness condition (3...8 seconds) on target and adjacent foes. 25% armor penetration. If target was attacking, also hits adjacent foes and deals 50% more damage.

skills.name: Blood Bond
skills.description: For 3...12 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes are hexed with Blood Bond. Whenever an ally hits one of them with an attack, that ally gains 5...20 Health. If one of these foes dies while hexed, all allies adjacent to that foe are healed for 20...100 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes adjacent to your target (3...12 seconds). Allies hitting these foes gain 5...20 health. If any of these foes dies while hexed, adjacent allies are healed for 20...100.

skills.name: Blood Drinker
skills.description: If your Health is above 90%, you begin Bleeding for 6 seconds. Steal up to 20...65 Health from target foe.
skills.conciseDescription: Steals 20...65 Health. <gray>You begin Bleeding (6 seconds) if your Health is above 90%.</gray>

skills.name: Blood is Power
skills.description: For 10 seconds, target other ally gains +3...6 Energy regeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) +3...6 Energy regeneration. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Blood of the Aggressor
skills.description: Steal up to 5...45 Health from target foe. If that foe was attacking, that foe suffers Weakness for 3...12 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Steal 5...45 Health. Inflicts Weakness (3...12 seconds) if target foe was attacking.

skills.name: Blood of the Master
skills.description: All of your undead allies are healed for 30...116 Health. You sacrifice an additional 2% maximum Health per minion healed in this way.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals your undead servants for 30...116. <gray>Healing cost: +2% Health sacrifice per servant healed.</gray>

skills.name: Blood Renewal
skills.description: For 7 seconds, you gain +3...6 Health regeneration. When Blood Renewal ends, you gain 40...190 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (7 seconds.) You have +3...6 Health regeneration. End effect: heals you for 40...190.

skills.name: Blood Ritual
skills.description: For 8...14 seconds, target touched ally gains +3 Energy regeneration. Blood Ritual cannot be used on the caster.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...14 seconds.) +3 Energy regeneration. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Bloodsong
skills.description: Create a level 1...12 spirit who dies after 30...150 seconds. Attacks by that spirit steal up to 5...25 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...12 spirit (30...150 second lifespan). Its attacks steal 5...25 Health.

skills.name: Blurred Vision
skills.description: For 4...10 seconds, target foe and adjacent foes are hexed with Blurred Vision. While hexed, those foes have a 50% chance to miss with attacks.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes adjacent to target (4...10 seconds). They have 50% chance to miss.

skills.name: Body Blow
skills.description: If this attack hits, target foe takes +10...40 damage. If target foe has Cracked Armor, that foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 0...15 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound (0...15 second[s]) if target foe has Cracked Armor.

skills.name: Body Shot
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If it hits a foe with Cracked Armor, you gain 5...10 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. You gain 5...10 Energy if target foe has Cracked Armor.

skills.name: Bonetti's Defense
skills.description: For 5...11 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block melee and projectile attacks. You gain 5 Energy for each successful melee attack blocked. Bonetti's Defense ends if you use a skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block. Gain 5 Energy for each melee attack blocked. <gray>Ends if you use a skill.</gray>

skills.name: Boon of Creation
skills.description: For 15...60 seconds, whenever you create a creature, you gain 5...50 Health and 1...6 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (15...60 seconds.) You gain 5...50 Health and 1...6 Energy whenever you create a creature.

skills.name: Boon Signet
skills.description: Heal target ally for 20...80 Health. Your next Healing or Protection Prayer <sic/> spell that targets an ally heals for an additional 20...100 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 20...80. Your next Healing or Protection Prayer <sic/> spell that targets an ally heals for +20...100 Health.

skills.name: Brambles
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 Spirit. Non-Spirit creatures that are knocked down in its range take 5 damage and begin Bleeding for 5...20 seconds. This Spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). Knocked-down creatures take 5 damage and begin Bleeding (5...20 seconds). Does not affect spirits.

skills.name: Brawling Headbutt
skills.description: You headbutt target touched foe dealing 45...70 damage and knocking down that foe if it hits.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Deals 45...70 damage; causes knock-down.

skills.name: Breath of Fire
skills.description: Create Breath of Fire at target foe's current location. For 5 seconds, foes adjacent to that location are struck for 10...40 fire damage each second.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...40 fire damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target's initial location.

skills.name: Breath of the Great Dwarf
skills.description: All party members are relieved of Burning and are healed for 50...60 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes burning and heals for 50...60 Health. Affects party members.

skills.name: Broad Head Arrow
skills.description: You shoot a broad head arrow that moves slower than normal. If it hits, target foe is Dazed for 5...20 seconds, and if target foe is casting a spell that spell is interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: Slow moving arrow. Interrupts a spell. Inflicts Dazed condition (5...20 seconds).

skills.name: Brutal Strike
skills.description: Your animal companion attempts a Brutal Strike that deals +5...35 damage. If that attack strikes a foe whose Health is below 50%, that foe takes an additional +5...35 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...35 damage. Deals +5...35 more damage if target foe is under 50% health.

skills.name: Brutal Weapon
skills.description: Give target ally a Brutal Weapon for 10...40 seconds. The bearer's weapon strikes for +5...15 damage as long as the bearer is under no enchantments.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...40 seconds.) Attacks deal +5...15 damage. <gray>No effect while target ally is enchanted.</gray>

skills.name: Bull's Charge
skills.description: For 1...7 seconds, you move 50% faster and if you strike a moving foe in melee, that foe is knocked down. Bull's Charge ends if you use a skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...7 seconds.) You move 50% faster. Causes knock-down if you hit a moving foe in melee. <gray>Ends if you use a skill.</gray>

skills.name: Bull's Strike
skills.description: If this attack hits a moving foe, you strike for +5...30 damage, and your target is knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...30 damage and causes knock-down if target foe is moving.

skills.name: Burning Arrow
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +10...30 damage and cause Burning for 2...8 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...30 damage. Inflicts Burning condition (2...8 seconds).

skills.name: Burning Refrain
skills.description: For 20 seconds, if target non-spirit ally hits a foe with more Health than that ally, that foe is set on Fire <sic/> for 1...3 second[s]. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on that ally.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) Inflicts Burning condition (1...3 second[s]) if target ally hits a foe with more Health. Renewal: Whenever a chant or shout ends on that ally. <gray>Cannot target spirits.</gray>

skills.name: Burning Shield
skills.description: For 3...9 seconds, while wielding a shield, the next attack skill used against you is blocked. If it was a melee attack, your attacker is set on fire for 1...6 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...9 seconds.) Blocks the next attack skill against you. Inflicts Burning condition (1...6 second[s]) if it was a melee attack. <gray>No effect unless you are wielding a shield.</gray>

skills.name: Burning Speed
skills.description: For 7 seconds, you are set on fire and move 30...45% faster. When Burning Speed ends, all adjacent foes are set on fire for 3...9 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (7 seconds.) You move 30...45% faster. <gray>You suffer from Burning (7 seconds).</gray> End effect: inflicts Burning condition (3...9 seconds) on adjacent foes.

skills.name: Burst of Aggression
skills.description: For 2...10 seconds, you attack 33% faster. When this stance ends, you lose all adrenaline.
skills.conciseDescription: (2...10 seconds.) You attack 33% faster. <gray>End effect: lose all adrenaline.</gray>

skills.name: Cacophony
skills.description: For 15 seconds, whenever target foe uses a shout or chant, that foe takes 30...105 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) Deals 30...105 damage whenever target foe uses a shout or chant.

skills.name: Calculated Risk
skills.description: For 3...24 seconds, target foe's attacks do +10 damage, but there is a 50% chance that the damage from each attack will be done to that foe instead. (Maximum 15...100 damage.)
skills.conciseDescription: Target foe does +10 damage with attacks (3...24 seconds). There is a 50% chance that the damage from each attack (maximum 15...100) will be done to that foe instead.

skills.name: Call of Haste
skills.description: For 30 seconds, your animal companion has a 33% faster attack speed and moves 33% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Your pet moves and attacks 33% faster.

skills.name: Call of Protection
skills.description: For 120 seconds, your animal companion has a 5...20 base damage reduction.
skills.conciseDescription: (120 seconds.) Your pet has 5...20 damage reduction.

skills.name: Called Shot
skills.description: Shoot an arrow that moves 3 times faster and cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: You shoot an arrow that moves 3 times faster. Unblockable.

skills.name: Caltrops
skills.description: Target foe and all foes adjacent to your target are Crippled and Bleeding for 5...15 seconds. Caltrops has half the normal range.
skills.conciseDescription: Half Range Spell. Inflicts Crippled and Bleeding condition (5...15 seconds) on target and adjacent foes.

skills.name: Caretaker's Charge
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 20...85 lightning damage. If you are holding an item, you gain 7 Energy and 5...50 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 20...85 lightning damage. You gain 7 Energy and 5...50 Health if you are holding an item.

skills.name: Castigation Signet
skills.description: Target foe takes 26...56 holy damage. If that foe was attacking, you gain 4...14 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 26...56 holy damage. You gain 4...14 Energy if target foe is attacking.

skills.name: Cautery Signet
skills.description: All party members lose all conditions. You are set on Fire <sic/> for 1 second for each condition removed in this way.
skills.conciseDescription: All party members lose all conditions. <gray>You begin Burning (one second for each condition removed).</gray>

skills.name: Chain Lightning
skills.description: Target foe and up to two other foes near your target are struck for 10...85 lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...85 lightning damage. Also hits two foes near your target. 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Channeled Strike
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 5...95 lightning damage. That foe is struck for an additional 5...35 lightning damage if you are holding an item.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 5...95 lightning damage. Deals 5...35 additional lightning damage if you are holding an item.

skills.name: Channeling
skills.description: For 8...56 seconds, whenever you cast a spell, you gain 1 Energy for each foe in the area.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...56 seconds.) You gain 1 Energy for each foe in the area whenever you cast a spell.

skills.name: Chaos Storm
skills.description: Create a Chaos Storm at target foe's location that lasts for 10 seconds. Each second, foes adjacent to this location take 5...25 damage and lose 0...2 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 5...25 damage and causes 0...2 Energy loss each second (10 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target's initial location.

skills.name: Charging Strike
skills.description: For 1...10 second[s], you run 33% faster. Your next successful melee hit does +10...90 damage and this stance ends. This stance ends if you use a skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...10 second[s].) You move 33% faster and deal +10...90 damage with your next melee hit. <gray>Ends when you hit or if you use a skill.</gray>

skills.name: Charm Animal
skills.description: Charm target animal. Once charmed, your animal companion will travel with you whenever you have Charm Animal equipped. You cannot charm an animal that is more than 4 levels above you.
skills.conciseDescription: Charm target animal. Once charmed, your animal companion will travel with you whenever you have Charm Animal equipped. <gray>You cannot charm an animal that is more than 4 levels above you.</gray>

skills.name: Chest Thumper
skills.description: If this attack hits a foe with Cracked Armor, that foe suffers a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds) if target foe has Cracked Armor.

skills.name: Chilblains
skills.description: You become Poisoned for 10 seconds. Foes in the area of your target are struck for 10...44 cold damage and lose 1...2 enchantment[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...44 cold damage to foes in the area around your target; removes 1...2 enchantment[s] from these foes. <gray>You are Poisoned (10 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Chilling Victory
skills.description: If it hits, this attack strikes for +3...15 damage. For each foe hit who has less Health than you, that foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 10...30 cold damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +3...15 damage. Deals 10...30 cold damage to each foe hit who has less Health than you and foes adjacent to those targets.

skills.name: Chilling Winds
skills.description: Target foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 30...60 cold damage. For 10 seconds, the next Water Magic hex targeting a hexed foe lasts 25...100% longer.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) The next water hex on target foe lasts 25...100% longer. Initial effect: 30...60 cold damage. Also strikes adjacent.

skills.name: Choking Gas
skills.description: For 1...12 seconds, your arrows deal 1...8 more damage and spread Choking Gas to all adjacent foes on impact. Choking Gas interrupts foes attempting to cast spells.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...12 seconds.) +1...8 damage. Spreads Choking Gas to foes adjacent to target. Choking Gas interrupts spells.

skills.name: Chorus of Restoration
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses a shout or chant, that ally is healed for 30...90 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot are healed for 30...90 with their next shout or chant.

skills.name: Churning Earth
skills.description: Create Churning Earth at target foe's location. For the next 5 seconds, Churning Earth strikes foes near that location for 10...40 earth damage each second. Any foe moving faster than normal when struck by Churning Earth is knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...40 earth damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes near target's initial location. Causes knock-down to foes moving faster than normal.

skills.name: Clamor of Souls
skills.description: Target foe and all nearby foes take 10...65 lightning damage. If you are within earshot of a spirit or holding a bundle item, you gain 10 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...65 lightning damage to target and nearby foes. You gain 10 Energy if you are within earshot of a spirit or holding a bundle item.

skills.name: Cleave
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +10...40 damage and hit 1...2 adjacent foe[s] for 10...40 slashing damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage and hits 1...2 adjacent foe[s] for 10...40 slashing damage.

skills.name: Club of a Thousand Bears
skills.description: If this attack hits, it deals +6...9 damage for each adjacent foe (maximum 60 damage). If target foe is non-human it is knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +6...9 damage for each adjacent foe (maximum 60 damage). Causes knock-down if target foe is non-human.

skills.name: Clumsiness
skills.description: For 4 seconds, target and adjacent foes are hexed with Clumsiness. The next time each foe attacks, the attack is interrupted and that foe suffers 10...80 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (4 seconds.) Also hexes adjacent foes. Interrupts next attack. Interruption effect: deals 10...80 damage.

skills.name: Comfort Animal
skills.description: You heal your animal companion for 40...120 Health. If your companion is dead, it is resurrected with 10...58% Health. If you have Comfort Animal equipped, your animal companion will travel with you.
skills.conciseDescription: Your pet gains 40...120 Health. Resurrects your pet (10...58% Health.) If you have Comfort Animal equipped, your animal companion will travel with you.

skills.name: Companionship
skills.description: If you have less Health than your pet, you are healed for 30...120 Health. If your pet has less Health than you, it is healed for 30...120 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals you for 30...120 if you have less Health than your pet. Heals your pet for 30...120 if it has less Health than you.

skills.name: Complicate
skills.description: If target foe is using a skill, that skill is interrupted and disabled for target foe and all foes in the area for an additional 5...12 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupt a skill. Interruption effect: disables interrupted skill (+5...12 seconds) for target foe and all foes in the area.

skills.name: Concussion Shot
skills.description: If Concussion Shot hits while target foe is casting a spell, the spell is interrupted and your target is Dazed for 5...20 seconds. This attack deals only 1...16 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts a spell. Interruption effect: inflicts Dazed condition (5...20 seconds). <gray>Hits for only 1...16 damage.</gray>

skills.name: Conflagration
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, all arrows that hit strike for fire damage. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). All arrows deal fire damage for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.

skills.name: Confusing Images
skills.description: For 2...10 seconds, target foe takes twice as long to activate non-attack skills.
skills.conciseDescription: (2...10 seconds). Target foe takes twice as long to activate non-attack skills.

skills.name: Conjure Flame
skills.description: For 60 seconds, if you're wielding a fire weapon, your attacks strike for an additional 5...20 fire damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) Your attacks hit for +5...20 fire damage. <gray>No effect unless your weapon deals fire damage.</gray>

skills.name: Conjure Frost
skills.description: For 60 seconds, if you're wielding a cold weapon, your attacks strike for an additional 5...20 cold damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) Your attacks hit for +5...20 cold damage. <gray>No effect unless your weapon deals cold damage.</gray>

skills.name: Conjure Lightning
skills.description: For 60 seconds, if you're wielding a lightning weapon, your attacks strike for an additional 5...20 lightning damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) Your attacks hit for +5...20 lightning damage. <gray>No effect unless your weapon deals lightning damage.</gray>

skills.name: Conjure Nightmare
skills.description: For 2...16 seconds, target foe suffers -8 Health degeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (2...16 seconds.) Causes -8 Health degeneration.

skills.name: Conjure Phantasm
skills.description: For 4...18 seconds, target foe experiences -5 Health degeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...18 seconds.) Causes -5 Health degeneration.

skills.name: Consume Corpse
skills.description: Exploit a random corpse. You teleport to that corpse's location and gain 25...100 Health and 5...20 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Teleport to a corpse's location. You gain 25...100 Health and 5...20 Energy. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse.</gray>

skills.name: Consume Soul
skills.description: You steal 5...70 Health from target foe. All hostile summoned creatures in earshot of that foe take 25...125 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Steals 5...70 Health. Deal 25...125 damage to hostile summoned creatures within earshot of target foe.

skills.name: Contagion
skills.description: For 60 seconds, whenever you suffer from a new condition, all foes in the area suffer from that same condition and you sacrifice 10...5% maximum Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) Whenever you gain a condition, all foes in the area gain that same condition. <gray>You sacrifice 10...5% maximum Health each time this happens.</gray>

skills.name: Contemplation of Purity
skills.description: Lose all enchantments. For each one lost, you gain 0...80 Health, lose one hex, and lose one condition (maximum 1...8 hexes and conditions).
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 0...80 Health and lose one hex and one condition for each enchantment on you (maximum 1...8 hexes and conditions). <gray>You lose all enchantments.</gray>

skills.name: Convert Hexes
skills.description: Remove all hexes from target other ally. For 8...20 seconds, that ally gains +10 armor for each Necromancer hex that was removed.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes all hexes; +10 armor for each Necromancer hex removed (8...20 seconds). <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Conviction
skills.description: For 10 seconds, you gain +10 armor if you have a condition and gain 1...3 Health regen <sic/> for each condition you are suffering from. When this enchantment ends, you are cured of 1...2 condition[s].
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Gain +10 armor while conditioned. Gain 1...3 Health regeneration for each condition you have. End Effect: Remove 1...2 condition[s].

skills.name: Corrupt Enchantment
skills.description: Remove one enchantment from target foe. If an enchantment is removed in this way, that foe suffers from -1...8 Health degeneration for 10 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes one enchantment from target foe. Removal effect: -1...8 Health degeneration (10 seconds).

skills.name: Counter Blow
skills.description: If this attack hits an attacking foe, that foe is knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Causes knock-down if target foe is attacking.

skills.name: Counterattack
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +5...35 damage. If you hit an attacking foe, you gain 2...6 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...35 damage. You gain 2...6 Energy if target foe is attacking.

skills.name: Crippling Anguish
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, target moves and attacks 50% slower and suffers -1...8 Health degeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Target foe moves and attacks 50% slower and has -1...8 Health degeneration.

skills.name: Crippling Anthem
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each ally within earshot causes Crippling for 5...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot inflict Crippled condition (5...15 seconds) with their next attack skill.

skills.name: Crippling Dagger
skills.description: Send out a Crippling Dagger at target foe. Crippling Dagger strikes for 15...60 earth damage if it hits, and Cripples moving foes for 3...15 seconds. This spell has half the normal range.
skills.conciseDescription: Half Range Spell. Projectile: deals 15...60 earth damage. Inflicts Crippled condition (3...15 seconds) if target foe is moving.

skills.name: Crippling Shot
skills.description: If Crippling Shot hits, your target becomes Crippled for 4...14 second[s]. This attack cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: Unblockable. Inflicts Crippled condition (4...14 second[s]).

skills.name: Crippling Slash
skills.description: If this attack hits, target foe is Crippled for 5...15 seconds and begins Bleeding for 10...25 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Crippled condition (5...15 seconds) and Bleeding condition (10...25 seconds).

skills.name: Crippling Sweep
skills.description: If this attack hits a foe, that foe is Crippled for 3...12 seconds. This skill deals +3...15 extra damage if that foe is moving.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...12 seconds.) Inflicts Cripple <sic/> condition. Deals +3...15 damage to moving foes.

skills.name: Crippling Victory
skills.description: If this attack hits a foe, that foe is Crippled for 3...8 seconds. If you have more Health than target foe, all adjacent foes take 10...30 earth damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...8 seconds) Cripples target foe. If your health is greater than target foe's, all adjacent foes take 10...30 earth damage.

skills.name: Critical Agility
skills.description: For 4 seconds and 1 second for each rank of Critical Strikes, you attack 33% faster and gain +15...25 armor. This skill reapplies itself every time you land a critical hit.
skills.conciseDescription: (4 seconds plus 1 second for each rank of Critical Strikes.) You attack 33% faster and gain +15...25 armor. Renewal: every time you land a critical hit.

skills.name: Critical Chop
skills.description: If this attack hits, you inflict +5...20 damage. If this attack results in a critical hit, target foe is interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Interrupts an action if you land a critical hit.

skills.name: Critical Defenses
skills.description: For 4...10 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block. Critical Defenses refreshes every time you land a critical hit.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...10 seconds.) You have a 75% chance to block. Renewal: every time you land a critical hit.

skills.name: Critical Eye
skills.description: For 10...35 seconds, you have an additional 3...15% chance to land a critical hit when attacking. You gain 1 Energy whenever you score a critical hit.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) You have +3...15% chance to land a critical hit. You gain 1 Energy whenever you land a critical hit.

skills.name: Critical Strike
skills.description: Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, this attack strikes for +10...30 damage, results in a critical hit, and you gain 1...3 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...30 damage. Automatic critical hit. You gain 1...3 Energy. <gray>Must follow an off-hand attack.</gray>

skills.name: Crossfire
skills.description: If this attack hits target foe, it deals +5...20 damage. If that foe is near any of your allies, this attack cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Unblockable if target foe is near any of your allies.
