skills.name: Crude Swing
skills.description: Attack all adjacent foes. Each foe you hit is struck for +1...20 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Attack all adjacent foes for +1...20 damage.

skills.name: Cruel Spear
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +10...50 damage. If it hits a non-moving target, you inflict a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...50 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds) if target is not moving.

skills.name: Cruel Was Daoshen
skills.description: Hold Daoshen's ashes for up to 15...60 seconds. While you hold his ashes, all Ritualist skills have 10% armor penetration. When you drop his ashes, all nearby foes are struck for 15...85 lightning damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (15...60 seconds.) Your Ritualist skills have 10% armor penetration. Drop effect: deals 15...85 lightning damage to all nearby foes.

skills.name: Crushing Blow
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +1...20 damage. If you hit a knocked-down foe you inflict a Deep Wound, lowering your target's maximum Health by 20% for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +1...20 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition if target foe is knocked-down (5...20 seconds).

skills.name: Cry of Frustration
skills.description: If target foe is using a skill, that foe and all foes in the area are interrupted and suffer 15...75 damage and foes in the area take 75% of that damage.
skills.conciseDescription: If target foe is using a skill, that foe and all foes in the area are interrupted. Foe suffers 15...75 damage and foes in the area take 75% of that damage.

skills.name: Cry of Pain
skills.description: Interrupt target foe's skill. If that foe was suffering from a Mesmer hex, that foe and all foes in the area take 25...50 damage and have 3...5 Health degeneration for 10 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts a skill. If target foe had a Mesmer hex, deals 25...50 damage to target and foes in the area and causes 3...5 Health degeneration (10 seconds).

skills.name: Crystal Wave
skills.description: Foes adjacent to you are struck for 10...70 damage but are cured of any negative conditions. Each condition removed deals 5...15 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...70 damage to all foes adjacent to you. Those foes lose all conditions and take 5...15 damage for each condition removed.

skills.name: Cultist's Fervor
skills.description: For 5 seconds and 3 seconds longer for every rank of Soul Reaping, your Necromancer spells cost -1...6 Energy to cast but you suffer from Bleeding for 10 seconds each time you cast a Necromancer spell.
skills.conciseDescription: (5 seconds plus 3 seconds more for every rank of Soul Reaping.) Your Necromancer spells cost 1...6 less Energy. <gray>You suffer from Bleeding (10 seconds) each time you cast a Necromancer spell.</gray>

skills.name: Cure Hex
skills.description: Remove one Hex from target ally. If a Hex was removed, that ally is healed for 30...100 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes a Hex. Removal effect: Heals for 30...100.

skills.name: Cyclone Axe
skills.description: Perform a spinning axe attack striking for +4...12 damage to all adjacent opponents.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +4...12 damage to all foes adjacent to you.

skills.name: Dancing Daggers
skills.description: Send out three Dancing Daggers at target foe, each striking for 5...35 earth damage if they hit. Dancing Daggers has half the normal range. This skill counts as a lead attack.
skills.conciseDescription: Half Range Spell. Three projectiles: each deals 5...35 earth damage. Counts as a lead attack.

skills.name: Dark Apostasy
skills.description: For 3...17 seconds, every time you successfully land a critical hit, you remove one enchantment from your target. If you remove an enchantment in this way, you lose 10...3 Energy or Dark Apostasy ends.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...17 seconds.) Your critical hits remove an enchantment. <gray>Removal cost: lose 10...3 Energy or Dark Apostasy ends.</gray>

skills.name: Dark Aura
skills.description: For 30 seconds, whenever target ally sacrifices Health, Dark Aura deals 5...50 shadow damage to adjacent foes, and you lose 5...20 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds). Deals 5...50 damage to adjacent foes whenever target ally sacrifices Health. <gray>Damage cost: you lose 5...20 Health.</gray>

skills.name: Dark Bond
skills.description: For the next 30...60 seconds, whenever you receive damage, your closest minion suffers 75% of that damage for you.
skills.conciseDescription: (30...60 seconds.) Transfers 75% of incoming damage from you to your nearest servant.

skills.name: Dark Escape
skills.description: For 5...15 seconds, you move 25% faster and take half damage. Dark Escape ends if you successfully hit with an attack.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.) You move 25% faster and take half damage. <gray>Ends if you hit with an attack.</gray>

skills.name: Dark Fury
skills.description: For 5 seconds, whenever any party member hits with an attack, that party member gains one hit of adrenaline. (50% failure chance with Blood Magic of 4 or less.)
skills.conciseDescription: Enchants party members (5 seconds). These party members gain one strike of adrenaline each time they hit with an attack. <gray>50% failure chance unless Blood Magic 5 or more.</gray>

skills.name: Dark Pact
skills.description: Deal 20...60 shadow damage to target foe.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 20...60 damage.

skills.name: Dark Prison
skills.description: Shadow Step to target foe. For 1...6 seconds, that foe moves 33% slower.
skills.conciseDescription: Shadow Step to target foe. This foe moves 33% slower (1...6 seconds).

skills.name: Dash
skills.description: For 3 seconds, you run 50% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (3 seconds.) You move 50% faster.

skills.name: Deadly Haste
skills.description: For 10...35 seconds, half-ranged spells cast 5...50% faster and recharge 5...60% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) Your half-ranged spells cast 5...50% faster and recharge 5...60% faster.

skills.name: Deadly Paradox
skills.description: All of your attack skills are disabled for 10 seconds. For 5...15 seconds, your Assassin skills activate and recharge 33% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.) Your Assassin skills activate and recharge 33% faster. <gray>Disables your attack skills (10 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Deadly Riposte
skills.description: For 8 seconds, while you have a sword equipped, you block the next melee attack against you, and your attacker is struck for 15...90 damage and begins Bleeding for 3...25 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds). You block the next melee attack and your attacker takes 15...90 damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition. (3...25 seconds). <gray>No effect unless you have a sword equipped.</gray>

skills.name: Death Blossom
skills.description: Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, Death Blossom strikes target foe for +20...45 damage and all adjacent foes take 20...45 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +20...45 damage. Also affects foes adjacent to target foe. <gray>Must follow an off-hand attack.</gray>

skills.name: Death Nova
skills.description: For 30 seconds, if target ally dies, all adjacent foes take 26...100 damage and are Poisoned for 15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Deals 26...100 damage and inflicts Poisoned condition (15 seconds) on adjacent foes if target ally dies.

skills.name: Death Pact Signet
skills.description: Resurrect target party member with your current Health and 15...100% Energy. The next time that ally dies within 120 seconds, so do you.
skills.conciseDescription: Resurrects target party member with your current Health and 15...100% maximum Energy. <gray>For 120 seconds, you die the next time this party member dies.</gray>

skills.name: Death's Charge
skills.description: Shadow Step to target foe. If that foe has more Health than you, you are healed for 65...200.
skills.conciseDescription: You Shadow Step to target foe. You are healed for 65...200 if this foe has more Health than you.

skills.name: Death's Retreat
skills.description: Shadow Step to target ally. If you have less Health than that ally, you gain 40...130 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Gain 40...130 Health if you have less Health than target ally. Initial effect: Shadow Step to this ally. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Deathly Chill
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 5...50 cold damage. If that foe's Health is above 50%, you deal an additional 5...50 shadow damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 5...50 cold damage. Deals 5...50 more damage if target foe was above 50% Health.

skills.name: Deathly Swarm
skills.description: Deathly Swarm flies out slowly and strikes for 30...90 cold damage on up to three targets in the area.
skills.conciseDescription: Deathly Swarm flies out slowly and deals 30...90 cold damage. Hits two additional foes in the area.

skills.name: Debilitating Shot
skills.description: If Debilitating Shot hits, your target loses 1...10 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Causes 1...10 Energy loss.

skills.name: Decapitate
skills.description: You lose all adrenaline and all Energy. This attack is unblockable, you deal +5...80 damage and cause a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds. This attack is always critical and if foe is killed, nearby foes are Weakened for 8 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...80 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds). Automatic critical hit. If foe is killed, nearby foes are Weakened (8 seconds). <gray>You lose all adrenaline and Energy.</gray>

skills.name: Deep Freeze
skills.description: You cause a Deep Freeze at target foe's location. All foes in this area are struck for 10...85 cold damage, and for 10 seconds, they move 66% slower.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes in the area of your target (10 seconds). These foes move 66% slower. Initial effect: deals 10...85 cold damage.

skills.name: Defender's Zeal
skills.description: For 10...30 seconds, whenever target foe hits with an attack, you gain 2 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...30 seconds.) You gain 2 Energy whenever target foe hits with an attack.

skills.name: Defensive Anthem
skills.description: For 4...10 seconds, each party member within earshot has a 50% chance to block incoming attacks. This chant ends if that party member hits with an attack skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...10 seconds.) Party members in earshot have 50% chance to block. <gray>Ends when hitting with an attack skill.</gray>

skills.name: Defensive Stance
skills.description: For 1...5 second[s], you have a 75% chance to block melee and projectile attacks. When Defensive Stance ends, you gain one strike of adrenaline for each melee attack skill you have (maximum 0...4).
skills.conciseDescription: (1...5 second[s].) You have 75% chance to block. <gray>End effect: gain one adrenaline for each melee attack skill you have (maximum 0...4).</gray>

skills.name: Defiant Was Xinrae
skills.description: Hold Xinrae's ashes for up to 15...60 seconds. While you hold her ashes, you cannot lose more than 20% of your max Health from a single hit. When you drop her ashes, you steal 5...50 Health from all nearby foes.
skills.conciseDescription: (15...60 seconds.) You cannot lose more than 20% of your max Health from a single hit. Drop effect: steal 5...50 Health from nearby foes.

skills.name: Defile Defenses
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, the next time target foe blocks, that foe takes 30...120 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Deals 30...120 damage the next time target foe blocks.

skills.name: Defile Enchantments
skills.description: Target foe and all nearby foes take 6...60 shadow damage and 4...20 shadow damage for each enchantment on them.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 6...60 damage to target and nearby foes. Deals 4...20 more damage for each enchantment on them.

skills.name: Defile Flesh
skills.description: For 5...35 seconds, target foe gains only two-thirds Health from healing.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...35 seconds.) Reduces healing target foe receives by 33%. <gray>Only skills with the word "heal" in the description are affected.</gray>

skills.name: Deflect Arrows
skills.description: For 1...6 second[s], you have a 75% chance to block attacks. If you block a projectile attack, adjacent foes suffer from Bleeding for 5...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...6 second[s].) You have 75% chance to block attacks. Adjacent foes suffer Bleeding (5...15 seconds) when you block a projectile attack.

skills.name: Deft Strike
skills.description: If this attack hits, target foe takes 18...30 damage. If that foe has Cracked Armor, it begins Bleeding for 18...30 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 18...30 damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition (18...30 seconds) if target foe has Cracked Armor.

skills.name: Defy Pain
skills.description: For 20 seconds you have an additional 90...300 Health, an additional 20 armor, and you take -1...10 less damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) You have +90...300 maximum Health, +20 armor, and take 1...10 less damage.

skills.name: Demonic Flesh
skills.description: For 30...60 seconds, whenever you use a skill that targets a foe, you deal 5...20 shadow damage to all other foes adjacent to you.
skills.conciseDescription: (30...60 seconds.) When using a skill on a foe, deal 5...20 shadow damage to all other foes adjacent to you.

skills.name: Deny Hexes
skills.description: Remove one hex from target ally and one additional hex for each recharging Divine Favor skill you have.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes one hex from target ally and one additional hex for each recharging Divine Favor skill you have.

skills.name: Depravity
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, whenever target foe casts a spell, that foe and one nearby foe lose 1...5 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Causes 1...5 Energy loss whenever target foe casts a spell. One foe near your target also loses Energy.

skills.name: Desecrate Enchantments
skills.description: Target foe and all nearby foes take 6...60 shadow damage and 4...20 shadow damage for each enchantment on them.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 6...60 damage to target and nearby foes. Deals 4...20 more damage for each enchantment on them.

skills.name: Desperate Strike
skills.description: If you have less than 50...80% Health, you deal +15...60 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +15...60 damage if you have less than 50...80% Health.

skills.name: Desperation Blow
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +10...40 damage, and your target suffers from one of the following conditions: Deep Wound (for 20 seconds), Weakness (for 20 seconds), Bleeding (for 25 seconds), or Crippled (for 15 seconds). After making a Desperation Blow, you are knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage. Inflicts one of the following random conditions: Deep Wound (20 seconds), Weakness (20 seconds), Bleeding (25 seconds), or Crippled (15 seconds). <gray>You are knocked-down.</gray>

skills.name: Destruction
skills.description: Create a level 1...14 Spirit that dies after 30 seconds. When this Spirit dies, all foes in the area take 5...25 damage for each second the Spirit was alive (maximum 150 damage).
skills.conciseDescription: Create a level 1...14 Spirit that dies after 30 seconds. When this Spirit dies, all foes in the area take 5...25 damage for each second the Spirit was alive (maximum 150 damage).

skills.name: Destructive Was Glaive
skills.description: Hold Glaive's ashes for up to 30...60 seconds. While you hold her ashes, all Ritualist skills have 20% armor penetration. When you drop her ashes, all foes in the area are struck for 15...85 lightning damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (30...60 seconds.) Your Ritualist skills have 20% armor penetration. Drop effect: deals 15...85 lightning damage to all foes in the area.

skills.name: Determined Shot
skills.description: If Determined Shot hits, you strike for +5...20 damage. If Determined Shot fails to hit, all of your attack skills are recharged.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Recharges your attack skills if it fails to hit.

skills.name: Devastating Hammer
skills.description: If Devastating Hammer hits, your target is knocked down and suffers from Weakness for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Causes knock-down. Inflicts Weakness condition (5...20 seconds).

skills.name: Disarm
skills.description: Interrupt target foe's action. If that action was an attack, all of that foe's attack skills are disabled for 0...3 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts target foe. Interruption effect: disables this foe's attack skills (0...3 second[s]) if that action was an attack.

skills.name: Discharge Enchantment
skills.description: Remove one enchantment from target foe. If that foe is hexed, this skill recharges 20...50% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes one enchantment from target foe. 20...50% faster recharge if that foe was hexed.

skills.name: Disciplined Stance
skills.description: For 1...4 second[s], you gain +10 armor and have a 75% chance to block attacks. Disciplined Stance ends if you use an adrenal skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...4 second[s].) You have 75% chance to block and +10 armor. <gray>Ends if you use an adrenal skill.</gray>

skills.name: Discord
skills.description: If target foe is suffering from a condition and under the effects of a hex or an enchantment, that foe suffers 30...110 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 30...110 damage. <gray>No effect unless target foe has a condition and is either hexed or enchanted.</gray>

skills.name: Disenchantment
skills.description: Create a level 1...12 spirit. This spirit deals 5...20 damage and anyone struck by its attack loses one enchantment. This spirit dies after 10...35 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...12 spirit (10...35 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5...20 damage and remove one enchantment.

skills.name: Dismember
skills.description: If it hits, this axe blow will inflict a Deep Wound on the target foe, lowering that foe's maximum Health by 20% for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds).

skills.name: Dismiss Condition
skills.description: Remove one condition from target ally. If that ally is under the effects of an enchantment, that ally is healed for 15...75 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes one condition. Heals for 15...75 if target ally is enchanted.

skills.name: Displacement
skills.description: Create a level 1...14 spirit. All non-spirit allies within its range have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks. Every time an attack is blocked in this way, this spirit takes 60 damage. This spirit dies after 30...60 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...14 spirit (30...60 second lifespan). Non-spirit allies within range have 75% chance to block. <gray>Block effect: this spirit takes 60 damage.</gray>

skills.name: Disrupting Accuracy
skills.description: For 36 seconds, whenever your arrows critical, they also interrupt your target.
skills.conciseDescription: (36 seconds.) Interrupts an action whenever your arrows critical.

skills.name: Disrupting Chop
skills.description: If it hits, this attack interrupts the target's current action. If that action was a skill, that skill is disabled for an additional 20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: interrupted skill is disabled for +20 seconds.

skills.name: Disrupting Dagger
skills.description: Send out a Disrupting Dagger at target foe that strikes for 10...35 earth damage. If that foe was activating a skill, that skill is interrupted. This spell has half the normal range.
skills.conciseDescription: Half Range Spell. Projectile: deals 10...35 earth damage. Interrupts a skill.

skills.name: Disrupting Lunge
skills.description: Your animal companion attempts a Disrupting Lunge that deals +1...12 damage. If that attack strikes a foe using a skill that skill is interrupted and is disabled for an additional 20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +1...12 damage. Interrupts a skill. Interruption effect: interrupted skill is disabled for +20 seconds.

skills.name: Disrupting Shot
skills.description: If this attack hits, target foe's action is interrupted. If that action was a Skill, you strike for +10...40 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: +10...40 damage if you interrupt a skill.

skills.name: Disrupting Stab
skills.description: If this attack hits, it interrupts target foe's action. If that action was a spell, it is disabled for 3...10 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts an action. If the interrupted action was a spell, it is disabled (3...10 seconds).

skills.name: Disrupting Throw
skills.description: If this attack hits a foe suffering from a condition, that foe is interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts actions. <gray>No effect unless target has a condition.</gray>

skills.name: Dissonance
skills.description: Create a level 1...12 spirit. This spirit deals 5...20 damage and anyone struck by its attack is interrupted. This spirit dies after 10...25 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...12 spirit (10...25 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5...20 damage and interrupt actions.

skills.name: Distortion
skills.description: For 1...5 second[s], you have a 75% chance to block attacks. Whenever you block an attack this way, you lose 2 Energy or Distortion ends.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...5 second[s].) You have 75% chance to block. <gray>Block cost: you lose 2 Energy or Distortion ends.</gray>

skills.name: Distracting Blow
skills.description: Swipe your weapon at the target, dealing no damage but disrupting the target's current action (and the actions of foes adjacent to your target).
skills.conciseDescription: Also attacks foes adjacent to your target. Interrupts an action. <gray>Hits for no damage.</gray>

skills.name: Distracting Shot
skills.description: If Distracting Shot hits, it interrupts target foe's action but deals only 1...16 damage. If the interrupted action was a skill, that skill is disabled for an additional 20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: interrupted skill is disabled for +20 seconds. <gray>Hits for only 1...16 damage.</gray>

skills.name: Distracting Strike
skills.description: If Distracting Strike hits, it deals no damage and interrupts target foe's action. If target foe has Cracked Armor, that skill is disabled for 30 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: Disables interrupted skill (30 seconds) if target foe has Cracked Armor. <gray>Deals no damage.</gray>

skills.name: Diversion
skills.description: For 6 seconds, the next time target foe uses a skill, that skill takes an additional 10...56 seconds to recharge.
skills.conciseDescription: (6 seconds.) Target foe's next skill takes +10...56 seconds to recharge.

skills.name: Divert Hexes
skills.description: Remove up to 1...3 hex[es] from target ally. For each hex removed in this way, that ally loses one condition and gains 15...75 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes 1...3 hex[es]. For each hex removed, target ally loses one condition and gains 15...75 Health.

skills.name: Divine Boon
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, whenever you cast a Protection Prayer <sic/> or Divine Favor spell that targets an ally, that ally is healed for 15...60 Health, and you lose 1 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Whenever you cast a Protection Prayer <sic/> or Divine Favor spell on an ally, that ally is healed for 15...60. <gray>Heal cost: you lose 1 Energy.</gray>

skills.name: Divine Healing
skills.description: Heals you and party members within earshot for 15...60 points.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals you and party members within earshot for 15...60.

skills.name: Divine Intervention
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next time target ally receives damage that would be fatal, the damage is negated and that ally is healed for 26...240 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Negates the next fatal damage target ally takes. Negation effect: heals for 26...240.

skills.name: Divine Spirit
skills.description: For 1...14 second[s], Monk Spells cost you 5 less Energy to cast. (Minimum cost: 1 Energy.)
skills.conciseDescription: (1...14 second[s].) Monk spells cost you 5 less Energy. <gray>Minimum cost: 1 Energy.</gray>

skills.name: Dodge
skills.description: For 5...11 seconds, you move 33% faster and have a 27...75% chance to block incoming projectiles. Dodge ends if you attack.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) You move 33% faster and have 27...75% chance to block projectile attacks. <gray>Ends if you attack.</gray>

skills.name: Dolyak Signet
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, you have +10...40 armor and cannot be knocked down, but your movement is slowed by 75%.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) You have +10...40 armor and cannot be knocked-down. <gray>You move 75% slower.</gray>

skills.name: Doom
skills.description: Strike target foe for 10...60 lightning (maximum 135) damage for every recharging binding ritual you have.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...60 lightning damage (maximum 135) for each of your recharging binding rituals.

skills.name: Double Dragon
skills.description: Invoke the power of the Dragon. For 8 seconds, you and target ally are enchanted with Double Dragon. Adjacent foes are dealt 10...40 fire damage each second. Additionally, when you or your ally use skills that target a foe, that foe is set on fire for 1...4 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) Enchants you and target ally. Adjacent foes take 10...40 fire damage each second. Skills that target a foe also inflict Burning (1...4 second[s]).

skills.name: Dragon Slash
skills.description: If Dragon Slash hits, you strike for +10...40 damage and gain 1...5 strike[s] of adrenaline.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage. You gain 1...5 strike[s] of adrenaline if it hits.

skills.name: Dragon's Stomp
skills.description: You invoke a Dragon's Stomp at target foe's location. All foes near this location are knocked down and are struck for 26...100 earth damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 26...100 earth damage. Causes knock-down. Also hits foes near this foe.

skills.name: Drain Delusions
skills.description: Remove one Mesmer hex from target foe. If a hex was removed in this way, that foe loses 1...5 Energy and you gain 4 Energy for each point lost.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes one Mesmer hex from target foe. Causes 1...5 Energy loss. You gain 4 Energy for each point lost. <gray>No effect unless a hex was removed.</gray>

skills.name: Drain Enchantment
skills.description: Remove an enchantment from target foe. If an enchantment is removed, you gain 8...17 Energy and 40...120 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes an enchantment from target foe. Removal effect: you gain 8...17 Energy and 40...120 Health.

skills.name: Draw Conditions
skills.description: All negative conditions are transferred from target other ally to yourself. For each condition acquired, you gain 6...26 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Transfers all conditions from target ally to yourself. Transfer effect: you gain 6...26 Health for each condition. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Draw Spirit
skills.description: Teleport target allied spirit to your location.
skills.conciseDescription: Teleports target allied spirit to your location.

skills.name: Drunken Blow
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +10...40 damage and your target suffers from one of the following conditions: Deep Wound (for 20 seconds), Weakness (for 20 seconds), Bleeding (for 25 seconds), or Crippled (for 15 seconds). After making a Drunken Blow, you are knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage. Inflicts one of the following random conditions: Deep Wound (20 seconds), Weakness (20 seconds), Bleeding (25 seconds), or Crippled (15 seconds). <gray>You are knocked-down.</gray>

skills.name: Drunken Master
skills.description: For 72...90 seconds, your movement and attack speeds are increased by 10...15%. If you are drunk while activating this skill, your movement and attack speeds are increased by 25...33% instead.
skills.conciseDescription: (72...90 seconds.) You move and attack 10...15% faster if you are not drunk. You move and attack 25...33% faster if you are drunk.

skills.name: Dryder's Defenses
skills.description: For 5...11 seconds, you gain 75% chance to block attacks and 34...60 armor against elemental damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block and +34...60 armor against elemental damage.

skills.name: Dual Shot
skills.description: Shoot two arrows simultaneously at target foe. These arrows deal 25% less damage.
skills.conciseDescription: You shoot two arrows simultaneously at target foe. <gray>These arrows deal 25% less damage</gray>

skills.name: Dulled Weapon
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes cannot achieve a critical hit and deal 3...20 less damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes adjacent to your target (5...20 seconds). Removes ability to land a critical hit. Reduces damage by 3...20.

skills.name: Dust Cloak
skills.description: All nearby foes are struck for 10...40 earth damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal earth damage. When this enchantment ends, all nearby foes are Blinded for 1...4 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Your attacks deal earth damage. Initial effect: deals 10...40 earth damage to nearby foes. End effect: inflicts Blindness condition (1...4 second[s]) on nearby foes.

skills.name: Dust Trap
skills.description: When Dust Trap is triggered, every second (for 5 seconds total), all nearby foes are Blinded for 3...8 seconds and take 10...25 damage. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted. Dust Trap ends after 90 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals 10...25 damage every second (5 seconds). Inflicts Blindness condition (3...8 seconds) every second (5 seconds). <gray>Easily interrupted.</gray>

skills.name: Dwarven Battle Stance
skills.description: For 5...11 seconds, if you are wielding a hammer, you attack 33% faster, you gain +40 armor, and your attack skills interrupt foes when they hit.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) You attack 33% faster, you gain +40 armor, and your attack skills interrupt actions. <gray>No effect unless you have a hammer equipped.</gray>

skills.name: Dwarven Stability
skills.description: For 24...30 seconds, your stances last 55...100% longer. If you activated this skill while drunk, you cannot be knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: (24...30 seconds.) Your stances last 55...100% longer. You cannot be knocked-down if you activated this skill while drunk . <sic/>

skills.name: Dwayna's Kiss
skills.description: Heal target other ally for 20...65 Health and an additional 15...40 Health for each enchantment or hex on that ally.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 20...65. Heals for 15...40 more for each enchantment and hex on target ally. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Dwayna's Sorrow
skills.description: For 30 seconds, target ally and all nearby allies are enchanted with Dwayna's Sorrow. If an ally dies while under the effects of Dwayna's Sorrow, your party is healed for 5...50.
skills.conciseDescription: Enchants allies near your target (30 seconds). Your party is healed for 5...50 whenever one of these allies dies.

skills.name: Dwayna's Touch
skills.description: Target touched ally is healed for 60 Health for each Enchantment on you (maximum 60...240).
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Spell. Heals for 60 (maximum 60...240) for each enchantment on you.

skills.name: Ear Bite
skills.description: Target touched foe takes 50...70 piercing damage and begins Bleeding for 15...25 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Deals 50...70 piercing damage and inflicts Bleeding condition (15...25 seconds).

skills.name: Earth Attunement
skills.description: For 36...60 seconds, you are attuned to Earth. You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the base Energy cost of the skill each time you use Earth Magic.
skills.conciseDescription: (36...60 seconds.) You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the Energy cost when you use an Earth Magic skill.

skills.name: Earth Shaker
skills.description: Target foe and all adjacent foes are knocked down. (50% failure chance with Hammer Mastery 4 or less.)
skills.conciseDescription: Knocks down target and adjacent foes. <gray>50% failure chance unless Hammer Mastery is 5 or more.</gray>

skills.name: Earthbind
skills.description: Create a level 1...14 spirit. All non-spirit foes knocked down within its range are knocked down for at least 3 seconds. Whenever this happens, this spirit loses 50...25 Health. This spirit dies after 15...45 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...14 spirit (15...45 second lifespan). Any time non-spirit foes within range are knocked down, they are knocked down for at least 3 seconds. <gray>Knock-down cost: this spirit loses 50...25 Health.</gray>

skills.name: Earthen Shackles
skills.description: For 3 seconds, target and all nearby foes move 90% slower. When Earthen Shackles ends, it applies Weakness for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (3 seconds.) Target and nearby foes move 90% slower. Applies Weakness for 5...20 seconds when it ends.

skills.name: Earthquake
skills.description: You invoke an Earthquake at target foe's location. All foes near this location are knocked down and are struck for 26...100 earth damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 26...100 earth damage. Also hits foes near target. Causes knock-down.

skills.name: Ebon Battle Standard of Courage
skills.description: You plant an Ebon Battle Standard of Courage at your current location. For 14...20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area gain +24 armor and an additional +24 armor against Charr.
skills.conciseDescription: (14...20 seconds.) Allies in this ward have +24 armor and +24 more armor against Charr. <gray>Spirits are unaffected.</gray>

skills.name: Ebon Battle Standard of Honor
skills.description: You plant an Ebon Battle Standard of Honor at your current location. For 14...20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area strike for +8...15 damage and an additional +7...10 vs. Charr.
skills.conciseDescription: (14...20 seconds.) Allies in this ward deal +8...15 damage and +7...10 more damage against Charr. <gray>Spirits are unaffected.</gray>

skills.name: Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom
skills.description: You plant an Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom at your current location. For 14...20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area have a 44...60% chance to halve skill recharge of spells they cast.
skills.conciseDescription: (14...20 seconds.) Spells that allies in this ward cast have a 44...60% chance to recharge 50% faster. <gray>Spirits are unaffected.</gray>

skills.name: Ebon Dust Aura
skills.description: When you cast this enchantment, all nearby foes are Blinded for 1...7 second[s]. For 30 seconds, if you are wielding an earth weapon, your melee attacks deal +3...30 earth damage. When this enchantment ends, you are cured of Blindness.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Deal +3...30 earth damage with your melee attacks. Initial Effect: Blinds nearby foes for 1...7 second[s]. End Effect: removes Blindness. <gray>No effect unless wielding an earth weapon.</gray>

skills.name: Ebon Escape
skills.description: Shadow Step to target other ally. You and that other ally are healed for 70...110 health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals you and target ally for 70...110. Initial effect: Shadow Step to this ally. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Ebon Hawk
skills.description: Send a projectile that strikes target foe for 10...85 earth damage and causes Weakness for 5...15 seconds if it hits.
skills.conciseDescription: Projectile: deals 10...85 earth damage and inflicts Weakness condition (5...15 seconds).

skills.name: Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support
skills.description: Summon a level 14...20 Ebon Vanguard Assassin that has Iron Palm, Fox Fangs, and Nine Tail Strike. This summoned Assassin Shadow Steps to target foe. If that foe is a Charr, the Assassin lives for 24...30 seconds. If target foe is not a Charr, the Assassin lives for 12...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Summon a level 14...20 assassin that has Iron Palm, Fox Fangs, and Nine Tail Strike; it Shadow Steps to this foe. If this foe is a Charr, the assassin lives for 24...30 seconds. If target foe is not a Charr, the Assassin lives for 12...15 seconds.

skills.name: Ebon Vanguard Sniper Support
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 54...90 piercing damage and begins Bleeding for 5...25 seconds. This attack has a 10% chance of doing an additional +540...900 piercing damage. If this attack hits a Charr it has a 25% chance of doing an additional +540...900 piercing damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 54...90 piercing damage and inflicts Bleeding condition (5...25 seconds). 10% chance of +540...900 piercing damage. 25% chance of +540...900 piercing damage if target foe is a Charr.

skills.name: Echo
skills.description: For 30 seconds, Echo is replaced with the next skill you use. Echo acts as this skill for 30 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Echo becomes the next skill you use (30 seconds).

skills.name: Edge of Extinction
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. If a non-spirit creature within range dies, Edge of Extinction deals 14...50 damage to all creatures of the same type that are below 90% Health and within range of the spirit. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). Deals 14...50 damage to creatures in its range whenever a creature of the same type dies. Does not affect spirits. <gray>No damage to creatures above 90% Health.</gray>

skills.name: Elemental Attunement
skills.description: For 25...60 seconds, you are attuned to Air, Fire, Water, and Earth and gain +1...2 to these attributes. You gain 1 Energy plus 50% of the base Energy cost of the skill each time you use magic associated with any of these elements.
skills.conciseDescription: (25...60 seconds.) Your elemental attributes are increased by +1...2. You gain 1 plus 50% of the Energy cost of any Air, Earth, Fire, and Water Magic skills you use.

skills.name: Elemental Flame
skills.description: For 10...35 seconds, whenever you apply an Elemental hex to a foe, that foe is set on fire for 1...5 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) Inflicts Burning condition (1...5 second[s]) whenever you apply an Elemental hex to a target.

skills.name: Elemental Lord (Kurzick)
skills.description: For 40...60 seconds, your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 Energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100...300% of the spell's Energy cost.
skills.conciseDescription: (40...60 seconds.) Your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100...300% of the spell's Energy cost.

skills.name: Elemental Lord (Luxon)
skills.description: For 40...60 seconds, your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 Energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100...300% of the spell's Energy cost.
skills.conciseDescription: (40...60 seconds.) Your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100...300% of the spell's Energy cost.

skills.name: Elemental Resistance
skills.description: For 30...90 seconds, You gain +40 armor against elemental damage, but you lose 24...12 armor against physical damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (30...90 seconds.) You have +40 armor against elemental damage. <gray>You have -24...12 armor against physical damage.</gray>

skills.name: Empathic Removal
skills.description: You and target other ally lose 1 condition and 1 hex, and are healed for 50.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes one condition and hex from target ally and yourself, and heals for 50. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Empathy
skills.description: For 5...15 seconds, whenever target foe attacks, that foe takes 10...55 damage and deals 1...15 less damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.) Target foe's attacks deal 1...15 less damage, and that foe takes 10...55 damage with each attack.

skills.name: Empowerment
skills.description: Create a level 1...14 spirit. All allies within its range holding an item gain 15...45 maximum Health and 10 maximum Energy. This spirit dies after 15...60 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...14 spirit (15...60 second lifespan). Allies in range holding an item gain 15...45 maximum Health and 10 maximum Energy.

skills.name: Enchanted Haste
skills.description: For 7 seconds, you move 25% faster. If this enchantment ends prematurely, you lose 1 condition.
skills.conciseDescription: (7 seconds). You move 25% faster. Lose 1 condition if this enchantment ends prematurely.

skills.name: Enchanter's Conundrum
skills.description: For 10 seconds, target foe casts enchantments 100...200% slower. If target foe is not under the effects of an enchantment when this hex is applied, that foe takes 10...100 damage and all adjacent foes take 75% of that damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Causes 100...200% slower enchantment casting (10 seconds). Initial effect: if target foe is not enchanted<sic/> deals 10...100 damage to target and 75% of that damage to adjacent foes.

skills.name: Endure Pain
skills.description: For 7...18 seconds you have an additional 90...300 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (7...18 seconds.) You have +90...300 maximum Health.

skills.name: Enduring Harmony
skills.description: For 10...35 seconds, chants and shouts last 50% longer on target non-spirit ally.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) Chants and shouts last 50% longer on target ally. <gray>Cannot target spirits.</gray>

skills.name: Enduring Toxin
skills.description: For 5 seconds, target foe suffers -1...5 Health degeneration. If that foe is moving when Enduring Toxin would end, Enduring Toxin is renewed for another 5 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (5 seconds.) Causes -1...5 Health degeneration. Renewal: if the target foe is moving when this hex ends.

skills.name: Energetic Was Lee Sa
skills.description: Hold Lee Sa's ashes for 5...15 seconds. While you hold her ashes, you gain +2 Energy regeneration. When you drop her ashes, you gain +1...10 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.) You have +2 Energy regeneration. Drop effect: you gain +1...10 Energy.

skills.name: Energizing Chorus
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next Shout or Chant used by each ally within earshot costs 3...7 less Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) The next shout or chant costs 3...7 less Energy for allies within earshot.

skills.name: Energizing Finale
skills.description: For 10...35 seconds, whenever a shout or chant ends on target non-spirit ally, that ally gains 1...2 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) Target ally gains 1...2 Energy whenever a shout or chant ends on that ally. <gray>Cannot target spirits.</gray>

skills.name: Energizing Wind
skills.description: Create a level 1...6 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, all skills cost 15 less Energy (minimum cost 10 Energy), and skills recharge 25% slower. This spirit dies after 1...60 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...6 spirit (1...60 second[s] lifespan). Skills cost 15 less energy (minimum cost 10 energy) and recharge 25% slower for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.

skills.name: Energy Blast
skills.description: Target foe takes 1...2 damage for each point of Energy you have (maximum 130 damage).
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 1...2 damage (maximum 130) for each point of Energy you have.

skills.name: Energy Boon
skills.description: For 36...60 seconds, Energy Boon raises the maximum Health of you and target ally by 1...3 for each point of your respective maximum Energy. When this enchantment is first applied, you and your target gain 1...12 Energy. You gain an additional 1 Energy for every 2 points you have in Energy Storage.
skills.conciseDescription: (36...60 seconds.) Maximum Health for you and target ally is increased by 1...3 for each point of maximum Energy. Initial effect: Both gain 1...12 Energy. You gain +1 Energy for every 2 points of Energy Storage.

skills.name: Energy Burn
skills.description: Target foe loses 1...10 Energy and takes 9 damage for each point of Energy lost.
skills.conciseDescription: Causes 1...10 Energy loss. Deals 9 damage for each point of Energy lost.

skills.name: Energy Drain
skills.description: Target foe loses 2...9 Energy. You gain 3 Energy for each point of Energy lost.
skills.conciseDescription: Causes 2...9 Energy loss. You gain 3 Energy for each point of Energy lost.

skills.name: Energy Surge
skills.description: Target foe loses 1...10 Energy. For each point of Energy lost, that foe takes 7 damage and all nearby foes take 75% of that damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Causes 1...10 Energy loss. Deals 7 damage to target for each point of Energy lost and 75% of that damage to nearby foes.

skills.name: Energy Tap
skills.description: Target foe loses 4...7 Energy. You gain 2 Energy for each point of Energy lost.
skills.conciseDescription: Causes 4...7 Energy loss. You gain 2 Energy for each point of Energy lost.

skills.name: Enervating Charge
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 25...50 lightning damage and suffers from Weakness for 5...20 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 25...50 lightning damage. Inflicts Weakness condition (5...20 seconds). 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Enfeeble
skills.description: Target suffers from Weakness for 10...30 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Weakness condition (10...30 seconds).

skills.name: Enfeebling Blood
skills.description: Target foe and all nearby foes suffer from Weakness for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Weakness condition (5...20 seconds) on this foe and nearby foes.

skills.name: Enfeebling Touch
skills.description: Target touched foe loses 5...65 Health and suffers from Weakness for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Causes 5...65 Health loss. Inflicts Weakness condition (5...20 seconds).

skills.name: Enraged Lunge
skills.description: Your animal companion attempts an Enraged Lunge that applies a Deep Wound to target foe for 5...20 seconds and deals +10...50 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds) and deals +10...50 damage.

skills.name: Enraged Smash
skills.description: If Enraged Smash hits, you gain 1...4 strike[s] of adrenaline. If you hit a moving foe, you strike for +10...40 damage, and target foe is knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Gives you 1...4 strike[s] of adrenaline if you hit. Deals +10...40 damage and causes knockdown if target foe was moving.

skills.name: Enraging Charge
skills.description: For 5...15 seconds, you move 25% faster. Enraging Charge ends when you successfully strike a target, at which point you gain 0...3 strike[s] of adrenaline if you hit with a melee attack.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.) You move 25% faster. Gain +0...3 adrenaline on your next melee attack. <gray>Ends after your next hit.</gray>

skills.name: Entangling Asp
skills.description: Entangling Asp must follow a lead attack. Target foe is knocked down and becomes Poisoned for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Causes knock-down. Inflicts Poisoned condition (5...20 seconds). <gray>Must follow a lead attack.</gray>

skills.name: Envenom Enchantments
skills.description: Target foe loses one enchantment. For every remaining enchantment, target foe is poisoned for 3...10 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes one enchantment from target foe. Inflicts Poisoned condition (3...10 seconds for each remaining enchantment on that foe).

skills.name: Epidemic
skills.description: Spread all negative conditions and their remaining durations from target foe to all foes adjacent to your target.
skills.conciseDescription: Conditions on target foe transfer to adjacent foes.

skills.name: Equinox
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. Spells cast within its range that cause Overcast cause an additional 10 Overcast. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). Overcast-causing spells cast within range cause an additional 10 Overcast.

skills.name: Eremite's Attack
skills.description: If it hits, this attack deals +1...10 damage and removes a Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment is removed, you do an additional +1...10 damage and strike all adjacent foes.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +1...10 damage and removes a Dervish enchantment. Removal Effect: Deals +1...10 damage and strikes all adjacent foes.

skills.name: Eremite's Zeal
skills.description: You gain 1...3 Energy for each foe within earshot, maximum 8 Energy. For 10 seconds afterward, this enchantment does nothing. When this enchantment ends, you gain 1...3 Energy for each foe within earshot, maximum 8 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Initial effect: you gain 1...3 Energy (maximum 8) for each foe in earshot. End effect: you gain 1...3 Energy (maximum 8) for each foe in earshot.

skills.name: Eruption
skills.description: Cause an Eruption at target foe's location. Each second for 5 seconds, foes near this location are struck for 10...40 earth damage and are Blinded for 10 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...40 earth damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes near target's initial location. Inflicts Blindness condition (10 seconds).

skills.name: Escape
skills.description: For 1...8 second[s], you move 33% faster and have a 75% chance to block attacks.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...8 second[s].) You move 33% faster and have 75% chance to block.

skills.name: Essence Bond
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, whenever target ally takes physical or elemental damage, you gain 1 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 1 Energy whenever target ally takes physical or elemental damage.

skills.name: Essence Strike
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 15...60 lightning damage. If any spirits are within earshot, you gain 1...9 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 15...60 lightning damage. You gain 1...9 Energy if any spirits are within earshot.

skills.name: Eternal Aura
skills.description: You have +100 max Health. When this enchantment ends, all party members in the area are resurrected with 40...50% Health and 20...30% Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: You have +100 max Health. End effect: all party members in the area are resurrected with 40...50% Health and 20...30% Energy.

skills.name: Ether Feast
skills.description: Target foe loses 3 Energy. You are healed 20...65 for each point of Energy lost.
skills.conciseDescription: Causes 3 Energy loss. You gain 20...65 Health for each point of Energy lost.

skills.name: Ether Lord
skills.description: You lose all Energy. For 5...10 seconds, target foe suffers -1...3 Energy degeneration, and you experience +1...3 Energy regeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: <gray>You lose all Energy.</gray> Target foe has -1...3 Energy degeneration and you have +1...3 Energy regeneration (5...10 seconds).

skills.name: Ether Nightmare (Kurzick)
skills.description: Target foe loses 5...8 Energy. For each point of Energy lost in this way, that foe and all foes in the area suffer -1 Health degeneration for 10 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Causes 5...8 Energy loss. Target and foes in the area have -1 Health degeneration for each point of Energy lost (10 seconds).

skills.name: Ether Nightmare (Luxon)
skills.description: Target foe loses 5...8 Energy. For each point of Energy lost in this way, that foe and all foes in the area suffer -1 Health degeneration for 10 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Causes 5...8 Energy loss. Target and foes in the area have -1 Health degeneration for each point of Energy lost (10 seconds).

skills.name: Ether Phantom
skills.description: For 10 seconds, target foe has -1 Energy degeneration. If this hex is removed prematurely, that foe loses 1...5 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Causes -1 Energy degeneration. Causes 1...5 Energy loss if this hex ends early.

skills.name: Ether Prism
skills.description: For 3 seconds, all damage you take is reduced by 75%. When Ether Prism ends, you gain 5...20 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (3 seconds.) All damage you take is reduced by 75%. End effect: gain 5...20 Energy.

skills.name: Ether Prodigy
skills.description: Lose all enchantments. For 8...20 seconds, you gain +6 Energy regeneration. When Ether Prodigy ends, you lose 2 Health for each point of Energy you have.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) You have +6 Energy regeneration. End effect: lose 2 Health for each point of Energy you have. <gray>Lose all enchantments.</gray>

skills.name: Ether Renewal
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, each time you cast a spell, you gain 1...4 Energy and 5...20 Health for each enchantment on you.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1...4 Energy and 5...20 Health for each enchantment on you.

skills.name: Ether Signet
skills.description: If you have less than 5...10 Energy, gain 10...20 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 10...20 Energy. <gray>No effect unless you have less than 5...10 Energy.</gray>

skills.name: Ethereal Burden
skills.description: For 6...12 seconds, target foe moves 50% slower. When Ethereal Burden ends, you gain 10...18 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (6...12 seconds.) Target foe moves 50% slower. End effect: you gain 10...18 Energy.

skills.name: Ethereal Light
skills.description: Target ally is healed for 25...100. This spell is easily interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 25...100. <gray>Easily interrupted.</gray>

skills.name: Eviscerate
skills.description: If Eviscerate hits, you strike for +10...45 damage and inflict a Deep Wound, lowering your target's maximum Health by 20% for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...45 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds).

skills.name: Executioner's Strike
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +15...45 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +15...45 damage.

skills.name: Exhausting Assault
skills.description: Must follow a lead attack. Target foe's action is interrupted. If that action was casting a spell, target foe suffers 10 Overcast.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts an action. Inflicts 10 Overcast if the interrupted action was a spell. <gray>Must follow a lead attack.</gray>

skills.name: Expel Hexes
skills.description: Remove up to 2 Hexes from target ally.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes 2 hexes from target ally.

skills.name: Expert Focus
skills.description: For 24 seconds, your bow attack skills cost 1...2 less Energy and deal 1...10 extra damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (24 seconds.) Your bow attack skills cost 1...2 less Energy and do +1...10 damage.

skills.name: Expert's Dexterity
skills.description: For 1...20 second[s], you attack 33% faster and your Marksmanship attribute is increased by 2.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...20 second[s].) You attack 33% faster and you gain +2 to your Marksmanship attribute.

skills.name: Explosive Growth
skills.description: For 15...60 seconds, whenever you create a creature, up to 5 foes near that creature are struck for 20...65 lightning damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (15...60 seconds.) Deals 20...65 lightning damage each time you create a creature to 5 foes near that creature.

skills.name: Expose Defenses
skills.description: For 1...11 second[s], target foe cannot block your attacks.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...11 second[s].) Target foe cannot block your attacks.

skills.name: Expunge Enchantments
skills.description: Target foe loses 1 enchantment. All of your other non-attack skills are disabled for 8...4 seconds. For each skill disabled in this way, target touched foe loses 1 additional enchantment.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Removes one enchantment for each non-attack skill you have. <gray>All your non-attack skills are disabled (8...4 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Extend Conditions
skills.description: Spread all conditions from target foe to foes near your target. The durations of those conditions are increased by 5...100% (maximum 30 seconds).
skills.conciseDescription: Spread all conditions from target foe to foes near your target. Those <sic/> durations of those conditions are increased by 5...100% (maximum 30 seconds).

skills.name: Extend Enchantments
skills.description: For 10 seconds, your next Dervish enchantment lasts 10...150% longer.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Your next Dervish enchantment lasts 10...150% longer.

skills.name: Extinguish
skills.description: Remove one condition from each party member. Party members relieved of Burning are healed for 10...100 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Affects all party members. Removes one condition. Party members relieved of Burning are healed for 10...100.

skills.name: Faintheartedness
skills.description: For the next 4...18 seconds, target foe attacks 50% slower, and that foe suffers -1...3 Health degeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...18 seconds.) Target foe attacks 50% slower and has -1...3 Health degeneration.

skills.name: Faithful Intervention
skills.description: If damage drops your Health below 50%, Faithful Intervention ends. When Faithful Intervention ends, you are healed for 30...150 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 30...150 Health the next time damage drops your Health below 50%.

skills.name: Falling Lotus Strike
skills.description: Must strike a knocked-down foe. If it hits, you strike for +15...35 damage and gain 1...12 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +15...35 damage; you gain 1...12 Energy. <gray>No effect unless target foe is knocked-down.</gray>

skills.name: Falling Spider
skills.description: Must strike a knocked-down foe. If it hits, Falling Spider strikes for +15...35 damage and target foe is Poisoned for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +15...35 damage. Inflicts Poisoned condition (5...20 seconds). <gray>No effect unless target foe is knocked-down.</gray>

skills.name: Famine
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. Whenever a non-spirit creature in its range reaches 0 Energy, that creature takes 20...70 damage. This spirit dies after 30...180 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...180 lifespan). Deals 20...70 damage to creatures in range that reach 0 energy. Does not affect spirits.

skills.name: Farmer's Scythe
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If you hit more than one foe, this attack recharges instantly.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Instant recharge if you hit more than one foe.

skills.name: Favorable Winds
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, arrows move twice as fast and strike for +6 damage. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). Arrows move twice as fast and hit for +6 damage for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.

skills.name: Feast for the Dead
skills.description: Destroy target animated undead ally. All of your other animated undead allies are healed for 10...100 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Destroys one of your undead servants. Heals your servants for 10...100.

skills.name: Feast of Corruption
skills.description: Target foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 16...80 shadow damage. You steal up to 8...40 Health from each struck foe who is suffering from a hex.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 16...80 damage to target and adjacent foes. Steal 8...40 Health from each hexed foe.

skills.name: Feast of Souls
skills.description: Destroy all nearby allies' spirits. For each spirit destroyed in this way, all party members are healed for 50...100 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals all party members for 50...100 for each nearby allied spirit. <gray>All nearby allied spirits are destroyed.</gray>

skills.name: Featherfoot Grace
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, you move 25% faster, and conditions expire 50% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) You move 25% faster, and conditions expire 50% faster.

skills.name: Feedback
skills.description: Target foe loses one enchantment. If an enchantment is removed in this way, that foe also loses 4...10 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes one enchantment. Removal effect: target foe loses 4...10 Energy.

skills.name: Feel No Pain
skills.description: For 30 seconds you have +2...3 Health regeneration. If you are drunk when activating this skill, you also have +200...300 maximum Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) You have +2...3 Health regeneration. You have +200...300 maximum Health if you are drunk when activating this skill.

skills.name: Feigned Neutrality
skills.description: For 4...10 seconds, you have +7 Health regeneration and +80 armor. This enchantment ends if you successfully hit with an attack or use a skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...10 seconds.) You have +7 Health regeneration and +80 armor. <gray>Ends if you hit with an attack or use a skill.</gray>

skills.name: Feral Aggression
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, your pet attacks 33% faster and deals +3...10 additional damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Your pet attacks 33% faster and deals +3...10 damage.

skills.name: Feral Lunge
skills.description: Your animal companion attempts a Feral Lunge that deals +5...35 damage. If the attack strikes a foe who is attacking, that foe suffers from Bleeding for 5...25 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...35 damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition if target foe is attacking (5...25 seconds).

skills.name: Ferocious Strike
skills.description: Your animal companion attempts a Ferocious Strike that deals +13...28 damage. If that attack hits, you gain adrenaline and 3...10 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +13...28 damage. You gain adrenaline and 3...10 energy.

skills.name: Fertile Season
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within range have +50...150 maximum Health and gain +8 armor. This spirit dies after 15...90 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (15...90 second lifespan). Creatures in range have +50...150 maximum health and +8 armor. Does not affect spirits.

skills.name: Fetid Ground
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 15...65 cold damage. If that foe is knocked down, that foe becomes Poisoned for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 15...65 cold damage. Inflicts Poisoned condition (5...20 seconds) if target foe is knocked-down.

skills.name: Fevered Dreams
skills.description: For 10...25 seconds, whenever target foe suffers from a new condition, all foes in the area suffer from that condition as well. If target foe has two or more conditions that foe is Dazed for 1...3 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: (10...25 seconds.) Foes in the area also have any new conditions that target foe acquires. Inflicts Dazed on target foe (1...3 second[s]) if that foe has two or more conditions.

skills.name: Fierce Blow
skills.description: If Fierce Blow hits, you strike for +5...20 damage. If target foe was <sic/> suffering from Weakness, that foe also suffers from a Deep Wound for 1...8 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound (1...8 second[s]) if target foe is Weakened.

skills.name: Final Thrust
skills.description: Lose all adrenaline. If Final Thrust hits, you deal 5...40 more damage. This damage is doubled if your target was below 50% Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...40 damage. Deals +5...40 more damage if target foe is below 50% Health. <gray>Lose all adrenaline.</gray>

skills.name: Finale of Restoration
skills.description: For 10...35 seconds, whenever a chant or shout ends on target non-spirit ally, that ally is healed for 15...75 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) Target ally gains <sic/> 15...75 Health whenever a shout or chant ends on that ally. <gray>Cannot target spirits.</gray>

skills.name: Fire Attunement
skills.description: For 36...60 seconds, you are attuned to Fire. You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the base Energy cost of the skill each time you use Fire Magic.
skills.conciseDescription: (36...60 seconds.) You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the Energy cost when you use a Fire Magic skill.

skills.name: Fire Storm
skills.description: Create a Fire Storm at target foe's location. For 10 seconds, foes adjacent to that location are struck for 5...35 fire damage each second.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 5...35 fire damage each second (10 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target's initial location.

skills.name: Fireball
skills.description: Send out a ball of fire that strikes target foe and all nearby foes for 7...112 fire damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Projectile: deals 7...112 fire damage to target and nearby foes.

skills.name: Flail
skills.description: For 1...15 second[s], you attack 33% faster but move 33% slower.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...15 second[s].) You attack 33% faster. <gray>You move 33% slower.</gray>

skills.name: Flame Burst
skills.description: All nearby foes are struck for 15...120 fire damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 15...120 fire damage to all foes near you.

skills.name: Flame Djinn's Haste
skills.description: All adjacent foes are struck for 15...120 fire damage. For 8...14 seconds, you move 25% faster. Flame Djinn's Haste recharges 50% faster if a foe was struck by this spell.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...14 seconds.) You move 25% faster. Initial effect: deals 15...120 fire damage to foes adjacent to you. If you damage a foe with this spell, it recharges 50% faster.

skills.name: Flame Trap
skills.description: When Flame Trap is triggered, every second (for 3 seconds total), all nearby foes are struck for 5...20 fire damage and set on fire for 1...3 second[s]. Flame Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals 5...20 fire damage every second (3 seconds). Inflicts Burning condition (1...3 second[s]). <gray>Easily interrupted.</gray>

skills.name: Flare
skills.description: Send out a flare that strikes target foe for 20...65 fire damage if it hits. If you are Overcast, Flare hits adjacent foes as well.
skills.conciseDescription: Projectile: deals 20...65 fire damage. If Overcast, strikes adjacent.

skills.name: Flashing Blades
skills.description: For 5...30 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks while attacking. If you block an attack in this way, your attacker takes 5...20 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...30 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block while attacking. Block effect: 5...20 damage to your attacker.

skills.name: Fleeting Stability
skills.description: For 4...10 seconds, you cannot be knocked down and move 25% faster. This enchantment ends prematurely if it prevents a knockdown.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...10 seconds.) You cannot be knocked down and move 25% faster. Ends if knockdown prevented.

skills.name: Flesh of My Flesh
skills.description: Lose half your Health. Resurrect target party member with your current Health and 5...20% Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Resurrect target party member (half your current Health and 5...20% Energy). <gray>Lose half your Health.</gray>

skills.name: Flourish
skills.description: All of your attack skills become recharged. You gain 2...7 Energy for each skill recharged by Flourish.
skills.conciseDescription: Recharges your attack skills. You gain 2...7 Energy for each skill recharged.

skills.name: Flurry
skills.description: For 5 seconds, your attack rate is increased by 33%, but you deal 25% less damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (5 seconds). You attack 33% faster. <gray>You do 25% less damage.</gray>

skills.name: Focused Anger
skills.description: For 45 seconds, you gain 0...150% more adrenaline.
skills.conciseDescription: (45 seconds.) You gain 0...150% more adrenaline.

skills.name: Focused Shot
skills.description: This shot moves three times faster, cannot be blocked, and strikes for +10...40 damage but all of your other attack skills are disabled for 8...4 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage. Unblockable. This shot moves three times faster. <gray>Your other attack skills are disabled (8...4 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Forceful Blow
skills.description: If Forceful Blow hits, you strike for +10...30 damage and any stance being used by target foe ends. Target foe suffers from Weakness for 5...20 seconds. This attack cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...30 damage. Remove target foe's stance. Inflicts Weakness condition (5...20 seconds). Unblockable.

skills.name: Forked Arrow
skills.description: Shoot two arrows simultaneously at target foe. If you are under the effects of an enchantment or hex, you shoot only one arrow.
skills.conciseDescription: You shoot two arrows simultaneously. <gray>Shoot only one arrow if you are enchanted or hexed.</gray>

skills.name: Foul Feast
skills.description: All conditions are transferred from target other ally to yourself. For each condition acquired in this way, you gain 0...45 Health and 2...4 Energy. This skill recharges twice as fast if you remove Disease from your target.
skills.conciseDescription: Transfers all conditions from target ally to yourself. You gain 0...45 Health and 2...4 Energy for each condition transferred. Half recharge if you remove Disease. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Fox Fangs
skills.description: Must follow a lead attack. Fox Fangs cannot be blocked and strikes for +10...35 damage if it hits.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...35 damage. Unblockable. <gray>Must follow a lead attack.</gray>

skills.name: Fox's Promise
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, your dagger attacks cannot be blocked. This enchantment ends the next time you fail to hit.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Your dagger attacks are unblockable. <gray>Ends the next time you fail to hit.</gray>

skills.name: Fragility
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, target and adjacent foes take 5...20 damage each time they suffer or recover from a new condition.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes adjacent to target (8...20 seconds). These foes take 5...20 damage each time they gain or lose a condition.

skills.name: Freezing Gust
skills.description: If target foe is under the effect of a Water Magic hex, that foe is struck for 20...80 cold damage. Otherwise, that foe moves 66% slower for 1...5 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 20...80 cold damage if target foe is hexed with Water Magic. Otherwise, this foe moves 66% slower (1...5 second[s]).

skills.name: Frenzied Defense
skills.description: For 8 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks, but take double damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block. <gray>You take double damage.</gray>

skills.name: Frenzy
skills.description: For 8 seconds, you attack 33% faster but take 175...125%<sic/>damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) You attack 33% faster. <gray>You take 175...125% damage.</gray>

skills.name: Frigid Armor
skills.description: For 10...25 seconds, you have +10...40 armor against physical damage and cannot be set on fire.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...25 seconds.) You have +10...40 armor against physical damage and immunity to Burning.

skills.name: Frozen Burst
skills.description: All nearby foes are struck for 10...85 cold damage and move 66% slower for 3...8 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Hexes foes near you. These foes move 66% slower (3...8 seconds). Initial effect: deals 10...85 cold damage to foes near you.

skills.name: Frozen Soil
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within its range cannot activate resurrection skills. This spirit dies after 30...180 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit. (30...180 second lifespan). Creatures in range cannot activate resurrection skills. Does not affect spirits.

skills.name: Frustration
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, target foe casts spells 50% slower and takes 5...50 damage whenever interrupted. If a skill is interrupted, Frustration deals double damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Causes 50% slower spell casting. Target foe takes 5...50 damage whenever interrupted. Deals double damage on skill interrupt.

skills.name: Furious Axe
skills.description: If Furious Axe hits, you strike for +5...35 damage. If it is blocked you gain 3 strikes worth of adrenaline.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...35 damage. Gives you 3 strikes of adrenaline if blocked.

skills.name: Gale
skills.description: Knock down target foe for 2 seconds. (50% failure chance with Air Magic 4 or less.)
skills.conciseDescription: Causes knock-down. <gray>50% failure chance unless Air Magic 5 or more.</gray>

skills.name: Galrath Slash
skills.description: This attack strikes for +1...40 damage if it hits.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +1...40 damage.

skills.name: Gash
skills.description: If this attack hits a Bleeding foe, you strike for 5...20 more damage and that foe suffers a Deep Wound, lowering that foe's maximum Health by 20% for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage and inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds) if your target is Bleeding.

skills.name: Gaze from Beyond
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 20...65 lightning damage. If you are within earshot of a spirit, that foe is Blinded for 2...6 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 20...65 lightning damage. Inflicts Blindness condition for 2...6 seconds if you are within earshot of a spirit.

skills.name: Gaze of Contempt
skills.description: If target foe has more than 50% Health, that foe loses all enchantments.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes target foe's enchantments. <gray>No effect unless this foe has more than 50% Health.</gray>

skills.name: Gaze of Fury
skills.description: Destroy target spirit and create a level 1...14 Spirit of Fury. This spirit's attacks deal 5...20 damage. This spirit dies after 30...60 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Destroys a spirit. Creates a level 1...14 spirit (30...60 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5...20 damage.

skills.name: Generous Was Tsungrai
skills.description: Hold Tsungrai's ashes for up to 15...60 seconds and gain +50...140 maximum Health. When you drop his ashes, you gain 100...280 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (15...60 seconds.) You have +50...140 maximum Health. Drop effect: you gain 100...280 Health.

skills.name: Ghostly Haste
skills.description: For 5...30 seconds, spells you cast while within earshot of a spirit recharge 25% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...30 seconds.) Spells you cast recharge 25% faster. <gray>No effect unless you are within earshot of a spirit.</gray>

skills.name: Ghostly Weapon
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, target other ally's next attack cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Target ally's next attack is unblockable. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Ghostmirror Light
skills.description: Target other ally is healed for 15...90 Health. If you are within earshot of a spirit, you are also healed for 15...90 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 15...90. You gain 15...90 Health if you are within earshot of a spirit. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Gift of Health
skills.description: All of your other Healing Prayers skills are disabled for 10...5 seconds. Target other ally is healed for 15...150 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 15...150. <gray>Disables your other Healing Prayers skills (10...5 seconds). Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Gladiator's Defense
skills.description: For 5...11 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks. Whenever you block a melee attack this way, the attacker suffers 5...35 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block. Your attacker takes 5...35 damage whenever you block a melee attack this way.

skills.name: Glass Arrows
skills.description: For 10...35 seconds, your arrows strike for +6...20 damage if they hit and cause Bleeding for 10...20 seconds if they are blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) Your arrows deal +6...20 damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition if blocked (10...20 seconds).

skills.name: Glimmer of Light
skills.description: Heal target ally for 10...115 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 10...115.

skills.name: Glimmering Mark
skills.description: For 10 seconds, target foe and all foes adjacent to your target take 5...25 damage each second. Foes using attack skills are Blinded for 3 seconds. This hex ends if you use a skill that targets this foe.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Deals 5...25 damage each second to target and adjacent foes. Inflicts Blindness <sic/> on foes using attack skills. <gray>Ends if you use a skill that targets this foe.</gray>

skills.name: Glowing Gaze
skills.description: Target foe takes 5...50 fire damage. If that foe is on Fire, <sic/> you gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 5...50 fire damage. You gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage if target foe is Burning.

skills.name: Glowing Ice
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 5...50 cold damage. If that foe is under the effects of a Water Magic hex, you gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 5...50 cold damage. You gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage if target foe is hexed with Water Magic.

skills.name: Glowing Signet
skills.description: If target foe is Burning, you gain 5...15 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 5...15 Energy if target foe is Burning.

skills.name: Glowstone
skills.description: Send a projectile that strikes for 5...50 earth damage if it hits. If this spell hits a weakened <sic/> foe, you gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage.
skills.conciseDescription: Projectile: deals 5...50 earth damage. You gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage if target foe is Weakened.

skills.name: Glyph of Concentration
skills.description: For 15 seconds, your next 1 spell cannot be interrupted and ignores the effects of being Dazed.
