skills.conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) Your next 1 spell cannot be interrupted and is unaffected by the Dazed condition.

skills.name: Glyph of Elemental Power
skills.description: For 25 seconds, your elemental attributes are boosted by 2 for your next 10 spells.
skills.conciseDescription: (25 seconds.) Boosts your elemental attributes by +2 for your next 10 spells.

skills.name: Glyph of Energy
skills.description: Your next 1...3 spell[s] do[es] not cause Overcast and cost[s] 10...25 less Energy to cast. Your elemental attributes are increased by 1...2.
skills.conciseDescription: Your next 1...3 spell[s] do[es] not cause Overcast and cost[s] 10...25 less Energy. Gain 1...2 to all elemental attributes.

skills.name: Glyph of Essence
skills.description: For 15 seconds, your next spell casts instantly but causes you to lose all Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) Your next spell casts instantly. <gray>You lose all Energy.</gray>

skills.name: Glyph of Immolation
skills.description: For 15 seconds, your next 1...4 spell[s] that target[s] a foe also cause[s] Burning for 1...4 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) Your next 1...4 spell[s] that target[s] a foe also inflict[s] Burning condition (1...4 second[s]).

skills.name: Glyph of Lesser Energy
skills.description: For the next 15 seconds, your next 2 spells cost 10...18 less Energy to cast.
skills.conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) Your next 2 spells cost 10...18 less Energy.

skills.name: Glyph of Renewal
skills.description: For 15 seconds, your next spell instantly recharges.
skills.conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) Your next spell recharges instantly.

skills.name: Glyph of Restoration
skills.description: For 15 seconds, your next 2 spells heal you for 30...105 Health, and you are healed for 150...400% of the Energy cost of each spell.
skills.conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) Your next 2 spells heal you for 30...105, and you are healed for 150...400% of the Energy cost of each spell.

skills.name: Glyph of Sacrifice
skills.description: For 15 seconds, your next spell casts instantly, but it takes an additional 30 seconds to recharge. Ends prematurely if you use a non-spell skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) Your next spell casts instantly but takes an additional 30 seconds to recharge. <gray>Ends if you use a non-spell skill.</gray>

skills.name: Glyph of Swiftness
skills.description: For 15 seconds, your next 1...5 spell[s] recharge 25% faster and projectiles from the affected spells move 200% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) Your next 1...5 spell[s] recharge 25% faster and projectiles from them move 200% faster.

skills.name: Godspeed
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, all allies within earshot move 25% faster while under the effects of an enchantment.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Allies in earshot move 25% faster while enchanted.

skills.name: Golden Fang Strike
skills.description: Must follow a lead attack. If you are under the effects of an enchantment and this attack hits, target foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds) if you are enchanted. <gray>Must follow a lead attack.</gray>

skills.name: Golden Fox Strike
skills.description: If this attack hits, target foe takes +10...30 damage. If you are under the effects of an Enchantment, this attack cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...30 damage. Unblockable if you are Enchanted.

skills.name: Golden Lotus Strike
skills.description: If it hits, this attack strikes for +5...20 damage. If you are under the effects of an Enchantment, you gain 5...8 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. You gain 5...8 Energy if you are enchanted.

skills.name: Golden Phoenix Strike
skills.description: If you are not under the effects of an enchantment, this skill misses. If it hits, Golden Phoenix Strike deals +10...30 damage and all adjacent foes take 10...30 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...30 damage to target and deals 10...30 damage to adjacent foes. <gray>Fails if you are not enchanted.</gray>

skills.name: Golden Skull Strike
skills.description: If you are under the effects of an enchantment and this attack hits, target foe is Dazed 1...12 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Dazed condition (1...12 seconds). <gray>No effect unless you are enchanted.</gray>

skills.name: Grapple
skills.description: You and target touched foe are knocked down. You lose your current stance.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Causes knockdown. You are also knocked down. <gray>Your current stance ends.</gray>

skills.name: Grasping Earth
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, all nearby foes move 50% slower.
skills.conciseDescription: Hexes foes near you for (5...20 seconds). These foes move 50% slower.

skills.name: Grasping Was Kuurong
skills.description: Hold Kuurong's ashes for up to 15...60 seconds. When you drop his ashes, all foes in the area are struck for 15...75 damage and knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: (15...60 seconds.) Drop effect: deal 15...75 damage and knocks-down all foes in the area.

skills.name: Great Dwarf Armor
skills.description: For 22...40 seconds, target ally has +24 armor, +60 maximum Health, and an additional +24 armor against Destroyers.
skills.conciseDescription: (22...40 seconds.) +24 armor and +60 maximum Health. Additional +24 armor against Destroyers.

skills.name: Great Dwarf Weapon
skills.description: For 20 seconds, target other ally's weapon strikes for +15...20 damage and has a 28...40% chance to cause knock down.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) +15...20 weapon damage and 28...40% chance to cause knock-down with attacks. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Greater Conflagration
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, all physical damage is fire damage instead. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). Converts physical damage to fire damage for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.

skills.name: Grenth's Aura
skills.description: For 20 seconds, you deal 5...25 less damage and steal 5...25 Health whenever you hit with a scythe attack. When you cast this enchantment you steal 5...25 Health from all adjacent foes.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) You deal 5...25 less damage and steal 5...25 Health when you hit with a scythe. Initial effect: steal 5...25 Health from all adjacent foes.

skills.name: Grenth's Balance
skills.description: If target foe has more Health than you, you gain half the difference (up to your maximum Health), and that foe loses an equal amount. If this foe has less Health than you, you lose half the difference, and that foe gains an equal amount.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain Health equal to half the difference between you and target, and this foe loses an equal amount. <gray>If this foe has less Health than you, you lose Health equal to half the difference.</gray>

skills.name: Grenth's Fingers
skills.description: All nearby foes are struck for 10...40 cold damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal cold damage. When this enchantment ends, you transfer 1...2 condition[s] to all nearby foes. <sic/>
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Your attacks deal cold damage. Initial effect: hits nearby foes for 10...40 cold damage. End effect: transfers 1...2 condition[s] to all nearby foes.

skills.name: Grenth's Grasp
skills.description: For 20 seconds, your attack skills also Cripple that <sic/> foe for 1...11 second[s] and you transfer 1...3 condition[s] from yourself to that foe.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) Inflicts Crippled (1...11 second[s]) with your attack skills and transfer 1...3 condition[s].

skills.name: Griffon's Sweep
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +5...20 damage. If this attack is blocked, your target is knocked down and suffers 10...34 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Causes knock-down and deals 10...34 damage if blocked.

skills.name: Guardian
skills.description: For 2...7 seconds, target ally has a 50% chance to block attacks.
skills.conciseDescription: (2...7 seconds.) 50% chance to block.

skills.name: Guided Weapon
skills.description: For 4...10 seconds, target ally's attacks cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...10 seconds.) Attacks are unblockable.

skills.name: Guiding Hands
skills.description: For 20 seconds, your next 0...3 attack[s] cannot be blocked. When activated, this skill removes the Blindness condition.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) Your next 0...3 attack[s] cannot be blocked. Initial effect: removes Blindness.

skills.name: Guilt
skills.description: For 6 seconds, the next time target foe casts a spell that targets a foe, the spell fails and you steal up to 5...14 Energy from that foe.
skills.conciseDescription: (6 seconds.) Target foe's next spell fails and you steal 5...14 Energy. <gray>No effect unless this foe's spell targets one of your allies.</gray>

skills.name: Gust
skills.description: For 5...11 seconds, both you and target ally move 33% faster. When you cast this spell, all foes adjacent to you and your target take 15...70 cold damage. Foes struck by Gust while attacking or moving are knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) You and target ally move 33% faster. Initial effect: Foes adjacent to you and target ally are struck for 15...70 cold damage. Attacking or moving foes are knocked down.

skills.name: Hammer Bash
skills.description: Lose all adrenaline. If Hammer Bash hits, your target is knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Causes knock-down. <gray>Lose all adrenaline.</gray>

skills.name: Hamstring
skills.description: If this attack hits, your target is Crippled for 3...15 seconds, slowing his<sic/> movement.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Crippled condition (3...15 seconds).

skills.name: Harrier's Grasp
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, attacks against moving foes also Cripple that foe for 2...9 seconds. When you cast this enchantment, you are relieved of Cripple and 1 other condition. This enchantment ends after you apply Cripple 1...3 times. <sic/>.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Attacks on moving foes also Cripple them. <sic/> Initial Effect: you lose Cripple and 1 other condition. <gray>Ends after you apply Cripple 1...3 times. <sic/> </gray>

skills.name: Harrier's Haste
skills.description: For 2...8 seconds, you move 25% faster and deal +3...12 more damage against moving foes.
skills.conciseDescription: (2...8 seconds.) You move 25% faster and deal +3...12 damage to moving foes.

skills.name: Harrier's Toss
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If this attack hits a moving foe, it deals an additional 5...40 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Deals 5...40 more damage if target is moving.

skills.name: Hasty Refrain
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, target ally moves 25% faster. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on that ally.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) Target ally moves 25% faster. Renewal: every time a chant or shout ends on this ally.

skills.name: Headbutt
skills.description: Target touched foe takes 40...100 damage. You are Dazed for 10 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Elite Touch Skill. Deals 40...100 damage. <gray>You are Dazed (10 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Heal Area
skills.description: Heal yourself and all adjacent creatures for 30...180 points.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals you and adjacent allies and foes for 30...180.

skills.name: Heal as One
skills.description: For 15 seconds, your animal companion steals 1...20 Health whenever it hits with an attack. You and your companion are both healed for 20...104 Health. If your companion is dead, it's resurrected with 50% Health. If you have this skill equipped, your companion will travel with you.
skills.conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) Your pet's attacks steal 1...20 Health. Initial effect: heals you and your pet for 20...104; resurrects your pet (50% Health) if dead. If you have this equipped, your pet will travel with you.

skills.name: Heal Other
skills.description: Heal target other ally for 35...180 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 35...180. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Heal Party
skills.description: Heal entire party for 30...75 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals entire party for 30...75.

skills.name: Healer's Boon
skills.description: For 10...55 seconds. <sic/> Healing Prayers spells cast 50% faster and heal for 50% more Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...55 seconds.) Healing Prayers spells cast 50% faster and heal for 50% more.

skills.name: Healer's Covenant
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, your Healing Prayers spells heal for 20% less Health, but cost -1...4 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Your Healing Prayers spells cost 1...4 less Energy. <gray>These spells heal for 20% less.</gray>

skills.name: Healing Breeze
skills.description: For 15 seconds, target ally gains +4...9 Health regeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) +4...9 Health regeneration.

skills.name: Healing Burst
skills.description: Target ally is healed for 20...120. All party members in earshot of your target gain Health equal to the Divine Favor bonus from this spell. Your Smiting Prayers are disabled for 20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 20...120. Party members in earshot of your target gain Health equal to the Divine Favor bonus. <gray>Disables your Smiting Prayers (20 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Healing Hands
skills.description: For 10 seconds, whenever target ally takes damage, that ally is healed for 5...35 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Heals for 5...35 whenever target takes damage.

skills.name: Healing Light
skills.description: Heal target ally for 40...120 Health. If your target has an enchantment, you gain 1...3 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 40...120. You gain 1...3 Energy if target ally is enchanted.

skills.name: Healing Ribbon
skills.description: Target other ally is healed for 20...110 Health. Up to 2 additional allies near target ally are healed for 10...100 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 20...110. Heals two additional allies near target ally for 10...100. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Healing Ring
skills.description: Heal adjacent creatures for 30...180 Health. The caster is not healed.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals adjacent allies and foes for 30...180. <gray>The caster is not healed.</gray>

skills.name: Healing Seed
skills.description: For 10 seconds, whenever target other ally takes damage, that ally and all adjacent allies gain 3...30 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Target and adjacent allies gain 3...30 Health whenever this ally takes damage. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Healing Signet
skills.description: You gain 82...172 Health. You have -40 armor while using this skill.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 82...172 Health. <gray>You have -40 armor while using this skill.</gray>

skills.name: Healing Spring
skills.description: For 10 seconds, all adjacent allies are healed for 15...60 every 2 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Affects adjacent allies. Heals for 15...60 every 2 seconds. <gray>Easily interrupted.</gray>

skills.name: Healing Touch
skills.description: Heal target touched ally for 20...80 Health. Health gain from Divine Favor is doubled for this spell.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Spell. Heals for 20...80. Double Health gain from Divine Favor for this spell.

skills.name: Healing Whisper
skills.description: Target other ally is healed for 40...100. This spell has half the normal range.
skills.conciseDescription: Half Range Spell. Heals for 40...100. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Heart of Fury
skills.description: For 2...10 seconds, you attack 25% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (2...10 seconds.) You attack 25% faster.

skills.name: Heart of Holy Flame
skills.description: All nearby foes take 5...30 holy damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal holy damage. When this enchantment ends, all nearby foes are set on fire for 2...5 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Your attacks deal holy damage. Initial effect: deals 5...30 holy damage to nearby foes. End effect: inflicts Burning condition (2...5 seconds) on nearby foes.

skills.name: Heart of Shadow
skills.description: You are healed for 30...150. Shadow Step to a nearby location directly away from your target.
skills.conciseDescription: You are healed for 30...150 and you Shadow Step to a nearby location directly away from your target.

skills.name: Heaven's Delight
skills.description: Heals you and party members within earshot for 15...60 points.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals you and party members within earshot for 15...60 points.

skills.name: Heavy Blow
skills.description: Lose all adrenaline. If this attack hits a foe suffering from Weakness, that foe is knocked down and you strike for +1...30 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +1...30 damage and causes knock-down if target foe is Weakened. <gray>Lose all adrenaline.</gray>

skills.name: Heket's Rampage
skills.description: For 5...11 seconds, you attack 33% faster. This stance ends if you use an attack skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds). You attack 33% faster. <gray>Ends if you use an attack skill.</gray>

skills.name: Heroic Refrain
skills.description: For 3...15 seconds, target non-spirit ally gains +1...3 to all attributes. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on that ally.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...15 seconds.) Target ally gains +1...3 to all attributes. Renewal: every time a chant or shout ends on this ally. <gray>Cannot target spirits. PvE Skill</gray>

skills.name: Hex Breaker
skills.description: For 5...80 seconds, the next time you are the target of a hex, that hex fails and the caster takes 10...46 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...80 seconds.) The next hex against you fails and the caster takes 10...46 damage.

skills.name: Hex Eater Signet
skills.description: Target touched ally and up to 2...5 adjacent allies each lose one hex. You gain 1...4 Energy for each hex removed this way.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Signet. Removes a hex from target and 2...5 adjacent allies. Removal effect: you gain 1...4 Energy for each hex removed.

skills.name: Hex Eater Vortex
skills.description: Remove a hex from target ally. If a hex is removed in this way, foes in the area of that ally take 30...90 damage and lose one enchantment.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes one hex from target ally. Removal effect: deals 30...90 damage and removes one enchantment from foes in the area of this ally.

skills.name: Hexbreaker Aria
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot casts a spell, that ally loses 1 hex.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot lose one hex with their next spell.

skills.name: Hexer's Vigor
skills.description: For 10 seconds, you have +1...8 Health regeneration. Hexer's Vigor ends if you cast a non-hex skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) You have +1...8 Health regeneration. <gray>Ends if you use a non-hex skill.</gray>

skills.name: Hidden Caltrops
skills.description: Your non-Assassin skills are disabled for 3 seconds. For 1...10 seconds, target foe moves 50% slower. When this hex ends that foe is Crippled for 1...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...10 seconds.) Causes 50% slower movement. End effect: inflicts Crippled condition (1...15 seconds). Your non-Assassin skills are disabled (3 seconds.)

skills.name: Holy Haste
skills.description: For 1...60 second[s], your Healing Prayers spells cast 50% faster. This enchantment ends if you cast another enchantment.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...60 second[s].) Your Healing Prayers spells cast 50% faster. <gray>Ends if you cast an enchantment.</gray>

skills.name: Holy Spear
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If it hits a summoned creature, all nearby foes take 15...90 holy damage, and are set on fire for 3 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Deals 15...90 holy damage and inflicts Burning condition (3 seconds) to nearby foes if you hit a summoned creature.

skills.name: Holy Strike
skills.description: Touched target foe takes 10...55 holy damage. If knocked down, your target takes an additional 10...55 holy damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Deals 10...55 holy damage. Deals 10...55 more holy damage if target is knocked down.

skills.name: Holy Veil
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, any hex cast on target ally takes twice as long to cast. When Holy Veil ends, one hex is removed from target ally.
skills.conciseDescription: Doubles casting time of hexes cast on target ally. End effect: removes a hex.

skills.name: Holy Wrath
skills.description: For 10...30 seconds, the next 1...10 time[s] target other ally takes attack damage, this spell deals 66% of the damage back to the source (maximum of 5...50 damage).
skills.conciseDescription: (10...30 seconds). Deals 66% of each attack's damage (maximum 5...50) back to source. <gray>Ends after dealing damage 1...10 time[s]. Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Horns of the Ox
skills.description: Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, Horns of the Ox strikes for +1...11 damage. If struck foe is not adjacent to any allies, that foe is knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +1...11 damage. Causes knock-down if the target foe is not adjacent to any of its allies. <gray>Must follow an off-hand attack.</gray>

skills.name: Hundred Blades
skills.description: For 15 seconds, whenever you attack with a sword, all adjacent foes take 10...35 slashing damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) Deals 10...35 slashing damage to all adjacent foes whenever you attack with a sword.

skills.name: Hunter's Shot
skills.description: If this attack hits, your target bleeds for 3...25 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Bleeding condition (3...25 seconds) if your target is hit.

skills.name: Hypochondria
skills.description: Transfer all conditions from all foes in the area to target foe.
skills.conciseDescription: Transfer all conditions from foes in the area to target foe.

skills.name: Ice Prison
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, target foe's legs are encased in ice, causing the foe to move 66% slower.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) Target foe moves 66% slower.

skills.name: Ice Spear
skills.description: Send out an Ice Spear, striking target foe for 10...60 cold damage if it hits. If you are Overcast, you gain +1...4 Health regeneration for 5 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Projectile: deals 10...60 cold damage. Gain +1...4 Health regeneration for 5 seconds if Overcast.

skills.name: Ice Spikes
skills.description: Target and adjacent foes are struck for 20...80 cold damage and move 66% slower for 2...6 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes adjacent to target (2...6 seconds). These foes move 66% slower. Initial effect: deals 20...80 cold damage.

skills.name: Icy Prism
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 15...75 cold damage. If that foe has a Water Magic hex, Icy Prism deals +<sic/>15...75 cold damage to all other nearby foes.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 15...75 cold damage. Deals +<sic/>15...75 cold damage to other nearby foes if target has a Water Magic hex.

skills.name: Icy Shackles
skills.description: For 1...10 second[s], target foe's movement speed is reduced by 66%. While under the effects of an enchantment, that foe's movement is reduced by 90%.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...10 second[s].) Target foe moves 66% slower. This foe moves 90% slower if enchanted.

skills.name: Icy Veins
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 10...90 cold damage. For 10...35 seconds, if target foe dies all nearby foes are struck for 20...110 cold damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) Deals 20...110 cold damage to nearby foes if target foe dies. Initial effect: deals 10...90 cold damage.

skills.name: Ignite Arrows
skills.description: For 24 seconds, your arrows explode on contact, dealing 3...18 fire damage to target and all adjacent foes.
skills.conciseDescription: (24 seconds.) Your arrows deal 3...18 fire damage to target and foes adjacent to target.

skills.name: Ignorance
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds target foe cannot use signets.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) Target foe cannot use signets.

skills.name: Illusion of Haste
skills.description: For 5...11 seconds you are no longer Crippled, and you move 33% faster. When Illusion of Haste ends, you become Crippled for 3 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) You move 33% faster. Initial effect: removes Crippled condition. <gray>End effect: you are Crippled (3 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Illusion of Pain
skills.description: For 8 seconds, target foe has -3...10 Health degeneration and takes 3...10 damage each second. When Illusion of Pain ends, that foe is healed for 36...120.
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) Causes -3...10 Health degeneration and target foe takes 3...10 damage each second. End effect: that foe is healed for 36...120.

skills.name: Illusion of Weakness
skills.description: You lose 50...240 Health. Illusion of Weakness ends if damage drops your Health below 25% of your maximum. When Illusion of Weakness ends, you gain 50...240 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Lose 50...240 Health. End effect: you gain 50...240 Health. <gray>Ends if damage drops your Health below 25% of your maximum.</gray>

skills.name: Illusionary Weaponry
skills.description: For 30 seconds, your melee attacks neither hit nor fail to hit. Instead, Illusionary Weaponry deals 20...60 damage to your targets for each melee attack. You have +5 armor for each equipped Illusion Magic skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Deals 20...60 damage to foes in place of other damage or effects from melee attacks. You have +5 armor for each equipped Illusion Magic skill. <gray>Your melee attacks neither hit nor fail to hit.</gray>

skills.name: Images of Remorse
skills.description: For 5...10 seconds, target foe suffers -1...3 Health degeneration. If that foe was attacking, that foe takes 10...52 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...10 seconds.) Causes -1...3 Health degeneration. Initial effect: 10...52 damage if target foe is attacking.

skills.name: Imagined Burden
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, target foe moves 50% slower.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) Target foe moves 50% slower.

skills.name: Imbue Health
skills.description: Target other ally is healed for 5...50% of your current Health (maximum 300 Health).
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 5...50% of your current Health (maximum 300). <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Immolate
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 20...75 fire damage and is set on fire for 1...3 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 20...75 fire damage. Inflicts Burning condition (1...3 second[s]).

skills.name: Impale
skills.description: Must follow a dual attack. Target foe is struck for 25...100 earth damage and suffers from a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 25...100 earth damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds). <gray>Must follow a dual attack.</gray>

skills.name: Incendiary Arrows
skills.description: Shoot arrows at target foe and up to 2 foes near your target. Those foes are set on fire for 1...3 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Hits 2 foes near your target and inflicts burning (1...3 second[s]).

skills.name: Incendiary Bonds
skills.description: After 3 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes are struck for 20...80 fire damage and are set on fire for 1...3 second[s]. Activates early if target foe dies.
skills.conciseDescription: (3 seconds.) End effect: deals 20...80 fire damage and inflicts Burning condition (1...3 second[s]) to foes near your target. Also triggers if foe dies.

skills.name: Ineptitude
skills.description: For 4 seconds, the next time target foe or any adjacent foe attacks, they take 30...135 damage and are Blinded for 10 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (4 seconds.) Also hexes foes adjacent to target. Deals 30...135 damage. Inflicts Blindness condition (10 seconds). <gray>No effect unless hexed foe attacks.</gray>

skills.name: Inferno
skills.description: All adjacent foes are struck for 30...135 fire damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 30...135 fire damage to foes adjacent to you.

skills.name: Infuriating Heat
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within its range gain adrenaline twice as fast. This spirit dies after 30...120 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...120 second lifespan). Doubles adrenaline gain for creatures in range.

skills.name: Infuse Condition
skills.description: For the next 15...60 seconds, whenever you receive a condition, that condition is transferred to your closest minion instead.
skills.conciseDescription: (15...60 seconds.) Whenever you receive a condition, it transfers from you to your closest undead servant.

skills.name: Infuse Health
skills.description: Lose half your current Health. Target other ally is healed for 100...136% of the amount you lost.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 100...136% of half your current Health. <gray>Lose half your current Health. Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Insidious Parasite
skills.description: For 5...15 seconds, whenever target foe hits with an attack, you steal up to 15...45 Health from that foe.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.) Steal 15...45 Health whenever target foe hits with an attack.

skills.name: Inspirational Speech
skills.description: You lose all adrenaline and target other ally gains 1...8 strikes of adrenaline.
skills.conciseDescription: Target ally gains 1...8 strike[s] of adrenaline. <gray>Cannot self-target. You lose all adrenaline.</gray>

skills.name: Inspired Enchantment
skills.description: Removes an enchantment from target foe and gain 3...15 Energy. For 20 seconds, Inspired Enchantment is replaced with the enchantment removed from target foe.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes an enchantment from target foe. Removal effects: you gain 3...15 Energy; this spell is replaced with that enchantment (20 seconds).

skills.name: Inspired Hex
skills.description: Remove a hex from target ally and gain 4...10 Energy. For 20 seconds, Inspired Hex is replaced with the hex that was removed.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes a hex from target ally. Removal effects: you gain 4...10 Energy; this spell is replaced with that hex (20 seconds).

skills.name: Intensity
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next time you deal elemental damage with a spell to a target, you deal 60...70% of that damage to all other foes in the area.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) The next time you deal elemental damage with a spell, other targets in the area take 60...70% of that damage.

skills.name: Intimidating Aura
skills.description: For 60 seconds, you have +40...100 max Health and take 1...10 less damage from foes with less Health than you.
skills.conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) You have +40...100 max Health and take -1...10 damage from foes with less Health than you.

skills.name: Invoke Lightning
skills.description: Target foe and up to two other foes near your target are struck for 10...90 lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...90 lightning damage. Hits two foes near target. 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Iron Mist
skills.description: For 8...15 seconds, you have +15 armor. Your Air Magic spells that target a foe activate and recharge 33% faster, but you are Overcast by 2 points.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...15 seconds.) Gain +15 armor. Air Magic spells that target a foe activate and recharge 33% faster, but you are Overcast by 2 points.

skills.name: Iron Palm
skills.description: Target touched foe suffers 5...50 damage, and if that foe is suffering from a hex or condition that foe is knocked down. Iron Palm counts as a lead attack.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Deals 5...50 damage. Causes knock-down if target foe is hexed or has a condition. Counts as a lead attack.

skills.name: Irresistible Blow
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +5...20 damage. If Irresistible Blow is blocked, your target is knocked down and takes 5...20 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Deals 5...20 damage and causes knock-down if blocked.

skills.name: Irresistible Sweep
skills.description: Deal +3...15 damage and lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If you lose an enchantment in this way, Irresistible Sweep cannot be blocked, removes a stance, and deals +3...15 additional damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +3...15 damage. Remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: unblockable, removes a stance, deals +3...15 additional damage.

skills.name: Jagged Bones
skills.description: For 60 seconds, whenever target undead servant dies, it is replaced by a level 0...15 jagged horror that causes Bleeding with each of its attacks.
skills.conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) When target undead servant dies, it is replaced by a level 0...15 jagged horror that inflicts Bleeding with attacks.

skills.name: Jagged Strike
skills.description: If Jagged Strike hits, your target suffers from Bleeding for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Bleeding condition (5...20 seconds).

skills.name: Jaizhenju Strike
skills.description: If Jaizhenju Strike hits, you strike for +1...30 damage. If you are not using a stance, Jaizhenju Strike cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +1...30 damage. Unblockable unless you are in a stance.

skills.name: Jamei's Gaze
skills.description: Heal target other ally for 35...180 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 35...180. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Jaundiced Gaze
skills.description: Remove an enchantment from target foe. If an enchantment is removed, for the next 1...20 second[s], your next enchantment spell casts 0...1 second[s] faster and costs 1...10 less Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes an enchantment from target foe. Removal effect: your next enchantment casts 0...1 second[s] faster and costs 1...10 less Energy. (1...20 second[s])

skills.name: Judge's Insight
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, target ally's attacks deal holy damage and have +20% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) Converts target ally's attacks to holy damage and adds +20% armor penetration.

skills.name: Judge's Intervention
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next time target ally receives damage that would be fatal, the damage is negated and one nearby foe takes 30...180 holy damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Negates the next fatal damage. Negation effect: deals 30...180 holy damage to one foe near target ally.

skills.name: Judgment Strike
skills.description: Attack target and adjacent foes. Each attack that hits deals +13...30 Holy damage <sic/> and knocks down attacking foes.
skills.conciseDescription: Attacks target and adjacent foes for +13...30 Holy damage. Causes knock down on attacking foes.

skills.name: Jungle Strike
skills.description: Must follow a lead attack. If it hits, this attack strikes for +10...25 damage. If it hits a foe that was Crippled, that foe and all adjacent foes take 1...31 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...25 damage. Deals 1...31 damage to target and adjacent foes if target foe is Crippled. <gray>Must follow a lead attack.</gray>

skills.name: Karei's Healing Circle
skills.description: Heal yourself and all adjacent creatures for 30...180 points.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals you for 30...180. Also heals adjacent creatures.

skills.name: Keen Arrow
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +5...20 damage. If you land a critical hit, you deal an additional +5...25 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Deals +5...25 more damage if you land a critical hit.

skills.name: Keen Chop
skills.description: If it hits, this attack always results in a critical hit.
skills.conciseDescription: Always a critical hit.

skills.name: Keystone Signet
skills.description: All of your signets except Keystone Signet are recharged. For 20 seconds, the next 0...6 time[s] you use a signet that targets a foe, all other foes adjacent to your target take 15...60 damage and are interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) Your next 0...6 signet[s] interrupt <sic/> and deal 15...60 damage to other foes adjacent to your target. Initial Effect: <sic/> recharges all of your other signets.

skills.name: Kindle Arrows
skills.description: For 24 seconds, your arrows deal fire damage and hit for an additional 3...24 fire damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (24 seconds.) +3...24 fire damage. Your arrows deal fire damage.

skills.name: Kinetic Armor
skills.description: For 12 seconds, you gain +20...80 armor. Whenever you cast a spell, Kinetic Armor is renewed for 12 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (12 seconds.) You have +20...80 armor. Renewal bonus: cast a spell.

skills.name: Kirin's Wrath
skills.description: For 5 seconds, foes adjacent to the location in which the spell was cast take 8...32 holy damage each second.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 8...32 holy damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to your initial location.

skills.name: Kitah's Burden
skills.description: For 6...12 seconds, target foe moves 50% slower. When Kitah's Burden ends you gain 10...18 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (6...12 seconds.) Target foe moves 50% slower. End effect: you gain 10...18 Energy.

skills.name: Knee Cutter
skills.description: If this attack hits a Crippled foe, you gain 2...7 Energy and 1...3 strikes <sic/> of adrenaline.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 2...7 Energy and 1...3 adrenaline if target foe is Crippled.

skills.name: Lacerate
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. Bleeding creatures within its range suffer -2 Health degeneration. When this spirit dies, all non-spirit creatures within its range that have less than 90% Health begin Bleeding for 5...25 seconds. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). Bleeding creatures in range have -2 Health degeneration. End effect: Inflicts Bleeding condition (5...25 seconds) on creatures in range that have less than 90% health. Does not affect spirits.

skills.name: Lacerating Chop
skills.description: If Lacerating Chop hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If it strikes a knocked down foe your target suffers from Bleeding for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition (5...20 seconds) if target foe is knocked-down.

skills.name: Lamentation
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer -0...3 Health degeneration. When this hex is applied, these foes take 10...50 damage if you are within earshot of a spirit or corpse.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes near your target (5...20 seconds). Causes -0...3 Health degeneration. Initial effect: Deals 10...50 damage to these foes if you are within earshot of a spirit or corpse.

skills.name: Lava Arrows
skills.description: Lava Arrows fly toward up to 3 foes near your target and strike for 20...65 fire damage if they hit.
skills.conciseDescription: Projectile: deals 20...65 fire damage. Bonus effect: sends projectiles at 2 other foes near your target.

skills.name: Lava Font
skills.description: For 5 seconds, foes adjacent to the location where this spell was cast are struck for 5...50 fire damage each second. If you are Overcast, this spell strikes nearby foes instead of adjacent ones.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 5...50 fire damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to your initial location. If Overcast, range increased to nearby.

skills.name: Leader's Comfort
skills.description: You gain 30...75 Health. For each ally within earshot, you also gain +10...20 Health (maximum 140 Health).
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 30...75 Health. You also gain 10...20 Health (maximum 140) for each ally in earshot.

skills.name: Leader's Zeal
skills.description: For each nearby ally, you gain 2...4 Energy (maximum 8...12 Energy).
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 2...4 Energy (maximum 8...12 Energy) for each nearby ally.

skills.name: Leaping Mantis Sting
skills.description: If Mantis Sting hits, target foe takes +5...15 damage. If this attack strikes a moving foe, that foe is Crippled for 3...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...15 damage. Inflicts Crippled condition (3...15 seconds) if target foe is moving.

skills.name: Leech Signet
skills.description: Interrupt target foe's action. If that action was a spell, you gain 3...15 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: you gain 3...15 Energy if the action was a spell.

skills.name: Leviathan's Sweep
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +5...20 damage. If this attack is blocked, your target is knocked down and suffers 10...34 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Causes knock-down and deals 10...34 damage if blocked.

skills.name: Life
skills.description: Create a level 1...14 spirit. When this spirit dies, all non-spirit allies within its range are healed for 1...7 Health for each second this spirit was alive. This spirit dies after 20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...14 spirit (20 second lifespan). Affects non-spirit allies within range. End effect: heals for 1...7 for each second this spirit was alive.

skills.name: Life Attunement
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, target ally deals 30% less damage with attacks, but gains 14...50% more Health when healed.
skills.conciseDescription: Target ally gains 14...50% more Health when healed. <gray>This ally deals 30% less damage with attacks.</gray>

skills.name: Life Barrier
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, damage dealt to target other ally is reduced by 20...50%. If your Health is below 50% when that ally takes damage, Life Barrier ends.
skills.conciseDescription: Reduces damage by 20...50%. <gray>Cannot self-target. If your Health is below 50% when target takes damage, Life Barrier ends.</gray>

skills.name: Life Bond
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, whenever target other ally takes damage from an attack, half the damage is redirected to you. The damage you receive this way is reduced by 3...30.
skills.conciseDescription: Half of the damage target ally takes from attacks is redirected to you. Redirected damage is reduced by 3...30. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Life Sheath
skills.description: Remove 0...2 condition[s] from target ally. For 8 seconds, the next time that ally would take damage or life steal, that ally gains that amount of Health instead (maximum 20...100).
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) Converts the next incoming damage or life steal (maximum 20...100) to healing. Initial effect: Removes 0...2 condition[s].

skills.name: Life Siphon
skills.description: For 12...24 seconds, target foe suffers -1...3 Health degeneration, and you gain +1...3 Health regeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (12...24 seconds.) Target foe has -1...3 Health degeneration. You have +1...3 Health regeneration.

skills.name: Life Transfer
skills.description: For 6...12 seconds, target foe and adjacent foes suffer -3...8 Health degeneration, which you gain as Health regeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes adjacent to target (6...12 second). Causes -3...8 Health degeneration. You have +3...8 Health regeneration.

skills.name: Lifebane Strike
skills.description: Target foe takes 12...48 shadow damage. If that foe's Health is above 50%, you steal up to 12...48 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 12...48 damage. Steals 12...48 Health if target foe's Health is above 50%.

skills.name: Lift Enchantment
skills.description: If target touched foe is knocked down, that foe loses one enchantment.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Removes one enchantment.<gray>No <sic/> effect unless target foe is knocked-down.</gray>

skills.name: Light of Deldrimor
skills.description: All foes in the area are struck for 55...80 holy damage. The location of hidden objects are briefly indicated on your Compass. Any hidden objects in the area are revealed.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 55...80 holy damage to foes in the area. Pings hidden objects within the area on the compass.

skills.name: Light of Deliverance
skills.description: All party members are healed for 5...70 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals entire party for 5...70.

skills.name: Light of Dwayna
skills.description: Resurrect all dead party members in the area. They are returned to life with 25% Health and zero Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Resurrects all dead party members in the area. (25% Health, zero Energy).

skills.name: Lightbringer Signet
skills.description: If you are within the area of a demonic servant of Abaddon, you gain 4...5 strikes of adrenaline and 22...24 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 4...5 strikes of adrenaline and 22...24 Energy if you are within the area of a demonic servant of Abaddon.

skills.name: Lightbringer's Gaze
skills.description: Target demonic servant of Abaddon takes 100 holy damage and is interrupted. This skill strikes one additional foe in the area for each rank of Lightbringer you have attained. This skill is disabled for 15 seconds after it is used.
skills.conciseDescription: Target demonic servant of Abaddon takes 100 holy damage and is interrupted. Hits one additional foe in the area for each rank of Lightbringer you have attained. <gray>This skill is disabled (15 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Lightning Bolt
skills.description: Send out a Lightning Bolt that strikes for 5...50 lightning damage if it hits. If Lightning Bolt strikes a moving foe, that foe is struck for 5...50 additional lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: Projectile: deals 5...50 lightning damage. Deals 5...50 more lightning damage if target foe is moving. 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Lightning Hammer
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 10...100 lightning damage and applies<sic/> Cracked Armor for 5...20 seconds. Lightning Hammer has 25% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...100 lightning damage. Applies Cracked Armor (5...20 seconds). 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Lightning Javelin
skills.description: Send out a Lightning Javelin that strikes for 15...50 lightning damage if it hits. Lightning Javelin interrupts attacking foes. This spell has 25% armor penetration and strikes all foes between you and your target.
skills.conciseDescription: Projectile: Deals 15...50 lightning damage. Interrupts if your target is attacking. 25% armor penetration. Strikes all foes between you and your target.

skills.name: Lightning Orb
skills.description: Send out a Lightning Orb that strikes target foe for 10...100 lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: Projectile: deals 10...100 lightning damage. 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Lightning Reflexes
skills.description: For 5...11 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block melee and projectile attacks, and you attack 33% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) You attack 33% faster and have 75% chance to block.

skills.name: Lightning Strike
skills.description: Strike target foe for 10...60 lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration. If you are Overcast, that foe is hexed with Lightning Strike for 3 seconds. When this hex ends, that foe is struck again for 20...40 lightning damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...60 lightning damage. 25% armor penetration. Hex for 3 seconds if Overcast. End effect: deals 20...40 lightning damage.

skills.name: Lightning Surge
skills.description: After 3 seconds, target foe is knocked down and struck for 14...100 lightning damage, and has Cracked Armor for 5...20 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: (3 seconds.) End effect: deals 14...100 lightning damage, causes knock-down, and inflicts Cracked Armor (5...20 seconds). 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Lightning Touch
skills.description: Target touched foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 10...60 lightning damage, are Blinded for 1...4 second[s], and have Cracked Armor for 1...10 second[s]. This skill has 25% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Deals 10...60 lightning damage. Also hits foes adjacent to target foe. Inflicts Blind (1...4 second[s]) and Cracked Armor (1...10 second[s]) on all struck foes. 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Lingering Curse
skills.description: For 6...30 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer -1...4 Health degeneration, and gain 25% less benefit from healing.
skills.conciseDescription: (6...30 seconds.) Target and nearby foes have -1...4 Health degeneration and receive 25% less benefit from healing.

skills.name: Lion's Comfort
skills.description: All of your signets are disabled for 12 seconds. You are healed for 50...110 Health, and gain 0...3 strike[s] of adrenaline.
skills.conciseDescription: You are healed for 50...110 and gain 0...3 strike[s] of adrenaline. <gray>Disables your signets (12 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Liquid Flame
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 7...112 fire damage. If that foe is attacking or casting a spell, nearby foes are also struck for 7...112 fire damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 7...112 fire damage. Deals 7...112 fire damage to nearby foes if target was attacking or casting.

skills.name: Live Vicariously
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, whenever target ally hits a foe, you gain 2...17 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 2...17 Health whenever target ally hits a foe.

skills.name: Lively Was Naomei
skills.description: Hold Naomei's ashes for up to 45 seconds. When you drop her ashes, all party members in the area are resurrected with 15...75% Health and zero Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (45 seconds.) Drop effect: resurrects party members in the area (15...75% Health and zero Energy).

skills.name: Locust's Fury
skills.description: For 10...35 seconds, you have an additional 50% chance to double strike while using daggers.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) You have +50% chance to double strike. <gray>No effect unless you are wielding daggers.</gray>

skills.name: Lotus Strike
skills.description: Must follow a lead attack. If it hits, this attack strikes for +10...25 damage and you gain 5...20 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...25 damage; you gain 5...20 Energy. <gray>Must follow a lead attack.</gray>

skills.name: Low Blow
skills.description: Strike target foe for 45...70 damage. If target foe is knocked down, that foe takes an additional 30...50 damage and suffers from Cracked Armor for 14...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Deals 45...70 damage. Inflicts 30...50 damage and Cracked Armor (14...20 seconds) if target foe is knocked down.

skills.name: Lyric of Purification
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses a Signet, that ally loses 1 Condition.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Allies in earshot lose one condition with their next signet.

skills.name: Lyric of Zeal
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses a signet, that ally gains 1...8 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot gain 1...8 Energy with their next signet.

skills.name: Lyssa's Assault
skills.description: This attack interrupts an action if it hits. If you are enchanted, any skill you interrupt is disabled for additional 1...10 second[s]. This attack does 50% normal damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts an action. If you are enchanted, the interrupted skill is disabled for an additional 1...10 second[s]. This attack does 50% of normal damage.

skills.name: Lyssa's Aura
skills.description: For 10 seconds, you have +0...5 Energy regeneration. This enchantment reapplies itself every time you cast a spell on a foe.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) You have +0...5 Energy regeneration. Renewal: every time you cast a spell on an enemy.

skills.name: Lyssa's Balance
skills.description: Target foe loses one Enchantment. If you have more Enchantments than target foe, this skill has no effect.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes one enchantment from target foe. <gray>No effect if you have more enchantments than this foe.</gray>

skills.name: Lyssa's Haste
skills.description: For 3...15 seconds, your Dervish enchantments recharge 33% faster. When you activate this enchantment, all adjacent foes are interrupted. When this enchantment ends, all adjacent foes are interrupted. 50% failure chance unless Wind Prayers 5 or higher.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...15 seconds.) Your Dervish enchantments recharge 33% faster. Initial Effect: interrupts all adjacent foes. End Effect: interrupts all adjacent foes. <gray>50% failure chance unless Wind Prayers 5 or higher.</gray>

skills.name: Maelstrom
skills.description: Create a Maelstrom at target foe's location. For 10 seconds, foes adjacent to that area are struck for 10...25 cold damage each second. Maelstrom interrupts spell-casting when it hits.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...25 cold damage and interrupts spells each second (10 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target's initial location.

skills.name: Magebane Shot
skills.description: If this attack hits, it interrupts target foe's action. If that action was a spell, it is disabled for an additional 10 seconds. This attack cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: an interrupted spell is disabled for +10 seconds. Unblockable.

skills.name: Magehunter Strike
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +7...25 damage. If your target is under the effects of an enchantment, this attack cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +7...25 damage. Unblockable if target foe is enchanted.

skills.name: Magehunter's Smash
skills.description: If this attack hits, target foe is knocked down. If your target is under the effects of an enchantment, this attack cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: Causes knock-down. Unblockable if target foe is enchanted.

skills.name: Magnetic Aura
skills.description: For 1...8 second[s], you block the next attack against you and deal 10...50 damage to your attacker. If you are Overcast, all party members in earshot are also enchanted.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...8 second[s].) Block the next attack against you and reflect 10...50 damage to the attacker. If you are Overcast, enchant party members in earshot.

skills.name: Magnetic Surge
skills.description: Target foe takes 15...75 damage. If you are Overcast, Magnetic Surge enchants all allies in earshot for 1...5 second[s] to block the next attack against them.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 15...75 damage. If you are Overcast, allies in earshot are enchanted for 1...5 <sic/> and block the next attack against them.

skills.name: Maiming Spear
skills.description: If your attack hits a Bleeding foe, that foe is Crippled for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Crippled condition (5...20 seconds) if target foe is Bleeding.

skills.name: Maiming Strike
skills.description: Your animal companion attempts a Maiming Strike that deals +5...20 damage. If that attack hits<sic/> that foe becomes Crippled for 3...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Inflicts Crippled condition (3...15 seconds) on hit.

skills.name: Malaise
skills.description: For 5...35 seconds, target foe suffers -1 Energy degeneration and you suffer -1 Health degeneration. If target foe's Energy reaches 0, that foe takes 5...50 damage and Malaise ends.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...35 seconds.) Causes -1 Energy degeneration. Deals 5...50 damage if target foe's Energy drops to 0. <gray>You have -1 Health degeneration. Ends if this foe's Energy drops to 0.</gray>

skills.name: Malicious Strike
skills.description: If this attack hits a foe suffering from a condition, you deal +10...30 damage and this attack results in a critical hit.
skills.conciseDescription: If target foe has a condition, this attack deals +10...30 damage and is a critical hit.

skills.name: Malign Intervention
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, target foe receives 20% less benefit from healing. If target foe dies while hexed with Malign Intervention, a level 1...17 masterless bone horror is summoned.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Target foe receives 20% less from healing. If this foe dies while suffering from this hex, a level 1...17 masterless bone horror is summoned.

skills.name: Mantis Touch
skills.description: Target foe becomes Crippled for 5...20 seconds. This skill counts as an off-hand attack.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Crippled condition (5...20 seconds). This skill counts as an off-hand attack.

skills.name: Mantra of Concentration
skills.description: For 1...38 seconds, the next time you would be interrupted, you are not interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...38 seconds.) The next time you would be interrupted, you are not interrupted.

skills.name: Mantra of Earth
skills.description: For 30...90 seconds, whenever you take earth damage, the damage is reduced by 26...50% and you gain 2 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (30...90 seconds.) Reduces earth damage you take by 26...50%. You gain 2 Energy when you take earth damage.

skills.name: Mantra of Flame
skills.description: For 30...90 seconds, whenever you take fire damage, the damage is reduced by 26...50% and you gain 2 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (30...90 seconds.) Reduces fire damage you take by 26...50%. You gain 2 Energy when you take fire damage.

skills.name: Mantra of Frost
skills.description: For 30...90 seconds, whenever you take cold damage, the damage is reduced by 26...50% and you gain 2 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (30...90 seconds.) Reduces cold damage you take by 26...50%. You gain 2 Energy when you take cold damage.

skills.name: Mantra of Inscriptions
skills.description: For 5...25 seconds, signets you successfully activate while in this stance recharge 10...40% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...25 seconds.) Signets you successfully activate while in this stance recharge 10...40% faster.

skills.name: Mantra of Lightning
skills.description: For 30...90 seconds, whenever you take lightning damage, the damage is reduced by 26...50% and you gain 2 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (30...90 seconds.) Reduces lightning damage you take by 26...50%. You gain 2 Energy when you take lightning damage.

skills.name: Mantra of Persistence
skills.description: For 5...25 seconds, any Illusion Magic hex you cast lasts 10...40% longer.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...25 seconds.) Illusion hexes you cast last 10...40% longer.

skills.name: Mantra of Recall
skills.description: For 20 seconds, you gain no benefit from it. You gain 10...25 Energy when Mantra of Recall ends.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) End effect: you gain 10...25 Energy.

skills.name: Mantra of Recovery
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, spells you cast recharge 33% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Your spells recharge 33% faster.

skills.name: Mantra of Resolve
skills.description: For 30...90 seconds, you cannot be interrupted, but each time you would have been interrupted, you lose 10...4 Energy or Mantra of Resolve ends.
skills.conciseDescription: (30...90 seconds.) Prevents interrupts against you. <gray>Prevention cost: lose 10...4 Energy or Mantra of Resolve ends.</gray>

skills.name: Mantra of Signets
skills.description: For 10...40 seconds, you have +3 armor for each signet you have equipped. Whenever you use a signet, you gain 5...60 health.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...40 seconds.) You have +3 armor for each signet. You gain 5...60 health each time you use a signet.

skills.name: Marauder's Shot
skills.description: If Marauder's Shot hits, you strike for +25...55 damage and all your non-attack skills are disabled for 5 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +25...55 damage. <gray>Your non-attack skills are disabled (5 seconds) if this attack hits.</gray>

skills.name: Mark of Death
skills.description: For 4...10 seconds, target foe gains 50% less benefit from healing.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...10 seconds.) Target foe receives 50% less from healing.

skills.name: Mark of Fury
skills.description: For 5 seconds, allies hitting target foe gain 0...2 strike[s] of adrenaline. When this hex ends, that foe suffers from Cracked Armor for 1...15 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: (5 seconds.) Allies hitting target foe gain 0...2 strike[s] of adrenaline. End effect: inflicts Cracked Armor (1...15 second[s].)

skills.name: Mark of Insecurity
skills.description: For 5...25 seconds, target foe suffers from -1...5 Health degeneration, and enchantments and stances on target foe expire 20...60% faster. All of your non-Assassin skills are disabled for 5 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...25 seconds.) Causes -1...5 Health degeneration. Enchantments and stances expire 20...60% faster on target foe. <gray>Disables your non-Assassin skills (5 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Mark of Instability
skills.description: For 20 seconds, the next time you hit target foe with a dual attack skill that foe is knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) Causes knock-down the next time you hit target foe with a dual attack.

skills.name: Mark of Pain
skills.description: For 30 seconds, whenever target foe takes physical damage, Mark of Pain deals 10...40 shadow damage to adjacent foes.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Deals 10...40 damage to adjacent foes whenever target foe takes physical damage.

skills.name: Mark of Protection
skills.description: For 10 seconds, whenever target ally would take damage, that ally is healed for that amount instead, maximum 6...60. All your Protection Prayers are disabled for 5 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Converts incoming damage to healing (maximum 6...60). <gray>All your Protection Prayers are disabled (5 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Mark of Rodgort
skills.description: Target foe and all nearby foes are hexed with Mark of Rodgort. For 10...35 seconds, whenever each foe is struck for fire damage, that foe is set on fire for 1...4 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes near your target (10...35 seconds). Inflicts Burning condition (1...4 second[s]) when these foes take fire damage.

skills.name: Mark of Subversion
skills.description: For 6 seconds, the next time target foe casts a spell that targets an ally of that foe, the spell fails and you steal up to 10...92 Health from that foe.
skills.conciseDescription: (6 seconds.) Target foe's next spell fails and you steal 10...92 Health. <gray>No effect unless this foe's spell targeted one of its allies.</gray>

skills.name: Marksman's Wager
skills.description: For 18 seconds, you gain 5...10 Energy whenever your arrows hit, but lose 10 Energy whenever your arrows fail to strike.
skills.conciseDescription: (18 seconds.) Gain 5...10 Energy whenever your arrows hit. <gray>Lose 10 Energy whenever your arrows fail to hit.</gray>

skills.name: Martyr
skills.description: Transfer all conditions and their remaining durations from your allies to you.
skills.conciseDescription: Transfer all conditions from all allies to you.

skills.name: Masochism
skills.description: For 10...40 seconds, you have +2 to your Death Magic and Soul Reaping attributes and sacrifice 5...3% of your maximum Health when you cast a spell.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...40 seconds.) You have +2 Death Magic and Soul Reaping. Sacrifice 5...3% Health when you cast a spell.

skills.name: Master of Magic
skills.description: For 1...61 second[s], all of your elemental attributes are set to 8...14 and your elemental spells return 1 Energy plus 30% of their Energy cost.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...61 second[s]). Your elemental attributes are set to 8...14 and elemental spells return 1 Energy plus 30% of their Energy cost.

skills.name: Meditation
skills.description: Lose all adrenaline. For 20 seconds, you gain 1...4 Energy every time an enchantment on you ends.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) <gray>Lose all adrenaline.</gray> Gain 1...4 Energy whenever an enchantment on you ends.

skills.name: Meekness
skills.description: For 5...30 seconds, target foe and all foes in the area attack 50% slower.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes in the area of target (5...30 seconds). These foes attack 50% slower.

skills.name: Melandru's Arrows
skills.description: For 18 seconds, whenever your arrows hit, they cause Bleeding for 3...25 seconds, and if they hit a target who is under an enchantment, they do +8...28 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (18 seconds.) Your arrows inflict Bleeding condition (3...25 seconds) and deal +8...28 damage to enchanted foes.

skills.name: Melandru's Assault
skills.description: Your animal companion attempts a Melandru's Assault that deals +5...20 damage to all nearby foes.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage to nearby foes.

skills.name: Melandru's Resilience
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, you gain +4 Health regeneration and +1 Energy regeneration for each condition and hex you are suffering.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) You have +4 Health regeneration and +1 Energy regeneration for each condition and hex on you.

skills.name: Melandru's Shot
skills.description: If Melandru's Shot hits, your target begins Bleeding for 5...25 seconds. If it hits a foe that is moving or knocked down, that foe takes +10...25 damage and is Crippled for 5...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Bleeding (5...25 seconds). Deals +10...25 damage and inflicts Crippled (5...15 seconds) if target foe was moving or knocked down.

skills.name: Mend Ailment
skills.description: Remove one condition (Poison, Disease, Blindness, Dazed, Bleeding, Crippled, Burning, Weakness, Cracked Armor, or Deep Wound) from target ally. For each remaining Condition, that ally is healed for 5...70 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes a condition. Removal effect: heals for 5...70 for each remaining condition.

skills.name: Mend Body and Soul
skills.description: Target ally is healed for 20...115 Health. That ally loses one condition for each spirit within earshot.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 20...115. Removes one condition for each spirit within earshot.

skills.name: Mend Condition
skills.description: Remove one condition (Poison, Disease, Blindness, Dazed, Bleeding, Crippled, Burning, Weakness, Cracked Armor, or Deep Wound) from target other ally. If a condition is removed, that ally is healed for 5...70 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes one condition. Removal effect: heals for 5...70. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Mending
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, target ally gains +1...4 Health regeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: +1...4 Health regeneration.

skills.name: Mending Grip
skills.description: Target ally is healed for 30...90 Health. If that ally is under the effects of a weapon spell, that ally loses one condition.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 30...90. Removes one condition if target ally is under a Weapon <sic/> spell.

skills.name: Mending Refrain
skills.description: For 15 seconds, target non-spirit ally has +2...3 Health regeneration. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on that ally.
skills.conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) Target ally has +2...3 Health regeneration. Renewal: whenever a chant or shout ends on that ally. <gray>Cannot target spirits.</gray>

skills.name: Mending Touch
skills.description: Touched ally loses two conditions and is healed for 15...60 Health for each condition removed in this way.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Spell. Removes two conditions. Heals for 15...60 for each condition removed.

skills.name: Mental Block
skills.description: For 5...11 seconds you have a 50% chance to block attacks. This Enchantment is reapplied every time an enemy strikes you.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) You have a 50% chance to block. Renewal: every time an enemy hits you.

skills.name: Merciless Spear
skills.description: If this attack hits a foe with less than 50% Health, that foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds). <gray>No effect unless target has less than 50% Health.</gray>

skills.name: Meteor
skills.description: Target foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 7...112 fire damage and knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 7...112 fire damage and causes knock-down. Also hits foes adjacent to target foe.

skills.name: Meteor Shower
skills.description: Create a Meteor Shower at target foe's location. For 9 seconds, foes adjacent to that location are struck for 7...112 fire damage and knocked down every 3 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 7...112 fire damage and causes knock-down every 3 seconds (9 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target's initial location.

skills.name: Mighty Blow
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +10...40 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage.

skills.name: Mighty Throw
skills.description: Your spear moves three times faster. If it hits, you deal +10...40 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage. This spear moves three times faster.

skills.name: Mighty Was Vorizun
skills.description: Hold Vorizun's ashes for up to 15...60 seconds. While you hold his ashes, you gain +15 armor and +30 maximum Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (15...60 seconds.) You have +15 armor and +30 maximum Energy.

skills.name: Migraine
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, target foe suffers -1...8 Health degeneration and takes 100% longer to activate skills.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Causes -1...8 Health degeneration and doubles skill activation time.

skills.name: Mind Blast
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 15...60 fire damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, you gain 1...8 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 15...60 fire damage. You gain 1...8 Energy if you have more Energy than target foe.

skills.name: Mind Burn
skills.description: Target foe and all adjacent foes take 15...60 fire damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, that foe and all adjacent foes take an additional 15...60 fire damage and are set on fire for 1...10 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 15...60 fire damage. If you have more energy than target foe, deals 15...60 more fire damage and inflicts Burning (1...10 second[s]). Also hits adjacent foes.

skills.name: Mind Freeze
skills.description: Target foe takes 10...60 cold damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, that foe suffers an additional 10...60 cold damage and moves 90% slower for 1...5 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...60 cold damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, deals +10...60 cold damage and causes 90% slower movement (1...5 second[s]).

skills.name: Mind Shock
skills.description: Target foe suffers 10...50 lightning damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, that foe suffers 10...50 more lightning damage and is knocked down. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...50 lightning damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, deals +10...50 lightning damage and causes knockdown. 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Mind Wrack
skills.description: For 5...40 seconds, whenever this foe is the target of any of your non-hex Mesmer skills, that foe loses 1 Energy and takes 5...25 damage per point of Energy lost. If the target foe's Energy drops to 0, Mind Wrack ends and that foe takes 15...100 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...40 seconds.) Causes 1 Energy loss each time foe is the target of your non-hex Mesmer skills. Deals 5...25 damage per point of Energy lost. If target foe's Energy drops to 0, it takes 15...100 damage and Mind Wrack ends.

skills.name: Mindbender
skills.description: For 10...16 seconds, you move 20...33% faster and your Spells take 20% less time to cast.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...16 seconds.) You move 20...33% faster and cast Spells 20% faster.

skills.name: Mirage Cloak
skills.description: For 20 second[s], you have a 40% chance to block and an extra 4...10% for each additional enchantment (max 80%). All nearby foes are struck for 10...40 earth damage each time a Dervish enchantment is removed from you.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 second[s].) 40% chance to block and an extra 4...10% for each additional enchantment. 10...40 earth damage to nearby foes when you lose a Dervish enchantment.

skills.name: Mirror of Disenchantment
skills.description: Remove one enchantment from target foe. All of that foe's party members also lose that same enchantment.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes one enchantment from target foe. That foe's party members also lose this enchantment.

skills.name: Mirror of Ice
skills.description: Shatter a Mirror of Ice. All foes near you and target ally take 15...70 cold damage and move 66% slower for 2...6 seconds. If you strike a foe hexed with Water Magic, Mirror of Ice recharges 50% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 15...70 cold damage and slows foes by 66% (2...6 seconds). Hits foes near you and target ally. Recharges 50% faster if it hits a foe hexed with Water Magic.

skills.name: Mirrored Stance
skills.description: For 10...35 seconds, whenever target foe enters a stance, you enter the same stance.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) You enter any stance used by target foe.

skills.name: Mist Form
skills.description: For 10...45 seconds, you take 33% less damage from foes under the effects of Water Magic hexes. Whenever you cast an elemental spell, all non-spirit allies in earshot are healed for 50...250% of the Energy cost of the spell.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...45 seconds.) Take 33% less damage from foes hexed with Water Magic. Heals non-spirit allies in earshot for 50...250% of the energy cost of your elemental spells.

skills.name: Mistrust
skills.description: For 6 seconds, the next spell that target foe casts on one of your allies fails and deals 10...80 damage to that foe and 75% of that damage to all nearby foes.
skills.conciseDescription: (6 seconds.) The next spell that target foe casts on one of your allies fails and deals 10...80 damage to target and 75% of that damage to nearby foes.

skills.name: Moebius Strike
skills.description: Must follow a Dual Attack. If it hits, Moebius Strike strikes for +10...35 damage. If you strike a foe whose Health is below 50%, all your other attack skills are recharged.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...35 damage. Recharges all your other attack skills if target foe's Health is below 50%. <gray>Must follow a dual attack.</gray>

skills.name: Mokele Smash
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +5...20 damage and gain 2 strikes of adrenaline.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage and you gain 2 strikes of adrenaline.

skills.name: Muddy Terrain
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within its range move 10% slower and speed boosts have no effect. This spirit dies after 30...180 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...180 second lifespan). Creatures in range have 10% slower movement: also negates speed boosts. <gray>Does not affect spirits.</gray>

skills.name: Mystic Corruption
skills.description: All adjacent foes suffer from Disease for 1...10 second[s]. For 20 seconds, nothing happens. Disease duration is doubled if you are enchanted when you activate this skill. When this enchantment ends, all party members in earshot are cured of Disease.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) Initial Effect: all adjacent foes are Diseased (1...10 second[s].) Double duration if you are already enchanted. End Effect: party members in earshot lose Disease.

skills.name: Mystic Healing
skills.description: You are healed for 5...65 Health. Also heals all enchanted party members for 5...65 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals you for 5...65. Heals all enchanted party members for 5...65 Health.

skills.name: Mystic Regeneration
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, you have +1...4 Health regeneration for each enchantment (maximum of 8) on you.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) You have +1...4 Health regeneration for each enchantment (maximum of 8) on you.

skills.name: Mystic Sandstorm
skills.description: Create a sandstorm at your location that lasts 3 seconds. Each second, foes nearby this location take 10...40 earth damage. Attacking foes take an additional 10...20 damage. If you are enchanted when you cast this spell, it lasts twice as long.
skills.conciseDescription: (3 seconds.) Deals 10...40 earth damage each second. Deals an additional 10...20 damage to attacking foes. Hits foes nearby your initial location. Lasts twice as long if you are enchanted.

skills.name: Mystic Sweep
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +3...12 damage. If you are enchanted, this attack deals an additional +3...12 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +3...12 damage. Deals an additional +3...12 damage if you are enchanted.

skills.name: Mystic Twister
skills.description: Deals 10...60 cold damage to all nearby foes. If you are enchanted, this spell deals an additional 10...60 cold damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...60 cold damage to all nearby foes. Deals 10...60 more cold damage if you are enchanted.

skills.name: Mystic Vigor
skills.description: For 20 seconds, every time you successfully hit with an attack, you gain 3...15 Health for each enchantment on you (maximum 25 Health).
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) You gain 3...15 Health (maximum 25) for each enchantment on you whenever you hit with an attack.

skills.name: Natural Healing
skills.description: You are healed for 50...170 Health. If you are not enchanted, this spell activates 50% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals you for 50...170. This skill activates 50% faster if you are not enchanted.

skills.name: Natural Stride
skills.description: For 1...8 second[s], you run 33% faster and have a 50% chance to block incoming attacks. Natural Stride ends if you become hexed or enchanted.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...8 second[s].) You move 33% faster and have 50% chance to block. <gray>Ends if you become hexed or enchanted.</gray>

skills.name: Natural Temper
