skills.description: For 4...15 seconds, you gain 33% more adrenaline while not under the effects of an Enchantment.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...15 seconds.) You gain 33% more adrenaline. <gray>No effect if you are enchanted.</gray>

skills.name: Nature's Renewal
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. For 30...240 seconds, enchantments and hexes cast by non-spirit creatures in range take twice as long to cast, and it costs twice as much Energy to maintain enchantments. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). For creatures in range, enchantments and Hexes <sic/> take twice as long to cast and it costs twice as much Energy to maintain enchantments. Does not affect spirits.

skills.name: Necrosis
skills.description: If target foe is suffering from a condition or hex, that foe suffers 60...90 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 60...90 damage if target foe has a condition or hex.

skills.name: Necrotic Traversal
skills.description: Exploit a random corpse or sacrifice 30...20% health to teleport to target foe's location. You become Diseased for 6 seconds and all nearby foes become Poisoned for 5...20 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Exploit a random corpse or sacrifice 30...20% health to teleport to target foe's location. You become Diseased for 6 seconds and all nearby foes become Poisoned for 5...20 second[s].

skills.name: Needling Shot
skills.description: Needling Shot strikes for only 10...30 damage and moves faster than normal. If Needling Shot strikes a foe below 50% Health, Needling Shot recharges instantly. Your other attack skills are disabled for 2 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Fast-moving arrow. Deals 10...30 damage. Recharges instantly if target foe is below 50% Health. <gray>Your other attack skills are disabled (2 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Never Rampage Alone
skills.description: For 18...25 seconds, you and your pet attack 25% faster and have +1...3 Health regeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (18...25 seconds.) You and your pet attack 25% faster and have +1...3 Health regeneration.

skills.name: Nightmare Weapon
skills.description: For 12 seconds, target ally has a Nightmare Weapon. Target ally's next 3 attacks are reduced by 10...50 damage and steal up to 10...50 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (12 seconds.) Target ally's attacks steal 10...50 Health but deal 10...50 less damage. <gray>Ends after 3 attacks.</gray>

skills.name: Nine Tail Strike
skills.description: Must follow an off-hand attack. Nine Tail Strike cannot be blocked and strikes for +15...40 damage if it hits.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +15...40 damage. Unblockable. <gray>Must follow an off-hand attack.</gray>

skills.name: Oath Shot
skills.description: If Oath Shot hits, all of your skills except Oath Shot are recharged. If it misses, all of your skills are disabled for 10...4 seconds. (50% miss chance with Expertise 7 or less.)
skills.conciseDescription: Recharges all skills except Oath Shot if it hits. <gray>Disables all skills if it misses (10...4 seconds). 50% miss chance unless Expertise 8 or higher.</gray>

skills.name: Obsidian Flame
skills.description: Deal 22...112 damage to target foe. This spell ignores armor.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 22...112 damage.

skills.name: Obsidian Flesh
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, you gain +20 armor and cannot be the target of enemy spells, but cannot attack and have -2 energy degeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) You have +20 armor and enemy spells cannot target you. <gray>You cannot attack and have -2 energy degeneration.</gray>

skills.name: Offering of Blood
skills.description: You gain 8...20 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 8...20 Energy.

skills.name: Offering of Spirit
skills.description: Gain 8...17 Energy. If any spirits are within earshot, you do not sacrifice Health.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 8...17 Energy. You do not sacrifice Health if any spirits are within earshot.

skills.name: Onslaught
skills.description: For 3...15 seconds, you attack, move and gain adrenaline 25% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...15 seconds.) You attack, move and gain adrenaline 25% faster.

skills.name: Oppressive Gaze
skills.description: Target foe and adjacent foes take 10...30 shadow damage. Foes already suffering from a condition are Poisoned and Weakened for 3...12 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...30 damage to target and adjacent foes. Inflicts Poison and Weakness (3...12 second) on foes suffering from a condition.

skills.name: Order of Apostasy
skills.description: For 5 seconds, whenever a party member hits a foe with physical damage, that foe loses one enchantment. For each Monk enchantment removed, you lose 10...3% maximum Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Enchants all party members (5 seconds). These party members remove one enchantment when they deal physical damage. <gray>Removal cost: for each Monk enchantment, you lose 10...3% maximum Health.</gray>

skills.name: Order of Pain
skills.description: For 5 seconds, whenever a party member hits a foe with physical damage, that party member does +3...16 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Enchants all party members (5 seconds). 3...16 more damage whenever these party members hit with physical damage.

skills.name: Order of the Vampire
skills.description: For 5 seconds, whenever a party member who is not under the effects of another Necromancer enchantment hits a foe with physical damage, that party member steals up to 3...16 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Enchants all party members (5 seconds.) These party members steal 3...16 Health with each physical damage attack. <gray>Party members under another Necromancer enchantment are not affected.</gray>

skills.name: Order of Undeath
skills.description: For 5 seconds, your minions deal +3...16 damage, but you lose 2% of your maximum Health whenever one of your minions hits with an attack.
skills.conciseDescription: (5 seconds.) Your undead servants deal +3...16 damage. <gray>You lose 2% of your maximum Health whenever your servants hit.</gray>

skills.name: Orison of Healing
skills.description: Heal target ally for 30...80 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 30...80.

skills.name: Otyugh's Cry
skills.description: For 10...25 seconds, your animal companion gains +24 armor and cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...25 seconds.) Your pet has +24 armor and is unblockable.

skills.name: Over the Limit
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, your spells cast 20...50% faster, and recharge 40...80% faster, but you continuously gain Overcast.
skills.conciseDescription: Spells cast 20...50% faster and recharge 40...80% faster. Continuously gain Overcast while active.

skills.name: Overbearing Smash
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +1...20 damage. If target foe is knocked down, that foe is Dazed for 1...8 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +1...20 damage. If target foe is knocked down, they are Dazed (1...8 second[s]).

skills.name: Overload
skills.description: For 5 seconds, target foe suffers -1...3 Health degeneration. If target foe is using a skill, then Overload deals 15...75 damage to that foe and 75% of that damage to all adjacent foes.
skills.conciseDescription: (5 seconds.) Causes -1...3 Health degeneration. If target foe is using a skill, that foe takes 15...75 damage and all adjacent foes take 75% of that damage.

skills.name: Pacifism
skills.description: For 4...8 seconds, target foe cannot attack. This effect ends if the target takes damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...8 seconds.) Target foe cannot attack. <gray>Ends if this foe takes damage.</gray>

skills.name: Pain
skills.description: Create a level 1...12 spirit. This spirit's attacks deal 5...30 damage. This spirit dies after 30...150 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...12 spirit (30...150 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5...30 damage.

skills.name: Pain Inverter
skills.description: For 6...10 seconds, every time target foe deals damage that foe takes 100...140% of the damage it causes (maximum 80 damage).
skills.conciseDescription: (6...10 seconds.) Deals 100...140% of the damage (maximum 80) back to target foe every time it does damage.

skills.name: Pain of Disenchantment
skills.description: Target foe loses 1...3 enchantment[s]. If an enchantment was lost in this way, that foe and all adjacent foes lose 10...100 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Target foe loses 1...3 enchantment[s]. Removal effect: that foe and all adjacent foes lose 10...100 Health.

skills.name: Painful Bond
skills.description: For 10...20 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes are hexed with Painful Bond and take 8...20 damage whenever hit by a spirit's attack.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes near your target (10...20 seconds). Spirits do 8...20 more damage against these foes.

skills.name: Palm Strike
skills.description: Target touched foe takes 10...65 damage and is Crippled for 1...5 second[s]. This skill counts as an off-hand attack.
skills.conciseDescription: Elite Touch Skill. Deals 10...65 damage and inflicts Crippled condition (1...5 second[s]). This skill counts as an off-hand attack.

skills.name: Panic
skills.description: For 1...10 second[s], target foe and all nearby foes are hexed with Panic. When a foe hexed with Panic successfully uses a skill, all other nearby foes are interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes near your target (1...10 second[s]). Interrupts all other nearby foes whenever a hexed foe successfully activates a skill.

skills.name: Parasitic Bond
skills.description: For 20 seconds, target foe suffers -1 Health degeneration. The caster is healed for 30...120 when Parasitic Bond ends.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) Causes -1 Health degeneration. End effect: you are healed for 30...120 Health.

skills.name: Patient Spirit
skills.description: For 2 seconds, target ally is enchanted with Patient Spirit. Unless this enchantment ends prematurely, that ally is healed for 30...120 Health when the enchantment ends.
skills.conciseDescription: (2 seconds.) End effect: heals for 30...120. <gray>No effect if ends early.</gray>

skills.name: Peace and Harmony
skills.description: Target ally loses 0...9 condition[s] and hex[es]. For 1...3 second[s], conditions and hexes expire 90% faster on that ally. All your Smiting Prayers are disabled for 20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Target ally loses 0...9 condition[s] and hex[es]. Conditions and hexes expire 90% faster on that ally (1...3 second[s]). <gray>Disables your Smiting Prayers (20 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Penetrating Attack
skills.description: If Penetrating Attack hits, you strike for +5...25 damage and this attack has 10% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...25 damage. 10% armor penetration.

skills.name: Penetrating Blow
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +10...25 damage. This axe attack has 20% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...25 damage. 20% armor penetration.

skills.name: Penetrating Chop
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +10...25 damage. This axe attack has 20% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...25 damage. 20% armor penetration.

skills.name: Pensive Guardian
skills.description: For 5...11 seconds, target ally has a 50% chance to block attacks from enchanted foes.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) 50% chance to block enchanted foes.

skills.name: Persistence of Memory
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, whenever a spell you cast is interrupted, that spell is instantly recharged.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Your interrupted spells recharge instantly.

skills.name: Pestilence
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. When any creature within its range dies, conditions on that creature spread to any creature in the area already suffering from a condition. This spirit dies after 30...180 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...180 second lifespan). When any creature in range dies, conditions on this creature spread to any creature in the area with a condition. Spirits are not affected.

skills.name: Phantom Pain
skills.description: For 10 seconds, target foe suffers -1...4 Health degeneration. When Phantom Pain ends, that foe suffers a Deep Wound, lowering that foe's maximum Health by 20% for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Causes -1...4 Health degeneration. End effect: inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds).

skills.name: Phoenix
skills.description: A fiery Phoenix rises at your location and flies out to your target, exploding on impact. This explosion strikes your target and nearby foes for 10...60 fire damage. If you are Overcast, allies in the blast radius are healed for 20...80 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Projectile: deals 10...60 fire damage to target and nearby foes. Heals allies for 20...80 if you are Overcast.

skills.name: Physical Resistance
skills.description: For 30...90 seconds, You gain +40 armor against physical damage, but you lose 24...12 armor against elemental damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (30...90 seconds.) You have +40 armor against physical damage. <gray>You have -24...12 armor against elemental damage.</gray>

skills.name: Piercing Trap
skills.description: When Piercing Trap is triggered, all nearby foes are struck for 5...50 piercing damage. Any foes with Cracked Armor are struck for an additional 15...60 damage. Piercing Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals 5...50 piercing damage. Deals 15...60 more damage to any foes with Cracked Armor. <gray>Easily interrupted.</gray>

skills.name: Pin Down
skills.description: If Pin Down hits, your target is Crippled for 3...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Crippled condition (3...15 seconds).

skills.name: Pious Assault
skills.description: If it hits, this attack deals +10...20 damage and removes 1 Dervish enchantment. If a Dervish enchantment was removed, this skill recharges 75% faster and adjacent foes take 15...40 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...20 damage. Removes 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal Effect: this skill recharges 75% faster and adjacent foes take 15...40 damage.

skills.name: Pious Concentration
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, you cannot be interrupted, but each time you would have been interrupted, you lose 1 Dervish enchantment or Pious Concentration ends.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Prevents interrupts. <gray>Prevention cost: you lose one Dervish enchantment or Pious Concentration ends.</gray>

skills.name: Pious Fury
skills.description: Remove 1 Dervish enchantment. For 1...7 second[s], you attack 25% faster. If an enchantment was removed, this stance lasts twice as long.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...7 second[s].)You <sic/> attack 25% faster and remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: this stance lasts twice as long.

skills.name: Pious Haste
skills.description: You remove 1 Dervish enchantment and for 1...7 second[s] you move 25% faster. If an enchantment was removed you move 50% faster instead.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...7 second[s].) Lose 1 Dervish enchantment and move 25% faster. Removal Effect: Run 50% faster instead.

skills.name: Pious Renewal
skills.description: For 8 seconds, nothing happens. When this enchantment ends, Pious Renewal is recharged and you gain 0...5 Energy and 0...30 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) End Effect: recharges itself and you gain 0...5 Energy and 0...30 Health.

skills.name: Pious Restoration
skills.description: You gain 80...150 Health and remove 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed in this way, you also lose 1...3 hex[es].
skills.conciseDescription: Gain 80...150 Health and remove 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal effect: lose 1...3 hex[es].

skills.name: Plague Sending
skills.description: Transfer 1...3 negative condition[s] and [its/their] remaining duration[s] from yourself to target foe and all adjacent foes.
skills.conciseDescription: Transfer 1...3 condition[s] and [its/their] remaining duration[s] from yourself to target foe and all adjacent foes.

skills.name: Plague Signet
skills.description: Transfer all negative conditions with 100...200% of their remaining durations from yourself to target foe. (50% failure chance with Curses 4 or less.)
skills.conciseDescription: Transfers all conditions with 100...200% of their remaining durations from yourself to target foe. <gray>50% failure chance unless Curses 5 or more.</gray>

skills.name: Plague Touch
skills.description: Transfer 1...3 negative condition[s] and [its/their] remaining duration[s] from yourself to target touched foe.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Transfers 1...3 condition[s] from yourself to target foe.

skills.name: Point Blank Shot
skills.description: Shoot an arrow that has half the normal range, but strikes for +10...40 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Half Range Bow Attack. Deals +10...40 damage.

skills.name: Poison Arrow
skills.description: If Poison Arrow hits, your target becomes Poisoned for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Poisoned condition. (5...20)

skills.name: Poison Tip Signet
skills.description: For 60 seconds, your next attack also inflicts Poison for 8...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) Inflicts Poisoned condition (8...15 seconds) with your next attack.

skills.name: Poisoned Heart
skills.description: You and all adjacent foes are Poisoned for 5...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Poisoned condition (5...15 seconds) to adjacent foes. <gray>You are also Poisoned.</gray>

skills.name: Poisonous Bite
skills.description: Your animal companion attempts a Poisonous Bite that Poisons target foe for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Poisoned condition (5...20 seconds).

skills.name: Pounce
skills.description: Your animal companion's next attack is a Pounce that deals +5...20 damage. If the attack strikes a moving foe, that foe is knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Causes knock-down if target foe is moving.

skills.name: Power Attack
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +10...40 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage.

skills.name: Power Block
skills.description: If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill and all skills of the same attribute are disabled for 1...12 seconds and that skill is interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill and all skills of the same attribute are disabled (1...12 seconds) and that skill is interrupted.

skills.name: Power Drain
skills.description: If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill is interrupted and you gain 1...31 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: you gain 1...31 Energy.

skills.name: Power Flux
skills.description: If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill is interrupted and for 4...10 seconds, that foe has -2 Energy degeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: -2 Energy degeneration (4...10 seconds).

skills.name: Power Leak
skills.description: If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill is interrupted and target foe loses 3...17 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: causes 3...17 Energy loss.

skills.name: Power Leech
skills.description: If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill is interrupted and for 10 seconds, whenever that foe casts a spell, you steal up to 5...15 Energy from that foe.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupt a spell or a chant. Interruption effect: steal 5...15 Energy whenever target foe casts a spell (10 seconds).

skills.name: Power Lock
skills.description: If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill is interrupted and disabled for an additional 5...13 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: interrupted spell or chant is disabled for +5...13 seconds.

skills.name: Power Return
skills.description: If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill is interrupted and target foe gains 10...5 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: target foe gains 10...5 Energy.

skills.name: Power Shot
skills.description: If Power Shot hits, target foe takes 25...50 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Target foe takes 25...50 damage.

skills.name: Power Spike
skills.description: If target foe is casting a spell or a chant, that skill is interrupted and target foe takes 30...120 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: deals 30...120 damage.

skills.name: Practiced Stance
skills.description: For 20...35 seconds, your Preparations recharge 50% faster and last 30...300% longer.
skills.conciseDescription: (20...35 seconds.) Your preparations recharge 50% faster and last 30...300% longer.

skills.name: Precision Shot
skills.description: If Precision Shot hits, you strike for +3...10 damage. Precision Shot cannot be blocked. This action is easily interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +3...10 damage. Unblockable. <gray>Easily Interrupted.</gray>

skills.name: Predator's Pounce
skills.description: Your animal companion attempts a Predator's Pounce that deals +5...35 damage. If that attack hits, your animal companion gains 5...50 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...35 damage. Your pet gains 5...50 Health if this attack hits.

skills.name: Predatory Bond
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, your animal companion attacks 25% faster and heals you for 1...31 Health with each successful attack.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Your pet attacks 25% faster and you gain 1...31 Health whenever your pet makes a successful attack.

skills.name: Predatory Season
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, all healing is reduced by 20%. If any of your attacks hit, you gain 5 Health. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). Creatures in range receive 20% less from healing. Creatures gain 5 health each time they hit with an attack. Does not affect spirits.

skills.name: Prepared Shot
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +10...25 damage. If you are under the effects of a preparation, you gain 1...9 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...25 damage. You gain 1...9 Energy if you have a preparation active.

skills.name: Preservation
skills.description: Create a level 1...14 spirit. Every 4 seconds, this spirit heals one non-spirit ally in the area for 10...115 Health. This spirit dies after 90 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...14 spirit (90 second lifespan). Every 4 seconds this spirit heals one non-spirit ally for 10...115.

skills.name: Price of Failure
skills.description: For 30 seconds, target foe has a 25% chance to miss with attacks and takes 1...46 damage whenever that foe fails to hit in combat.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) 25% chance to miss. Target foe takes 1...46 damage whenever it fails to hit.

skills.name: Price of Pride
skills.description: For 5 seconds, the next time target foe uses an elite skill, that foe loses 3...15 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (5 seconds.) Causes 3...15 Energy loss the next time target foe uses an elite skill.

skills.name: Primal Echoes
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 Spirit. For non-Spirit creatures within its range, Signets cost 10 Energy to use. This Spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). Signets cost 10 energy for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.

skills.name: Primal Rage
skills.description: For 1...9 second[s], you attack 33% faster and move 33% faster, but you take 150...125% damage .
skills.conciseDescription: (1...9 second[s].) You attack 33% faster and move 33% faster. <gray>You take 150...125% damage.</gray>

skills.name: Protective Bond
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, target ally cannot lose more than 5% max Health due to damage from a single attack or spell. When Protective Bond prevents damage, you lose 6...3 Energy or the spell ends.
skills.conciseDescription: Target ally cannot lose more than 5% max Health from a single attack or spell. <gray>Each time damage is reduced you lose 6...3 Energy or this spell ends.</gray>

skills.name: Protective Spirit
skills.description: For 5...23 seconds, target ally cannot lose more than 10% max Health due to damage from a single attack or spell.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...23 seconds.) Incoming damage is reduced to 10% of target ally's maximum Health.

skills.name: Protective Was Kaolai
skills.description: Hold Kaolai's ashes for up to 15...60 seconds. While you hold his ashes, you gain 20 armor. When you drop his ashes, all party members are healed for 20...95 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (15...60 seconds.) You have +20 armor. Drop effect: all party members are healed for 20...95.

skills.name: Protector's Defense
skills.description: For 5...11 seconds, allies adjacent to you have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks. Protector's Defense ends if you move.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) Allies adjacent to you have 75% chance to block. <gray>Ends if you move.</gray>

skills.name: Protector's Strike
skills.description: If this attack strikes a moving foe, you strike for 10...40 more damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage if target is moving.

skills.name: Psychic Distraction
skills.description: All of your other skills are disabled for 8 seconds. If target foe is using a skill, that skill is interrupted and disabled for an additional 5...12 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts a skill. Interruption effect: disables interrupted skill (+5...12 seconds). <gray>Your other skills are disabled (8 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Psychic Instability
skills.description: Interrupt the target foe's action. If that action was a skill, that foe and nearby foes are knocked down for 2...4 seconds. (50% failure chance with Fast Casting 4 or less.)
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: if the action is a skill, cause knockdown for 2...4 seconds on target foe and all nearby foes. <gray>50% failure chance unless Fast Casting 5 or higher.</gray>

skills.name: Pulverizing Smash
skills.description: If you hit a knocked-down foe, that foe suffers from Weakness and a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Weakness and Deep Wound conditions (5...20 seconds) if target foe is knocked-down.

skills.name: Punishing Shot
skills.description: If Punishing Shot hits, you strike for +10...20 damage and your target is interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...20 damage. Interrupts an action.

skills.name: Pure Strike
skills.description: If Pure Strike hits, you strike for +1...30 damage. If you are not using a stance, Pure Strike cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +1...30 damage. Unblockable unless you are in a stance.

skills.name: Pure Was Li Ming
skills.description: Hold Li Ming's ashes for 5...20 seconds. While you hold her ashes, conditions on you expire 10...50% faster. When you drop her ashes, all allies within earshot lose 1...4 condition[s].
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Conditions on you expire 10...50% faster. Drop effect: removes 1...4 condition[s] from allies in earshot.

skills.name: Purge Conditions
skills.description: Remove all conditions (Poison, Disease, Blindness, Dazed, Bleeding, Crippled, Burning, Weakness, Cracked Armor, and Deep Wound) from target ally.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes all conditions.

skills.name: Purge Signet
skills.description: Remove all hexes and conditions from target ally. You lose 10 Energy for each hex and each condition removed.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes all hexes and conditions. <gray>Removal cost: 10 Energy each.</gray>

skills.name: Purifying Finale
skills.description: For 10...35 seconds, target non-spirit ally loses 1 condition whenever a chant or shout ends on that ally.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) Target ally loses one condition whenever a chant or shout ends on that ally. <gray>Cannot target spirits.</gray>

skills.name: Purifying Veil
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, conditions expire 5...50% faster on target ally. When this enchantment ends, one condition is removed from that ally.
skills.conciseDescription: Conditions expire 5...50% faster on target ally. End effect: removes a condition.

skills.name: Putrid Bile
skills.description: For 5...25 seconds, target foe suffers -1...3 Health degeneration. If that foe dies while under the effects of this hex, all nearby foes take 25...85 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...25 seconds.) Causes -1...3 Health degeneration. Deals 25...85 damage to all nearby foes if target foe dies.

skills.name: Putrid Explosion
skills.description: The corpse nearest your target explodes, sending out a shockwave that deals 24...120 damage to nearby foes.
skills.conciseDescription: Explodes a corpse, dealing 24...120 damage to foes near it. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse.</gray>

skills.name: Putrid Flesh
skills.description: Destroy one of your target animated undead minions. All foes near that creature are Diseased for 5...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Destroys one of your undead servants. Inflicts Diseased condition (5...15 seconds) to foes near this servant.

skills.name: Quick Shot
skills.description: Shoot an arrow that moves twice as fast.
skills.conciseDescription: You shoot an arrow that moves twice as fast.

skills.name: Quickening Zephyr
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, all skills recharge twice as fast and cost 30% more of the base Energy to cast. This spirit dies after 15...90 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (15...90 second lifespan). Skills cost 30% more Energy and recharge twice as fast for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.

skills.name: Quicksand
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. All non-spirit creatures within its range lose 1 Energy each time they attack or use a skill. This spirit dies after 30...180 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...180 second lifespan). Creatures lose 1 Energy each time they attack or use a skill. Does not affect spirits.

skills.name: Quivering Blade
skills.description: If Quivering Blade hits, you strike for +10...40 damage. If this attack hits a moving foe, that foe is Dazed for 10 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage. Inflicts Dazed condition (10 seconds) if target foe was moving.

skills.name: Radiant Scythe
skills.description: This attack strikes for +1 damage for each point of Energy you currently have, maximum 5...30. You gain 1...7 Energy if this attack hits.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +1 damage (maximum 5...30) for each point of Energy you have. Gain 1...7 Energy.

skills.name: Radiation Field
skills.description: For 5 seconds, foes in the area have -4...6 Health degeneration. When the portal ends, foes in the area are Diseased for 12...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (5 seconds.) Causes -4...6 Health degeneration to foes in the area. End effect: inflicts Disease condition (12...20 seconds) to foes in the area.

skills.name: Rage of the Ntouka
skills.description: Gain 1...7 strike[s] of adrenaline. For 8 seconds, whenever you use an adrenal skill, that skill recharges for 3 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 1...7 adrenaline. <gray>For 8 seconds, adrenal skills have a 3 second recharge when used.</gray>

skills.name: Rampage as One
skills.description: For 3...15 seconds, both you and your animal companion attack 33% faster and run 25% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...15 seconds.) You and your pet attack 33% faster and move 25% faster. <gray>No effect unless your pet is alive.</gray>

skills.name: Rapid Fire
skills.description: For 5...25 seconds, you attack 33% faster while wielding a bow.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...25 seconds.) You attack 33% faster while wielding a bow.

skills.name: Raven Blessing
skills.description: You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the raven. For 60 seconds, you have 80 armor, 660...700 Health, and a 20...30% chance to block, All your attributes are set to 0 and raven attacks replace your skills.
skills.conciseDescription: You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the Raven (60 seconds). All your attributes are set to 0 and raven attacks replace your skills, and you have 80 armor, 660...700 Health, and a 20...30% block chance.

skills.name: Ravenous Gaze
skills.description: Deal 20...40 damage and steal 20...40 Health from target foe and all nearby foes.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 20...40 damage and steals 20...40 Health from target and nearby foes.

skills.name: Ray of Judgment
skills.description: Invoke a Ray of Judgment at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, target foe and all foes adjacent to this location take 10...50 holy damage each second and begin Burning for 1...3 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...50 holy damage and inflicts Burning (1...3 second[s]) every second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target's initial location.

skills.name: Read the Wind
skills.description: For 24 seconds, your arrows move twice as fast and deal 3...10 extra damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (24 seconds). +3...10 damage. Your arrows move twice as fast.

skills.name: Reap Impurities
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +3...15 damage. Each foe you hit loses 1 condition. For each foe who loses a condition, all foes adjacent to that target foe take 10...40 holy damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +3...15 damage. Struck foes lose 1 condition. Removal Effect: all foes adjacent to those struck take 10...40 holy damage.

skills.name: Reaper's Mark
skills.description: For 30 seconds, target foe suffers -1...5 Health degeneration. If that foe dies while hexed with Reaper's Mark, you gain 5...15 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Causes -1...5 Health degeneration. You gain 5...15 Energy if target foe dies while suffering from this hex.

skills.name: Reaper's Sweep
skills.description: If this attack hits, you Cripple your target for 3...15 seconds. You lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed, this attack knocks down for 2...3 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...15 seconds.) Cause Cripple. Lose 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal Effect: cause knockdown for 2...3 seconds.

skills.name: Rebirth
skills.description: Resurrect target party member. Target party member is returned to life with 25% Health and zero Energy, and is teleported to your current location. All of target's skills are disabled for 10...3 seconds. This spell consumes all of your remaining Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Resurrects target party member (25% Health, 0 Energy). Teleports target to you. <gray>Disables target's skills (10...3 seconds). You lose all Energy.</gray>

skills.name: Recall
skills.description: While you maintain Recall, nothing happens. When Recall ends, you Shadow Step to the ally you targeted when you activated this skill and all of your skills are disabled for 3 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: End effect: Shadow Step to target ally. <gray>Cannot self-target and disables all of your skills for 3 seconds when it ends.</gray>

skills.name: Reckless Haste
skills.description: For 6...12 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes are hexed with Reckless Haste. While hexed, they attack 25% faster but have a 50% chance to miss with attacks.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes adjacent to your target (6...12 seconds). These foes have 50% chance to miss, but attack 25% faster.

skills.name: Reclaim Essence
skills.description: All of your Spirits die. You gain 5...20 Energy and all of your Binding Rituals are recharged if a Spirit died in this way.
skills.conciseDescription: All of your Spirits die. If a Spirit dies in this way, you gain 5...20 Energy and all of your Binding Rituals are recharged.

skills.name: Recovery
skills.description: Create a level 1...14 spirit. Conditions on allies within range of this spirit expire 20...50% faster. This spirit dies after 30...60 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...14 spirit (30...60 second lifespan). Conditions on allies in range expire 20...50% faster.

skills.name: Recuperation
skills.description: Create a level 1...14 spirit. Non-spirit allies within its range gain +1...3 Health regeneration. This spirit dies after 15...45 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...14 spirit (15...45 second lifespan). Non-spirit allies within range have +1...3 Health regeneration.

skills.name: Recurring Insecurity
skills.description: For 5 seconds, target foe suffers from -1...6 Health degeneration. If that foe has another hex when Recurring Insecurity would end, it is reapplied.
skills.conciseDescription: (5 seconds.) Causes -1...6 Health degeneration. Renewal: if target foe has another hex when Recurring Insecurity would end.

skills.name: Rejuvenation
skills.description: Create a level 1...20 spirit. This spirit heals all party members within earshot for 3...10 Health each second. This spirit loses 3...10 Health for each party member healed in this way. This spirit dies after 30...90 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...20 spirit (30...90 second lifespan). Heals party members in earshot for 3...10 each second. <gray>Healing cost: this spirit loses 3...10 Health.</gray>

skills.name: Release Enchantments
skills.description: Lose all enchantments. Each party member is healed for 5...35 Health for each Monk enchantment lost.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes all of your enchantments. Heals all party members for 5...35 for each Monk Enchantment removed.

skills.name: Remedy Signet
skills.description: You lose 1 condition.
skills.conciseDescription: You lose one condition.

skills.name: Remove Hex
skills.description: Remove a hex from target ally.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes a hex from target ally.

skills.name: Rend Enchantments
skills.description: Remove 5...9 enchantments from target foe. For each Monk enchantment removed, you lose 55...25 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes 5...9 enchantments from target foe. <gray>Removal cost: you lose 55...25 Health for each Monk enchantment removed.</gray>

skills.name: Rending Aura
skills.description: When you cast this enchantment, all nearby foes take 10...40 cold damage. For 30 <sic/> seconds, your attack skills remove enchantments from knocked-down foes. When this enchantment ends, nearby foes are affected by Cracked Armor for 1...10 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Your attack skills remove enchantments from knocked-down foes. Initial effect: deals 10...40 cold damage to all nearby foes. End effect: nearby foes have Cracked Armor for 1...10 second[s].

skills.name: Rending Sweep
skills.description: You deal +5...20 and lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was lost, you remove an enchantment from each foe you hit.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. You lose 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal effect: struck foes lose an enchantment.

skills.name: Rending Touch
skills.description: Deals 15...65 cold damage to target foe. You lose one Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed, target foe loses 1 enchantment and you gain 2 strikes of adrenaline.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Spell. Deals 15...65 cold damage. Lose 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal effect: target foe loses 1 enchantment and you gain 2 strikes of adrenaline.

skills.name: Renew Life
skills.description: Resurrect target touched dead target <sic/> party member with 50% Health and 5...20% Energy. That party member and all allies within earshot are healed for 55...130 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Spell. Resurrects target party member (50% Health and 5...20% Energy). Heals allies within earshot for 55...130.

skills.name: Renewing Memories
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, while holding an item, any weapon and item Spells you cast cost 5...35% less Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Your weapon and item spells cost 5...35% less Energy. <gray>No effect unless holding an item.</gray>

skills.name: Renewing Smash
skills.description: If Renewing Smash hits, it deals +10...40 damage. If you hit a knocked-down foe, you gain 3 Energy and this attack recharges instantly.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage. You gain 3 Energy and this attack recharges instantly if target foe was knocked down.

skills.name: Renewing Surge
skills.description: For 8 seconds, target foe suffers 2...12 damage each second. When this hex ends, you gain 1...8 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) Deals 2...12 damage each second. End effect: You gain 1...8 energy.

skills.name: Repeating Strike
skills.description: Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, this attack strikes for +10...30 damage. If it misses, it takes an additional 15 seconds to recharge.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...30 damage. <gray>This skill has +15 second recharge time if it misses. Must follow an off-hand attack.</gray>

skills.name: Resilient Was Xiko
skills.description: Hold Xiko's ashes for up to 5...20 seconds. For each hex or condition you are suffering from while holding her ashes, you gain +3 Health regeneration. When you drop her ashes, you lose 1...4 conditions.<sic/>
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) You have +3 Health regeneration for each hex or condition on you. Drop effect: you lose 1...4 condition[s].

skills.name: Resilient Weapon
skills.description: For 3...12 seconds, target ally has a Resilient Weapon. While suffering from a hex or condition, that ally gains +1...6 Health regeneration and +24 armor.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...12 seconds.) +1...6 Health regeneration and +24 armor. <gray>No effect unless target ally is hexed or has a condition.</gray>

skills.name: Restful Breeze
skills.description: For 8...18 seconds, target ally has +10 Health regeneration. This enchantment ends if that ally attacks or uses a skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...18 seconds.) +10 Health regeneration. <gray>Ends if target ally attacks or uses a skill.</gray>

skills.name: Restoration
skills.description: Create a level 1...14 spirit. When this spirit dies, all party members in the area are resurrected with 5...50% Health and zero Energy. This spirit dies after 30 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...14 spirit (30 second lifespan). End effect: resurrects party members in the area with 5...50% Health and zero Energy.

skills.name: Restore Condition
skills.description: Remove all conditions (Poison, Disease, Blindness, Dazed, Bleeding, Crippled, Burning, Weakness, Cracked Armor, and Deep Wound) from target other ally. For each condition removed, that ally is healed for 10...70 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes all conditions. Removal effect: heals for 10...70 for each condition removed. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Restore Life
skills.description: Touch the body of a fallen party member. Target party member is returned to life with 20...65% Health and 42...90% Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Spell. Resurrects target party member (20...65% Health, 42...90% Energy).

skills.name: Resurrect
skills.description: Resurrect target party member. Target party member is returned to life with 25% Health and zero Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Resurrects target party member (25% Health, 0 Energy).

skills.name: Resurrection Chant
skills.description: Resurrect target party member with up to your current Health and 5...35% Energy. This spell has half the normal range.
skills.conciseDescription: Half Range Spell. Resurrects target party member at your current Health and with 5...35% Energy.

skills.name: Resurrection Signet
skills.description: Resurrect target party member. That party member is returned to life with 100% Health and 25% Energy. This signet only recharges when you gain a morale boost.
skills.conciseDescription: Resurrects target party member (100% Health, 25% Energy). This signet only recharges when you gain a morale boost.

skills.name: Retribution
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, whenever target ally takes attack damage, this spell deals 33% of the damage back to the source (maximum 5...20 damage).
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 33% of each attack's damage (maximum 5...20) back to the source.

skills.name: Return
skills.description: All adjacent foes are Crippled for 3...8 seconds. Shadow Step to target other ally's location.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Crippled condition (3...8 seconds) on all foes adjacent to you. You Shadow Step to target ally's location. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Revealed Enchantment
skills.description: Remove an enchantment from target foe and gain 3...15 Energy. For 20 seconds, Revealed Enchantment is replaced with the enchantment removed from target foe.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes an enchantment from target foe. Removal effects: you gain 3...15 Energy; this spell is replaced with that enchantment (20 seconds).

skills.name: Revealed Hex
skills.description: Remove a hex from target ally and gain 4...10 Energy. For 20 seconds, Revealed Hex is replaced with the hex that was removed.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes a hex from target ally. Removal effects: you gain 4...10 Energy; this spell is replaced with that hex (20 seconds).

skills.name: Reversal of Damage
skills.description: For 8 seconds, the next time target ally would take damage, the foe dealing the damage takes that damage instead (maximum 5...75).
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) Negates the next damage and hits the source for that same amount (maximum 5...75).

skills.name: Reversal of Fortune
skills.description: For 8 seconds, the next time target ally would take damage or life steal, that ally gains that amount of Health instead, maximum 15...80.
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) Converts the next incoming damage or life steal (maximum 15...80) to healing.

skills.name: Reverse Hex
skills.description: Remove one hex from target ally. If a hex was removed in this way, for 5...10 seconds, the next time target ally would take damage, that damage is reduced by 5...50.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...10 seconds.) Removes one hex from target ally. The next damage this ally takes is reduced by 5...50. <gray>No effect unless this ally is hexed.</gray>

skills.name: Revive Animal
skills.description: Resurrect all nearby allied animal companions. They come back to life with 10...94% Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Resurrects all nearby allied pets (10...94% Health).

skills.name: Ride the Lightning
skills.description: You Ride the Lightning to target. All adjacent foes are Blinded for 1...5 second[s]. If your target is a foe, it is struck for 10...70 lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...70 lightning damage. 25% armor penetration. Blinds all adjacent foes (1...5 second[s]). You instantly move to your target. May target allies.

skills.name: Rigor Mortis
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, target foe cannot block.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) Target foe cannot block.

skills.name: Rip Enchantment
skills.description: Remove 1 enchantment from target foe. If an enchantment was removed, that foe suffers from Bleeding for 5...25 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes 1 enchantment. Removal effect: inflicts Bleeding (5...25 seconds).

skills.name: Riposte
skills.description: For 8 seconds, while you have a sword equipped, you block the next melee attack against you and your attacker is struck for 20...80 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds). You block the next melee attack and your attacker takes 20...80 damage. <gray>No effect unless you have a sword equipped.</gray>

skills.name: Rising Bile
skills.description: For 20 seconds, this hex does nothing. When Rising Bile ends, that foe and all foes in the area take 1...6 damage for each second Rising Bile was in effect.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) End effect: deals 1...6 damage for each second Rising Bile was in effect. Also damages other foes in the area.

skills.name: Ritual Lord
skills.description: For 5...35 seconds, your Ritualist attributes are boosted by 2...4 for your next skill. If that skill is a Binding Ritual, it recharges 10...60% faster and Ritual Lord recharges instantly.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...35 seconds.) You have +2...4 to all Ritualist attributes for your next skill. If that skill is a Binding Ritual, it recharges 10...60% faster and Ritual Lord recharges instantly.

skills.name: Roaring Winds
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. Chants and shouts cost 1...5 more Energy. This spirit dies after 30...180 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...180 second lifespan). Chants and shouts cost 1...5 more Energy for creatures in range.

skills.name: Rodgort's Invocation
skills.description: Target foe and all nearby foes are struck for 15...120 fire damage and set on fire for 1...3 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 15...120 fire damage. Also affects foes near your target. Inflicts Burning condition (1...3 second[s]).

skills.name: Rotting Flesh
skills.description: Target fleshy foe becomes Diseased for 10...25 seconds, slowly losing Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Diseased condition (10...25 seconds).

skills.name: Run as One
skills.description: For 5...15 seconds, you and your pet run 25% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.) You and your pet move 25% faster.

skills.name: Rupture Soul
skills.description: Target allied spirit is destroyed. All nearby enemies are struck for 50...140 lightning damage and become blinded for 3...12 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Destroys target allied spirit. Deals 50...140 lightning damage and inflicts Blindness condition (3...12 seconds) to nearby foes.

skills.name: Rush
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, you move 25% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) You move 25% faster.

skills.name: Rust
skills.description: Deals 10...85 cold damage to target and adjacent foes. For 5...20 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes take twice as long to activate signets. If you are Overcast, foes struck with Rust have their signets interrupted and disabled for 1...10 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...85 cold damage to target and adjacent foes. Hexes target and adjacent foes (5...20 seconds). Doubles signet activation time. Interrupts and disables signets for 1...10 second[s] if you are Overcast.

skills.name: Sadist's Signet
skills.description: You gain 10...45 Health for each condition on target foe.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 10...45 Health for each condition on target foe.

skills.name: Sand Shards
skills.description: For 30 seconds, the next 1...5 time[s] you hit with a scythe, all other adjacent foes take 10...60 earth damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Deal 10...60 earth damage to all other adjacent foes whenever you hit with your scythe. <gray>Ends after 1...5 hit[s].</gray>

skills.name: Sandstorm
skills.description: Create a Sandstorm at target foe's location. For 10 seconds, nearby foes are struck for 20...40 earth damage each second and attacking foes are struck for an additional 10...30 earth damage each second.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 20...40 earth damage each second (10 seconds). Hits foes near target foe's initial location. Hits attacking foes for 10...30 more earth damage each second.

skills.name: Savage Pounce
skills.description: Your animal companion attempts a Savage Pounce that deals +5...20 damage. If the attack strikes a foe who is casting a spell, that foe is knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Causes knock-down if target foe is casting a spell.

skills.name: Savage Shot
skills.description: If Savage Shot hits, your target's action is interrupted. If that action was a spell, you strike for +13...28 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: deals +13...28 damage if action was a spell.

skills.name: Savage Slash
skills.description: If this attack hits, it interrupts target foe's action. If that action was a spell, you deal 1...40 extra damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: deals +1...40 damage if action was a spell.

skills.name: Savannah Heat
skills.description: You create Savannah Heat at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, all nearby foes take 5...20 fire damage for each second this spell has been in effect.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 5...20 fire damage for each second since casting this spell (5 seconds). <gray>Hits foes near target's initial location.</gray>

skills.name: Scavenger Strike
skills.description: Your animal companion attempts a Scavenger Strike that deals +10...25 damage. If the attack strikes a foe who is suffering a condition, you gain 3...15 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...25 damage. You gain 3...15 Energy if target foe has a condition.

skills.name: Scavenger's Focus
skills.description: For 10 seconds if you strike a foe who is suffering from a condition you gain 3...12 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds). You gain 3...12 Energy if you strike a foe who has a condition.

skills.name: Scorpion Wire
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, the next time you and target foe are more than 75' apart, you Shadow Step to that foe and that foe is knocked down. This spell has half the normal range.
skills.conciseDescription: Half Range Hex Spell. (8...20 seconds.) Shadow Step to target foe and cause knock-down the next time this foe is more than 75' away from you.

skills.name: Scourge Enchantment
skills.description: For 30 seconds, each time target foe is the target of an enchantment, the caster of that enchantment takes 15...75 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Deals 15...75 damage to anyone casting an enchantment on target foe.

skills.name: Scourge Healing
skills.description: For 30 seconds, every time target foe is healed, the healer takes 15...80 holy damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Whenever target foe is healed, the healer takes 15...80 holy damage.

skills.name: Scourge Sacrifice
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, every time target foe and adjacent foes sacrifice life, they sacrifice twice the normal amount.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes adjacent to target (8...20 seconds). Doubles Health sacrifice.

skills.name: Screaming Shot
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +10...25 damage. If your target is within earshot, that foe begins Bleeding for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...25 damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition (5...20 seconds) if target foe is within earshot.

skills.name: Scribe's Insight
skills.description: For 10...35 seconds, you gain 3 Energy whenever you use a Signet.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) You gain 3 Energy whenever you use a signet.

skills.name: Searing Flames
skills.description: Target foe and all nearby foes are struck with Searing Flames. Foes already on fire when this skill is cast are struck for 10...100 fire damage. Foes not already on fire begin Burning for 1...7 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Hits foes near your target. Deals 10...100 fire damage to foes already Burning. Inflicts Burning condition (1...7 seconds) to foes not Burning.

skills.name: Searing Heat
skills.description: Cause Searing Heat at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, foes near this location are struck for 10...40 fire damage each second. When Searing Heat ends, foes in the area of effect are set on fire for 3 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...40 fire damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes near target's initial location. End effect: inflicts Burning condition (3 seconds).

skills.name: Second Wind
skills.description: You gain 1 Energy and 5 Health for each point of Energy restricted by Overcast. You lose all enchantments.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 1 Energy and 5 Health for each point of Overcast. You lose all enchantments.

skills.name: Seed of Life
skills.description: For 2...5 seconds, whenever target other ally takes damage, all party members are healed for 2 Health for each rank in Divine Favor.
skills.conciseDescription: (2...5) seconds. Heals party members for 2 for each rank in Divine Favor whenever target takes damage. Cannot self target.

skills.name: Seeking Arrows
skills.description: For 3...14 seconds, your arrows cannot be blocked. Seeking Arrows ends if you fail to hit.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...14 seconds.) Your arrows are unblockable. <gray>Ends if you fail to hit.</gray>

skills.name: Seeking Blade
skills.description: If this attack hits you strike for +1...20 damage. If Seeking Blade is blocked, your target begins Bleeding for 25 seconds and takes 1...20 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +1...20 damage. Deals 1...20 damage and inflicts Bleeding condition (25 seconds) if blocked.

skills.name: Seeping Wound
skills.description: For 1...7 second[s], target foe moves 33% slower. That foe takes 5...25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...7 second[s].) Target foe moves 33% slower. This foe takes 5...25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.

skills.name: Selfless Spirit (Kurzick)
skills.description: For 15...20 seconds, spells you cast that target another ally cost 3 less energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (15...20 seconds.) Spells you cast that target another ally cost 3 less Energy.

skills.name: Selfless Spirit (Luxon)
skills.description: For 15...20 seconds, spells you cast that target another ally cost 3 less energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (15...20 seconds.) Spells you cast that target another ally cost 3 less Energy.

skills.name: Serpent's Quickness
skills.description: For 15...30 seconds, recharge times for your skills are reduced by 33%. Serpent's Quickness ends if your Health drops below 50%.
skills.conciseDescription: (15...30 seconds.) Your skills recharge 33% faster. <gray>Ends if your Health drops below 50%.</gray>

skills.name: Seven Weapons Stance
skills.description: For 3...20 seconds, your weapon attributes are increased by +1...15 and you attack 33% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...20 seconds.) Weapon attributes are increased by +1...15. You attack 33% faster.

skills.name: Sever Artery
skills.description: If this attack hits, the opponent begins Bleeding for 5...25 seconds, losing Health over time.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Bleeding condition (5...25 seconds).

skills.name: Shadow Fang
skills.description: Shadow Step to target foe. For 10 seconds, this hex does nothing. When this hex ends, you return to your original location and that foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Shadow Step to target foe. End effect after 10 seconds: inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds); you return to your original location.

skills.name: Shadow Form
skills.description: For 5...21 seconds, you cannot be the target of enemy spells, and you gain 5 damage reduction for each Assassin enchantment on you. You cannot deal more than 5...25 damage with a single skill or attack.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...21 seconds.) Enemy spells cannot target you. Gain 5 damage reduction for each Assassin enchantment on you. <gray>You cannot deal more than 5...25 damage with a single skill or attack.</gray>

skills.name: Shadow Meld
skills.description: Shadow Step to target other ally. When you stop maintaining this Enchantment, you return to your original location.
skills.conciseDescription: Shadow Step to target ally. End effect: return to your original location. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Shadow of Fear
skills.description: Target foe and all adjacent foes attack 50% slower for the next 5...30 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes adjacent to target (5...30 seconds). They attack 50% slower.

skills.name: Shadow of Haste
skills.description: For 10...40 seconds you move 15% faster than normal. When Shadow of Haste ends, you shadow step to your original location.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...40 seconds.) You move 15% faster. End effect: return to your original location.

skills.name: Shadow Prison
skills.description: Shadow Step to target foe. For 1...7 seconds, that foe moves 66% slower.
skills.conciseDescription: Shadow Step to target foe. This foe moves 66% slower (1...7 seconds).

skills.name: Shadow Refuge
skills.description: For 6 seconds, you gain 5...10 Health regeneration. When Shadow Refuge ends, you gain 40...100 Health if you are attacking.
skills.conciseDescription: (6 seconds.) You have +5...10 Health regeneration. End effect: heals you for 40...100 if you are attacking.

skills.name: Shadow Sanctuary (Kurzick)
skills.description: You are Blinded for 5 seconds. For 10 seconds, you gain +7...10 Health regeneration and +40 armor.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) You gain +7...10 Health regeneration and +40 armor. <gray>You are Blind (5 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Shadow Sanctuary (Luxon)
skills.description: You are Blinded for 5 seconds. For 10 seconds, you gain +7...10 Health regeneration and +40 armor.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) You gain +7...10 Health regeneration and +40 armor. <gray>You are Blind (5 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Shadow Shroud
skills.description: For 3...9 seconds, target foe cannot be the target of enchantments.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...9 seconds.) Target foe cannot be the target of enchantments.

skills.name: Shadow Strike
skills.description: Target foe takes 12...48 shadow damage. If that foe's Health is above 50%, you steal up to 12...48 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 12...48 damage. Steal up to 12...48 Health if this foe was above 50% Health.

skills.name: Shadow Theft
skills.description: Shadow Step to target foe. For 5...20 seconds that foe's attributes are reduced by 1...5 and your attributes are increased by 1...5. This skill counts as a Lead Attack.
skills.conciseDescription: Shadow Step to target foe. For 5...20 seconds that foe's attributes are reduced by 1...5 and your attributes are increased by 1...5. Counts as a Lead Attack.

skills.name: Shadow Walk
skills.description: Shadow Step to target foe. For 15 seconds nothing happens. Your attack skills are disabled for 1 second, and your stances and enchantments are disabled for 10 seconds. When this stance ends, you return to your original location.
skills.conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) Shadow Step to target foe. End effect: return to your original location. <gray>Disables your attack skills for 1 second. Disables your stances and enchantments for 10 seconds.</gray>

skills.name: Shadowsong
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. The spirit's attacks deal 5...20 damage and cause Blindness for 1...6 second[s]. This spirit dies after 30 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30-second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5...20 damage and inflict Blindness condition (1...6 second[s]).

skills.name: Shadowy Burden
skills.description: For 3...15 seconds, target foe moves 25% slower and while target foe has no other hexes, that foe has 20...30 less armor against your attacks.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...15 seconds.) Target foe moves 25% slower and has 20...30 less armor against your attacks. <gray>Armor reduction only affects this foe while it has no other hexes.</gray>

skills.name: Shame
skills.description: For 6 seconds, the next time target foe casts a spell that targets an ally, the spell fails and you steal up to 5...14 Energy from that foe.
skills.conciseDescription: (6 seconds.) Target foe's next spell fails and you steal 5...14 Energy. <gray>No effect unless this foe's spell targeted one of its allies.</gray>

skills.name: Shameful Fear
skills.description: For 10 seconds, target foe moves 10% faster than normal. For each second, if that foe is moving, that foe takes 5...20 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Target foe takes 5...20 damage each second while moving, but moves 10% faster.

skills.name: Shard Storm
skills.description: Send out an ice shard that strikes target foe for 10...85 cold damage if it hits and causing target foe to move 66% slower for 2...6 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Projectile: deals 10...85 cold damage. Target foe moves 66% slower (2...6 seconds).

skills.name: Shared Burden
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, target foe and all foes in the area attack, cast spells, and move 50% slower.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes in the area of your target (5...20 seconds). These foes attack, cast spells, and move 50% slower.

skills.name: Sharpen Daggers
skills.description: For 5...30 seconds, your dagger attacks cause Bleeding for 5...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...30 seconds.) Your dagger attacks inflict the Bleeding condition (5...15 seconds).

skills.name: Shatter Delusions
skills.description: Remove one Mesmer hex from target foe. If a hex was removed, that foe takes 15...75 damage and all adjacent foes take 75% of that damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes a Mesmer hex from target foe. Removal effect: 15...75 damage to target and 75% of that damage to all adjacent foes.

skills.name: Shatter Enchantment
skills.description: Remove an enchantment from target foe. If an enchantment is removed, that foe takes 14...100 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes an enchantment from target foe. Removal effect: deals 14...100 damage.

skills.name: Shatter Hex
skills.description: Remove a hex from target ally. If a hex is removed, foes near that ally take 30...120 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes a hex from target ally. Removal effect: deals 30...120 damage to foes near this ally.

skills.name: Shatter Storm
skills.description: Target foe loses all enchantments. For each enchantment removed this way, Shatter Storm is disabled for an additional 7 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes all enchantments. <gray>Removal cost: Shatter Storm is disabled for +7 seconds for each enchantment removed.</gray>

skills.name: Shattering Assault
skills.description: Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, you deal 5...50 damage and target foe loses one enchantment. This attack cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 5...50 damage. Removes one enchantment. Unblockable. <gray>Must follow an off-hand attack.</gray>

skills.name: Shatterstone
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 25...100 cold damage, moves 66% slower, and is hexed with Shatterstone for 3 seconds. When Shatterstone ends, that foe and all nearby foes are struck for 25...100 cold damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (3 seconds.) Initial effect: deals 25...100 cold damage and target moves 66% slower. End effect: deals 25...100 cold damage to target and all nearby foes.

skills.name: Shell Shock
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 10...30 lightning damage and has Cracked Armor for 5...20 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration. If you are Overcast, this spell strikes adjacent foes.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...30 lightning damage. Inflicts Cracked Armor condition (5...20 seconds). 25% armor penetration. If Overcast, strikes adjacent.

skills.name: Shelter
skills.description: Create a level 1...12 spirit. Non-spirit allies within its range cannot lose more than 10% maximum Health from a single attack. When this spirit prevents damage, it loses 75...45 Health. This spirit lasts 30...60 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...12 spirit (30...60 second lifespan). Non-spirit allies within range cannot lose more than 10% maximum Health from a single attack. <gray>Damage prevention cost: this spirit loses 75...45 Health.</gray>

skills.name: Shield Bash
skills.description: For 5...11 seconds, while wielding a shield, the next melee attack skill used against you is blocked, your attacker is knocked down and that skill is disabled for an additional 15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) You block the next melee attack skill. Causes knock-down and +15 second recharge. <gray>No effect unless you are wielding a shield.</gray>

skills.name: Shield Guardian
skills.description: For 2...6 seconds, all party members in earshot have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks. If an attack is blocked, all allies in earshot are healed for 10...40 and Shield Guardian ends.
skills.conciseDescription: (2...6 second[s]). Party members in earshot have a 75% chance to block attacks. Block effect: Allies in earshot are healed for 10...40, and Shield Guardian ends.

skills.name: Shield of Absorption
skills.description: For 3...7 seconds, damage received by target ally is reduced by 5 each time that ally is hit while under the effects of this enchantment.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...7 seconds.) Reduces incoming damage by 5 each time target ally takes damage.

skills.name: Shield of Deflection
skills.description: For 3...10 seconds, target ally has a 75% chance to block attacks and gains 15...30 armor.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...10 seconds.) 75% chance to block. +15...30 armor.

skills.name: Shield of Force
skills.description: For 1...16 second[s], blocks the next 1 attack against you. If an attack is blocked, all adjacent attacking foes are knocked down and suffer from Weakness for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...16 second[s].) Blocks the next 1 attack against you. Knocks down and inflicts Weakness (5...20 seconds) on all adjacent attacking foes.

skills.name: Shield of Judgment
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, anyone striking target ally with an attack is knocked down and suffers 5...50 holy damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) Deals 5...50 holy damage to foes attacking <sic/> target ally. Causes knock-down.

skills.name: Shield of Regeneration
skills.description: For 5...13 seconds, target ally gains +3...10 Health regeneration and 20...45 armor.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...13 seconds.) +3...10 Health regeneration and +20...45 armor.

skills.name: Shield Stance
skills.description: For 1...6 second[s], while wielding a shield, you have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks, and damage is reduced by 2 for each rank of Strength (maximum 15 damage reduction).
skills.conciseDescription: (1...6 second[s].) You have 75% chance to block. Damage is reduced by 2 for each rank of Strength (maximum 15 damage reduction). <gray>No effect unless you have a shield equipped.</gray>

skills.name: Shielding Hands
skills.description: For 8 seconds, damage and life steal received by target ally is reduced by 3...18. When Shielding Hands ends, that ally is healed for 5...50 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) Reduces incoming damage and<sic/> life steal by 3...18. End effect: heals for 5...50

skills.name: Shivers of Dread
skills.description: For 10...40 seconds, whenever target foe is struck for cold damage while using a skill, that foe is interrupted<sic/> and you lose 8...3 Energy or Shivers of Dread ends.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...40 seconds.) Cold damage interrupts target foe's skills. <gray>Interruption cost: you lose 8...3 Energy or this hex ends.</gray>

skills.name: Shock
skills.description: Target touched foe is knocked down and struck for 10...60 lightning damage. This skill has 25% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Deals 10...60 lightning damage. Causes knock-down. 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Shock Arrow
skills.description: Send out a shocking arrow that flies swiftly toward target foe, striking for 5...50 lightning damage. If Shock Arrow strikes a foe suffering from Cracked Armor, you gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage. Shock Arrow has 25% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: Rapid projectile: deals 5...50 lightning damage. Gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage if you hit a foe suffering from Cracked Armor. 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Shockwave
skills.description: All foes in the area take 15...60 earth damage and are Weakened for 1...10 second[s]. Nearby foes also take +15...60 earth damage and have Cracked Armor for 1...10 second[s]. Adjacent foes suffer the previous effects, take +15...60 earth damage, and are Blinded for 1...10 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Foes in the area take 15...60 earth damage and are Weakened (1...10 second[s]). Nearby foes also take +15...60 earth damage and have Cracked Armor (1...10 second[s]). Adjacent foes also take +15...60 earth damage and are Blinded (1...10 second[s]).

skills.name: Shove
skills.description: Target touched foe takes 15...75 damage, their stance ends, and they are knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Elite Touch Skill. Target touched foe takes 15...75 damage, their stance ends, and they are knocked down.

skills.name: Shrinking Armor
skills.description: For 10 seconds, target foe suffers from -1...4 Health degeneration. When this hex ends, that foe has Cracked Armor for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Causes -1...4 Health degeneration. End effect: inflicts Cracked Armor condition (5...20 seconds).

skills.name: Shroud of Distress
skills.description: For 30...60 seconds, if you are below 50% Health, you have +3...8 health regeneration and a 75% chance to block attacks.
skills.conciseDescription: (30...60 seconds.) You have +3...8 health regeneration and a 75% chance to block. <gray>No effect unless your Health is below 50%.</gray>

skills.name: Shroud of Silence
skills.description: All of your spells are disabled for 15 seconds. For 1...6 second[s], target touched foe cannot cast spells.
skills.conciseDescription: Elite Touch Hex Spell. (1...6 second[s].) Target foe cannot cast spells. <gray>Your spells are disabled for 15 seconds.</gray>

skills.name: Sight Beyond Sight
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, you cannot be Blinded.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds). You are immune to Blindness.

skills.name: Signet of Aggression
skills.description: If you are under the effects of a shout or chant, you gain 2 strikes of adrenaline.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 2 adrenaline if you are under the effects of a shout or chant.

skills.name: Signet of Agony
skills.description: You suffer from Bleeding for 25 seconds. All nearby foes take 10...70 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...70 damage to foes near you. <gray>You begin Bleeding (25 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Signet of Binding
skills.description: You lose 200...50 Health and take control of target enemy-controlled spirit. (50% failure chance with Spawning Power 4 or less.)
skills.conciseDescription: You lose 200...50 Health. Gain control of target enemy-controlled spirit. <gray>50% failure chance unless Spawning Power 5 or more.</gray>

skills.name: Signet of Capture
skills.description: Choose one skill from a nearby dead Boss of your profession. Signet of Capture is permanently replaced by that skill. If that skill was elite, gain 250 XP for every level you have earned.
skills.conciseDescription: Choose one skill from a nearby dead Boss of your profession. Signet of Capture is permanently replaced by that skill. If that skill was elite, gain 250 XP for every level you have earned.

skills.name: Signet of Clumsiness
skills.description: If target foe is attacking, that foe and all adjacent foes are interrupted and take 15...60 damage. Any foes using attack skills are knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts an attack for target foe and all adjacent foes. Interruption effect: deals 15...60 damage; knocks down foes using attack skills.

skills.name: Signet of Corruption (Kurzick)
skills.description: Target foe and all nearby foes take 20...30 damage. For each affected foe suffering from a condition or hex, you gain 2 Energy (maximum 12...20 Energy).
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 20...30 damage to target and nearby foes. You gain 2 Energy (maximum 12...20) for each of these foes with a condition or hex.

skills.name: Signet of Corruption (Luxon)
skills.description: Target foe and all nearby foes take 20...30 damage. For each affected foe suffering from a condition or hex, you gain 2 Energy (maximum 12...20 Energy).
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 20...30 damage to target and nearby foes. You gain 2 Energy (maximum 12...20) for each of these foes with a condition or hex.

skills.name: Signet of Creation
skills.description: You gain 4 Energy for every summoned creature you control within earshot (maximum 3...12 Energy).
skills.conciseDescription: Gain 4 Energy (maximum 3...12 Energy) for each summoned creature you control within earshot.

skills.name: Signet of Deadly Corruption
skills.description: Target foe takes 5...35 damage for each condition on that foe (maximum 130 damage).
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 5...35 damage (maximum 130) for each condition on target foe.

skills.name: Signet of Devotion
skills.description: Heal target ally for 20...120 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 20...120.

skills.name: Signet of Disenchantment
skills.description: Lose all Energy. Target foe loses one enchantment.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes one enchantment. <gray>You lose all Energy.</gray>

skills.name: Signet of Disruption
skills.description: If target foe is casting a spell, the spell is interrupted and that foe suffers 10...51 damage. If that foe is hexed, Signet of Disruption can interrupt any non-spell skills.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts a spell. Can interrupt any skill if target foe is hexed. Interruption effect: deals 10...51 damage.

skills.name: Signet of Distraction
skills.description: If target foe is casting a spell, that spell is interrupted and disabled for 1...5 seconds for each signet you have equipped.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts a spell. Interruption effect: target foe's spell is disabled for 1...5 seconds for each signet you have equipped.

skills.name: Signet of Ghostly Might
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, all spirits you control within earshot attack 33% faster and deal 5...10 additional damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) All spirits you control within earshot attack 33% faster and deal +5...10 damage.

skills.name: Signet of Humility
skills.description: Target foe's elite skill is disabled for 1...16 second[s]. Your non-Mesmer skills are disabled for 4 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Disables elite skill (1...16 second[s]). <gray>Disables your non-Mesmer skills (4 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Signet of Illusions
skills.description: Your next 1...3 non-Illusion spell[s] use your Illusion attribute instead of its normal attribute.
skills.conciseDescription: Your next 1...3 non-Illusion spell[s] use your Illusion attribute instead of its normal attribute.

skills.name: Signet of Infection
