skills.description: If target foe is Bleeding, that foe is Diseased for 13...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Diseased condition 13...20 seconds if target foe is Bleeding.

skills.name: Signet of Judgment
skills.description: Target foe is knocked down. That foe and all adjacent foes take 15...75 holy damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Knocks down target. Deals 15...75 holy damage to target and adjacent foes.

skills.name: Signet of Lost Souls
skills.description: If target foe is below 50% Health, you gain 10...100 Health and 1...10 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 10...100 Health and 1...10 Energy if target foe is below 50% Health.

skills.name: Signet of Malice
skills.description: For each condition suffered by target foe, you lose one condition.
skills.conciseDescription: You lose one condition for each condition on target foe.

skills.name: Signet of Midnight
skills.description: You and target touched foe become Blinded for 15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Elite Touch Signet. (15 seconds.) Inflicts Blindness condition. <gray>You suffer from Blindness (15 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Signet of Mystic Speed
skills.description: For 30 seconds, your next 1...3 self-targeting enchantment[s] cast instantly. Flash enchantments do not consume uses of this skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Your next 1...3 self-targeted enchantments <sic/> cast instantly. <gray>Flash enchantments do not consume uses of this skill.</gray>

skills.name: Signet of Mystic Wrath
skills.description: Target foe takes 25 holy damage for each enchantment on you (maximum 30...120 holy damage).
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 25 holy damage for each enchantment on you (maximum 30...120 holy damage).

skills.name: Signet of Pious Light
skills.description: Remove 1 Dervish enchantment. Target ally is healed for 30...150 Health. If an enchantment was removed in this way, this signet recharges 75% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 30...150. Removes one of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: recharges 75% faster.

skills.name: Signet of Pious Restraint
skills.description: Remove 1 Dervish enchantment. Target foe is Crippled for 5...15 seconds. If an enchantment was removed, all foes in the area of your target are also Crippled and this signet recharges 75% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Crippled condition (5...15 seconds). Remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: also causes Cripple to foes in the area of your target and recharges 75% faster.

skills.name: Signet of Rage
skills.description: Target foe takes 5...50 holy damage and +5...10 holy damage for each adrenaline skill that foe has.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 5...50 holy damage. Deals 5...10 more holy damage for each of target foe's adrenaline skills.

skills.name: Signet of Recall
skills.description: For 6 seconds, you have -4 Energy regeneration. When this effect ends, you gain 13...20 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (6 seconds.) You have -4 Energy regeneration. End effect: you gain 13...20 Energy.

skills.name: Signet of Rejuvenation
skills.description: Heal target ally for 15...75. If target ally is casting a spell or attacking, that ally is healed for an additional 15...75 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 15...75. Heals for 15...75 more if target ally is casting a spell or attacking.

skills.name: Signet of Removal
skills.description: If target ally is under the effects of an enchantment, that ally loses one hex and one condition.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes one hex and one condition. <gray>No effect unless target ally is enchanted.</gray>

skills.name: Signet of Return
skills.description: Resurrect target party member with 5...20% Health and 1...4% Energy for each party member within earshot.
skills.conciseDescription: Resurrects target party member (5...20% Health and 1...4% Energy for each party member in earshot).

skills.name: Signet of Shadows
skills.description: Target foe takes 5...35 damage. If your target was Blinded, that foe suffers an additional 15...60 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 5...35 damage. Deals 15...60 more damage if target foe is Blinded.

skills.name: Signet of Sorrow
skills.description: Target foe takes 15...75 damage. If target foe is near a corpse or has a dead pet, this skill recharges instantly.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 15...75 damage. Recharges instantly if target foe is near a corpse or has a dead pet.

skills.name: Signet of Spirits
skills.description: Create 3 level 1...12 spirits. These spirits deal 5...20 damage with attacks and die after 60 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates 3 level 1...12 spirits (60 second lifespan). These spirits deal 5...20 damage with attacks.

skills.name: Signet of Stamina
skills.description: You have +50...300 maximum Health. This signet ends if you successfully hit with an attack.
skills.conciseDescription: You have +50...300 maximum Health. <gray>Ends if you hit with an attack.</gray>

skills.name: Signet of Strength
skills.description: Your next 1...16 attack[s] deal +5 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Your attacks deal +5 damage. <gray>Ends after 1...16 attack[s].</gray>

skills.name: Signet of Suffering
skills.description: You suffer from Bleeding for 6 seconds. The next Necromancer skill that targets a foe causes Bleeding for 2...16 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: You Bleed for 6 seconds. Applies Bleeding (2...16 seconds) to the target of your next Necromancer skill.

skills.name: Signet of Synergy
skills.description: Target other ally is healed for 40...100 Health. If you are not under the effects of an enchantment, you are also healed for 40...100 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heal target ally for 40...100. You are also healed for 40...100 if you are not enchanted. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Signet of Toxic Shock
skills.description: If target foe is suffering from Poison, that foe takes 10...100 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...100 damage. <gray>No effect unless target foe is Poisoned</gray>

skills.name: Signet of Twilight
skills.description: For each hex on target foe, that foe loses one enchantment.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes one enchantment for each hex on target foe.

skills.name: Signet of Weariness
skills.description: Target foe and all nearby foes lose 3...8 Energy and suffer from Weakness for 1...12 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Also affects foes near your target. Causes 3...8 Energy loss and inflicts Weakness (1...12 second[s]).

skills.name: Silverwing Slash
skills.description: This attack strikes for +1...40 damage if it hits.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +1...40 damage.

skills.name: Simple Thievery
skills.description: Interrupt target foe's action. If that action was a skill, that skill is disabled for 5...20 seconds, and Simple Thievery is replaced by that skill.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: If a skill was interrupted, that skill is disabled and Simple Thievery becomes that skill (5...20 seconds).

skills.name: Siphon Speed
skills.description: For 5...15 seconds, target foe moves 33% slower and you move 33% faster. This spell recharges 50% faster if cast on a moving foe.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.) Target foe moves 33% slower and you move 33% faster. Recharges 50% faster if cast on a moving foe.

skills.name: Siphon Strength
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, target foe deals 5...50 less damage with attacks and all of your attacks against that foe have an additional 50% chance of being a critical hit.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Target foe deals -5...50 attack damage. You have +50% chance to land a critical hit on this foe.

skills.name: Skull Crack
skills.description: If it hits, this attack interrupts the target's current action. If that foe was casting a spell, that foe is Dazed for 15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts an action. Inflicts Dazed condition (15 seconds) if target is casting a spell.

skills.name: Slayer's Spear
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +5...25 damage. If that foe has more Health than you, that foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...25 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds) if target has more Health than you.

skills.name: Slippery Ground
skills.description: If target or adjacent foes are Blind or moving, these foes are knocked down. There is a 50% chance of failure with Water Magic less than 5.
skills.conciseDescription: Causes knock-down if this foe is Blind or moving. Affects foes adjacent to your target. <gray>50% failure chance unless Water Magic greater than 4.</gray>

skills.name: Sliver Armor
skills.description: For 5...11 seconds, you have 25...50% chance to block attacks and whenever you are the target of a hostile spell or attack one nearby foe is struck for 5...35 earth damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) You have 25...50% chance to block. Deals 5...35 earth damage to one nearby foe whenever you are the target of a hostile spell or attack.

skills.name: Sloth Hunter's Shot
skills.description: If this attack hits, target foe takes +10...25 damage. If that foe is not using a skill, Sloth Hunter's Shot does an additional +10...35 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...25 damage. Deals +10...35 more damage if target foe is not using a skill.

skills.name: Smite
skills.description: This attack <sic/> deals 10...55 Holy <sic/> damage. If attacking, your target takes an additional 10...35 Holy <sic/> damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...55 holy damage. Deals 10...35 more holy damage if target is attacking.

skills.name: Smite Condition
skills.description: Remove one condition from target ally. If a condition was removed, foes in the area take 10...60 holy damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes a condition. Removal effect: deals 10...60 holy damage to foes in the area of target ally.

skills.name: Smite Hex
skills.description: Remove a hex from target ally. If a hex is removed, foes in the area suffer 10...85 holy damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes a hex from target ally. Removal effect: deals 10...85 holy damage to foes in the area of target ally.

skills.name: Smiter's Boon
skills.description: For 30 seconds, your Smiting Prayers have double the Divine Favor bonus.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Your Smiting Prayers have double Divine Favor healing bonus.

skills.name: Smoke Powder Defense
skills.description: For 8 seconds, the next time you are struck, you take half damage and all adjacent foes are Blinded for 2...6 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) The next time you are struck, you take half damage and inflict Blindness condition (2...6 seconds) on adjacent foes.

skills.name: Smoke Trap
skills.description: When Smoke Trap is triggered, nearby foes are Blinded and Dazed for 5...10 seconds. Smoke Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: (90 seconds.) Inflicts Blinded and Dazed conditions (5...10 seconds) to nearby foes. <gray>Easily interrupted.</gray>

skills.name: Smoldering Embers
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 10...70 fire damage. If you are Overcast, that foe is hexed with Smoldering Embers for 3 seconds and takes 5...25 additional fire damage each second.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...70 fire damage to target. If you are Overcast, foe is hexed for 3 seconds, taking 5...25 fire damage each second.

skills.name: Smooth Criminal
skills.description: For 10...20 seconds, one random spell is disabled for target foe and Smooth Criminal is replaced by that spell. You gain 5...10 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...20 seconds.) Disables one Spell. This skill becomes that Spell. You gain 5...10 Energy.

skills.name: Snare
skills.description: When Snare is triggered, all nearby foes become Crippled for 3...15 seconds. Snare ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Inflicts Crippled condition (3...15 seconds). <gray>Easily interrupted.</gray>

skills.name: Sneak Attack
skills.description: If this attack hits, target foe is Blinded for 5...8 seconds. This attack counts as a lead attack.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Blindness (5...8 seconds). <gray>Counts as a lead attack.</gray>

skills.name: Snow Storm
skills.description: Create a Snow Storm at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, foes adjacent to that location are struck for 30...40 cold damage each second.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 30...40 cold damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target foe's initial location.

skills.name: Soldier's Defense
skills.description: For 1...6 second[s], you have a 75% chance to block attacks while under the effects of a shout or chant. You gain 1 strike of adrenaline for each blocked attack.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...6 second[s].) You have 75% chance to block while under the effects of a shout or chant. Block effect: gain 1 adrenaline.

skills.name: Soldier's Fury
skills.description: For 10...35 seconds, if you are under the effects of a chant or a shout, you attack 33% faster and gain 33% more adrenaline, but you have -20 armor.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) You attack 33% faster and gain 33% more adrenaline if under the effects of a shout or chant. <gray>You have -20 armor.</gray>

skills.name: Soldier's Speed
skills.description: For 3...18 seconds, you move 15% faster. You move an additional 15% faster while under the effects of a chant or shout.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...18 seconds.) You move 15% faster and an additional 15% while affected by a chant or shout.

skills.name: Soldier's Stance
skills.description: For 5...15 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block. You attack 33% faster while under the effects of a shout or chant.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.) You have a 75% chance to block. You attack 33% faster while under the effects of a chant or shout.

skills.name: Soldier's Strike
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +10...40 more damage. If you are under the effects of a chant or shout, this attack cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage. Unblockable if you are under the effects of a chant or shout.

skills.name: Song of Concentration
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next skill used by each ally within earshot cannot be interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot are uninterruptible with their next skill.

skills.name: Song of Power
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, each ally within earshot gains 4 Energy regeneration until that ally uses a Skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Allies in earshot gain +4 Energy regeneration. <gray>Ends when using a skill.</gray>

skills.name: Song of Purification
skills.description: For 20 seconds, the next 1...6 skill[s] used by each ally within earshot remove 1 condition from that ally.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) Allies in earshot lose one condition with their next 1...6 skill[s].

skills.name: Song of Restoration
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next time each party member within earshot uses a skill, that party member gains 45...110 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain 45...110 Health with their next skill.

skills.name: Soothing
skills.description: Create a level 1...12 spirit. All foes within its range take twice as long to build adrenaline. This spirit dies after 15...45 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...12 spirit (15...45 second lifespan). Building adrenaline takes twice as long for foes within range.

skills.name: Soothing Images
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes cannot gain adrenaline.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foe adjacent to target. (8...20 seconds). These foes cannot gain adrenaline.

skills.name: Soothing Memories
skills.description: Target ally is healed for 10...100 Health. If you are holding an item, you gain 3 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 10...100. You gain 3 Energy if you are holding an item.

skills.name: Soul Barbs
skills.description: For 30 seconds, target foe takes 15...30 damage when an enchantment or hex is cast on that target.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Deals 15...30 damage when an enchantment or hex is cast on target foe.

skills.name: Soul Bind
skills.description: For 30 seconds, every time target foe is healed, the healer takes 20...80 damage. This hex ends if target is suffering from a Smiting Prayers hex.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Every time target foe is healed, the healer takes 20...80 damage. <gray>Ends if target is suffering from a Smiting Prayers hex.</gray>

skills.name: Soul Feast
skills.description: Exploit nearest corpse to gain 50...280 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 50...280 Health. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse.</gray>

skills.name: Soul Ignition
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, reduce overcast at a rate of 1...2 per second. You and all adjacent foes are afflicted with burning while this enchantment is active.
skills.conciseDescription: Reduce overcast at a rate of 1...2 per second. You and all adjacent foes are afflicted with burning.

skills.name: Soul Leech
skills.description: For 10 seconds, whenever target foe casts a spell, you steal up to 16...80 Health from that foe.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Steal 16...80 Health whenever target foe casts a spell.

skills.name: Soul Taker
skills.description: For 3...30 seconds, your attacks sacrifice 15...20 health and deal 15...20 more damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...30 seconds.) Attacks deal +15...20 damage and sacrifice 15...20 health.

skills.name: Soul Twisting
skills.description: For 5...45 seconds, your Binding Rituals cost 15 less Energy (minimum 5) and recharge instantly. Soul Twisting ends after 1...3 Binding Ritual[s].
skills.conciseDescription: (5...45 seconds.) Your Binding Rituals cost 15 less Energy (minimum 5) and recharge instantly. <gray>Ends after 1...3 Binding Ritual[s].</gray>

skills.name: Spear of Fury (Kurzick)
skills.description: This attack deals +30...40 damage. If this attack hits a foe suffering from a condition, you gain 3...6 strikes of adrenaline.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +30...40 damage. Gain 3...6 strikes of adrenaline if you hit a foe with a condition.

skills.name: Spear of Fury (Luxon)
skills.description: This attack deals +30...40 damage. If this attack hits a foe suffering from a condition, you gain 3...6 strikes of adrenaline.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +30...40 damage. Gain 3...6 strikes of adrenaline if you hit a foe with a condition.

skills.name: Spear of Light
skills.description: Spear of Light flies toward target foe and deals 26...56 holy damage if it hits. Spear of Light deals +15...60 damage if it hits an attacking foe.
skills.conciseDescription: Projectile: deals 26...56 holy damage. Deals 15...60 more damage if target foe is attacking.

skills.name: Spear of Lightning
skills.description: Strikes all foes between you and your target. If this attack hits, it deals +10...20 lightning damage. This attack has 25% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...20 lightning damage. 25% armor penetration. Strikes all foes between you and your target.

skills.name: Spear of Redemption
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If it fails to hit, you lose one condition.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. If it fails to hit, you lose one condition.

skills.name: Spear Swipe
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +5...20 damage and target foe is Dazed for 4...10 seconds. This attack has melee range.
skills.conciseDescription: Spear Melee Attack. Deals +5...20 damage and inflicts Dazed condition (4...10 seconds). <gray>This attack has melee range.</gray>

skills.name: Spell Breaker
skills.description: For 5...17 seconds, target ally cannot be the target of enemy spells.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...17 seconds.) Target ally cannot be the target of enemy spells.

skills.name: Spell Shield
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, while you are casting spells, foes cannot target you with spells. When Spell Shield ends, all your skills are disabled for 8...4 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) While casting spells, you cannot be the target of spells. <gray>End effect: your skills are disabled (8...4 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Spike Trap
skills.description: When Spike Trap is triggered, every second (for 2 seconds), all nearby foes are struck for 10...40 piercing damage, become Crippled for 3...25 seconds, and are knocked down. Spike Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Every second, (for 2 seconds), this trap deals 10...40 piercing damage, causes knockdown, and inflicts Crippled condition (3...25 seconds). <gray>Easily interrupted.</gray>

skills.name: Spinal Shivers
skills.description: For 10...40 seconds, whenever target foe is struck for cold damage while using a skill, that foe is interrupted, and you lose 8...3 Energy or Spinal Shivers ends.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...40 seconds.) Cold damage interrupts target foe's skills. <gray>Interruption cost: you lose 8...3 Energy or Spinal Shivers ends.</gray>

skills.name: Spirit Bond
skills.description: For 8 seconds, whenever target ally takes more than 50 damage from the next 10 attacks or spells, that ally is healed for 30...90 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) Heals for 30...90 whenever target ally takes more than 50 damage. <gray>Ends after this ally takes damage from 10 attacks or spells.</gray>

skills.name: Spirit Boon Strike
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 20...65 lightning damage, and all spirits you control within earshot gain 20...65 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 20...65 lightning damage. Spirits you control within earshot gain 20...65 Health.

skills.name: Spirit Burn
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 5...50 lightning damage. If any spirits are within earshot, Spirit Burn causes Burning for 1...5 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 5...50 lightning damage. Inflicts Burning condition (1...5 second[s]) if you are within earshot of a spirit.

skills.name: Spirit Channeling
skills.description: For 12 seconds, you have +1...6 Energy regeneration. When you cast this spell, you gain 3...12 Energy if you are within earshot of a spirit.
skills.conciseDescription: (12 seconds.) You have +1...6 Energy regeneration. Initial effect: you gain 3...12 Energy if you are within earshot of a spirit.

skills.name: Spirit Light
skills.description: Target ally is healed for 60...180. If any spirits are within earshot, you don't sacrifice Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 60...180. You don't sacrifice Health if you are within earshot of any spirits.

skills.name: Spirit Light Weapon
skills.description: For 10 seconds, target ally gains 5...25 Health per second and an additional 5...25 Health per second if that ally is within earshot of a spirit.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Target ally gains 5...25 Health each second. 5...25 more healing per second while within earshot of a spirit.

skills.name: Spirit of Failure
skills.description: For 30 seconds, target foe has a 25% chance to miss with attacks. You gain 1...3 Energy whenever that foe fails to hit in combat.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Target foe has 25% chance to miss. You gain 1...3 Energy whenever this foe misses.

skills.name: Spirit Rift
skills.description: Open a Spirit Rift at target foe's location. After 3 seconds, all adjacent foes are struck for 25...125 lightning damage and suffer from Cracked Armor for 1...20 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: After 3 seconds, affects foes adjacent to target's initial location. Deals 25...125 lightning damage and inflicts Cracked Armor (1...20 second[s]).

skills.name: Spirit Shackles
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, target foe loses 5 Energy whenever that foe attacks.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20). Target foe loses 5 Energy whenever it attacks.

skills.name: Spirit Siphon
skills.description: The spirit nearest you loses all Energy. You gain 30...60% of that Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: The spirit nearest you loses all Energy. You gain 30...60% of that Energy.

skills.name: Spirit to Flesh
skills.description: Target touched allied spirit is destroyed. All nearby allies are healed for 30...240.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Spell. Destroys target touched allied spirit. Heals nearby allies for 30...240.

skills.name: Spirit Transfer
skills.description: The spirit nearest you loses 5...50 Health. Target ally is healed for 5 for each point of Health lost.
skills.conciseDescription: The spirit nearest you loses 5...50 Health. Heals target ally for 5 for each point of Health lost.

skills.name: Spirit Walk
skills.description: Shadow Step to target spirit.
skills.conciseDescription: Shadow Step to target Spirit. <sic/>

skills.name: Spirit's Gift
skills.description: For 60 seconds, whenever you create a creature, all allies near that creature gain 5...50 Health and lose 1 condition.
skills.conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) Whenever you create a creature, all nearby allies gain 5...50 Health and lose one condition.

skills.name: Spirit's Strength
skills.description: For 15...60 seconds, your attacks deal 5...35 more damage while under the effects of a weapon spell.
skills.conciseDescription: (15...60 seconds.) Your attacks deal +5...35 damage if you are under a weapon spell.

skills.name: Spiritleech Aura
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, all of your spirits within earshot deal 5...20 less damage and steal 5...20 Health when they attack.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) All of your spirits within earshot deal 5...20 less damage and steal 5...20 Health when they attack.

skills.name: Spiritual Pain
skills.description: Target foe takes 15...75 damage. All hostile summoned creatures in the area of that foe take 25...125 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 15...75 damage. Deals 25...125 damage to hostile summoned creatures in the area of your target foe.

skills.name: Spiteful Spirit
skills.description: For 10...25 seconds, whenever target foe attacks or uses a skill, Spiteful Spirit deals 15...45 shadow damage to that foe and all adjacent allies of that foe.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...25 seconds.) Deals 15...45 damage to target and adjacent foes whenever this foe attacks or uses a skill.

skills.name: Splinter Shot
skills.description: If Splinter Shot hits, you deal +3...15 damage. If Splinter Shot is blocked, all foes in the area to your target take 5...65 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +3...15 damage. Deals 5...65 damage to foes in the area if blocked.

skills.name: Splinter Weapon
skills.description: For 20 seconds, target ally has a Splinter Weapon. Target ally's next 1...5 attack[s] deal 5...50 damage to up to 4 adjacent foes.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) Attacks deal 5...50 damage to 3 <sic/> adjacent foes. <gray>Ends after 1...5 attack[s].</gray>

skills.name: Spoil Victor
skills.description: For 3...15 seconds, whenever target foe attacks or casts a spell on a creature with less Health, that foe loses 25...100 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...15 seconds.) Causes 25...100 Health loss whenever target foe attacks or casts spells on a creature with less Health.

skills.name: Spotless Mind
skills.description: For 1...15 seconds, target other ally loses a hex every 5 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...15 seconds.) Removes a hex every 5 seconds. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Spotless Soul
skills.description: For 1...15 seconds, target other ally loses a condition every 3 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...15 seconds.) Removes a condition every 3 seconds. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

skills.name: Sprint
skills.description: For 8...14 seconds, you move 25% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...14 seconds.) You move 25% faster.

skills.name: Staggering Blow
skills.description: If this hammer blow hits, your target will suffer from Weakness for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Weakness condition (5...20 seconds).

skills.name: Staggering Force
skills.description: All nearby foes are struck for 10...40 earth damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal earth damage. When this enchantment ends, all nearby foes have Cracked Armor for 1...10 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Your attacks deal earth damage. Initial effect: deals 10...40 earth damage to nearby foes. End effect: inflicts Cracked Armor condition (1...10 second[s]) on nearby foes.

skills.name: Standing Slash
skills.description: If it hits, Standing Slash deals +5...20 damage plus an additional 5...20 damage if you are in a stance.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Deals 5...20 more damage if you are in a stance.

skills.name: Star Burst
skills.description: Target touched foe and all foes in the area are struck for 7...112 fire damage and set on fire for 1...4 second[s]. For each foe you hit, gain 2 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Elite Touch Spell. Deals 7...112 fire damage. Inflicts Burning (1...4 seconds). <sic/> Gain 2 Energy for each foe struck. Also hits foes in the area.

skills.name: Steady Stance
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next time you would be knocked down, you gain 1...4 strike[s] of adrenaline and 1...7 Energy instead.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) The next time you would be knocked-down, you gain 1...4 adrenaline and 1...7 Energy instead.

skills.name: Steam
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 20...60 cold damage. If target foe is on fire, Steam Blinds that foe for 5...10 seconds and they take an additional 20...60 fire damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 20...60 cold damage. Inflicts Blindness condition (5...10 seconds) and does 20...60 fire damage if target foe is Burning.

skills.name: Steelfang Slash
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +1...31 damage. If you hit a foe that is knocked down, you gain 1...5 adrenaline.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +1...31 damage. You gain 1...5 adrenaline if target foe is knocked down.

skills.name: Stolen Speed
skills.description: For 1...10 seconds, spells cast by the target foe and all adjacent foes take 100% longer to cast. Spells targeting these foes that are cast by you or your allies take 50% less time to cast.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes adjacent foes (1...10 seconds). Doubles spell casting time. Spells cast by you or your allies have -50% casting times.

skills.name: Stone Daggers
skills.description: Send out two Stone Daggers. Each Stone Dagger strikes target foe for 8...33 earth damage if it hits. If you are Overcast, each projectile inflicts Bleeding for 1...5 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Two projectiles: each deals 8...33 earth damage. If Overcast, cause Bleeding for 1...5 second[s].

skills.name: Stone Sheath
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, you and target ally have +1...30 armor and are immune to critical hits. When you cast this spell, all foes near you and your target take 15...70 earth damage and are Weakened for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Gives you and target ally +1...30 armor and immunity to critical hits. Initial effect: Foes near you and target ally are struck for 15...70 earth damage and are Weakened (5...20 seconds).

skills.name: Stone Striker
skills.description: For 5...30 seconds, whenever you take or deal elemental or physical damage, that damage is converted to earth damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...30 seconds.) Converts elemental and physical damage you take or deal to earth damage.

skills.name: Stoneflesh Aura
skills.description: For 5...15 seconds, damage you receive is reduced by 1...31, and you are immune to critical attacks.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.) Reduces damage you take by 1...31, and you are immune to critical hits.

skills.name: Stonesoul Strike
skills.description: Touched target foe takes 10...55 holy damage. If knocked down, your target takes an additional 10...55 holy damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Deals 10...55 holy damage. Deals 10...55 more holy damage if target is knocked down.

skills.name: Stoning
skills.description: Send out a large stone, striking target foe for 45...105 earth damage if it hits. If Stoning hits a foe suffering from Weakness, that foe is knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Projectile: deals 45...105 earth damage. Causes knock-down if target foe is Weakened.

skills.name: Storm Chaser
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, you move 25% faster, and you gain 1...5 Energy whenever you take elemental damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) You move 25% faster and gain 1...5 Energy whenever you take elemental damage.

skills.name: Storm Djinn's Haste
skills.description: For 10...25 seconds, you move 25% faster. Each second that you are moving, you lose 1 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...25 seconds.) You move 25% faster. <gray>Lose 1 Energy each second while moving.</gray>

skills.name: Storm's Embrace
skills.description: For 10 seconds, you move 25% faster. This stance is refreshed whenever you take Elemental damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) You move 25% faster. Renewal: whenever you take elemental damage.

skills.name: Strength of Honor
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, target ally deals 5...25 more damage in melee.
skills.conciseDescription: Target ally deals 5...25 more damage in melee.

skills.name: Strike as One
skills.description: Your animal companion instantly moves to your target and causes Bleeding for 5...15 seconds with its next attack. The next time you hit with an attack, target foe is Crippled for 5...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Your animal companion instantly moves to your target and inflicts Bleeding (5...15 seconds) with its next attack. The next time you hit with an attack, you inflict Crippled condition (5...15 seconds).

skills.name: Strip Enchantment
skills.description: Remove 0...2 enchantment[s] from target foe. If an enchantment is removed, you steal 5...65 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Removes 0...2 enchantment[s] from target foe. Removal effect: you steal 5...65 Health.

skills.name: Stunning Strike
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +10...50 damage. If it hits a foe suffering from a condition, that foe is also Dazed for 4...10 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...50 damage. Inflicts Dazed condition (4...10 seconds) if target has a condition.

skills.name: Succor
skills.description: While you maintain this Enchantment, target other ally gains +1 Health and +1 Energy regeneration, but you lose 1 Energy each time that ally casts a Spell.
skills.conciseDescription: +1 Health regeneration and +1 Energy regeneration. <gray>Cannot self-target. You lose 1 Energy each time target ally casts a spell.</gray>

skills.name: Suffering
skills.description: For 6...30 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer -0...3 Health degeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes near target (6...30 seconds). These foes have -0...3 Health degeneration.

skills.name: Sum of All Fears
skills.description: For 4...12 second[s], target foe moves, attacks, and casts spells 33% slower.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...12 second[s].) Target foe moves, attacks, and casts spells 33% slower.

skills.name: Summon Ice Imp
skills.description: Summon a level 14...20 Ice Imp that lives for 40...60 seconds and has Ice Spikes. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.
skills.conciseDescription: Summon a level 14...20 Ice Imp (40...60 lifespan) that has Ice Spikes. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.

skills.name: Summon Mursaat
skills.description: Summon a level 14...20 Mursaat that lives for 40...60 seconds and has Enervating Charge. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active at a time.
skills.conciseDescription: Summon a level 14...20 Mursaat (40...60 lifespan) that has Enervating Charge. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.

skills.name: Summon Naga Shaman
skills.description: Summon a level 14...20 Naga Shaman that lives for 40...60 seconds and has Stoning. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.
skills.conciseDescription: Summon a level 14...20 Naga Shaman (40...60 lifespan) that has Stoning. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.

skills.name: Summon Ruby Djinn
skills.description: Summon a level 14...20 Ruby Djinn that lives for 40...60 seconds and has Immolate. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active at a time.
skills.conciseDescription: Summon a level 14...20 Ruby Djinn (40...60 lifespan) that has Immolate. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.

skills.name: Summon Spirits (Kurzick)
skills.description: All spirits you control Shadow Step to your location, and gain 60...100 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Spirits you control Shadow Step to your location and gain 60...100 Health.

skills.name: Summon Spirits (Luxon)
skills.description: All spirits you control Shadow Step to your location, and gain 60...100 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Spirits you control Shadow Step to your location and gain 60...100 Health.

skills.name: Sun and Moon Slash
skills.description: Attack target foe twice. These attacks cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: You attack target foe twice. Unblockable.

skills.name: Sundering Attack
skills.description: If Sundering Attack hits, you strike for +5...25 damage and this attack has 10% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...25 damage. 10% armor penetration.

skills.name: Sundering Weapon
skills.description: For 4...10 seconds, target ally's next 3 attacks have 10% armor penetration and cause Cracked Armor for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...10 seconds.) Target ally's next 3 attacks inflict Cracked Armor condition (5...20 seconds) and have 10% armor penetration.

skills.name: Sunspear Rebirth Signet
skills.description: Resurrect target dead party member at your location with full Health and 10% Energy for each Sunspear rank you have attained. This signet can only be used once per mission unless recharged by a morale boost.
skills.conciseDescription: Resurrect target dead ally <sic/> at your location (full Health and 10% Energy for each Sunspear Rank attained). <gray>This signet only recharges when you gain a morale boost.</gray>

skills.name: Supportive Spirit
skills.description: For 5...23 seconds, whenever target ally takes damage while knocked down, that ally is healed for 5...50 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...23 seconds.) Heals for 5...50 whenever target ally takes damage while knocked-down.

skills.name: Swap
skills.description: You and target summoned creature Shadow Step to each other's location.
skills.conciseDescription: You and target summoned creature Shadow Step to each other's locations.

skills.name: Swift Chop
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +1...20 damage. If Swift Chop is blocked, target foe takes 1...20 damage and suffers a Deep Wound for 20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +1...20 damage. Deals 1...20 damage and inflicts Deep Wound condition (20 seconds) if blocked.

skills.name: Swift Javelin
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If you are under the effects of an enchantment, this spear flies twice as fast and cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. This spear moves twice as fast and is unblockable if you are enchanted.

skills.name: Swirling Aura
skills.description: For 3...7 second[s], you are enchanted with Swirling Aura and have 1...6 Health regeneration and a 50% chance to block projectiles. If you are Overcast when you cast this spell, all party members in earshot are also enchanted.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...7 second[s].) Gives 1...6 Health regeneration and a 50% chance to block projectiles. If Overcast, also enchants party members in earshot.

skills.name: Symbiosis
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. For each enchantment on a non-spirit creature within range, that creature has +27...150 maximum Health. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). Creatures in range have +27...150 maximum health for each enchantment on them. Does not affect spirits.

skills.name: Symbiotic Bond
skills.description: For 120...300 seconds, your animal companion gains 1...3 Health regeneration, and half of all damage dealt to your animal companion is redirected to you.
skills.conciseDescription: (120...300 seconds.) Your pet has +1...3 Health regeneration. Half of all damage dealt to your pet is redirected to you.

skills.name: Symbol of Wrath
skills.description: Create a Symbol of Wrath at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, adjacent foes are struck for 10...40 holy damage each second.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...40 holy damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target foe's initial location.

skills.name: Symbolic Celerity
skills.description: For 36...60 seconds, all of your signets use your Fast Casting attribute instead of their normal attributes.
skills.conciseDescription: (36...60 seconds.) Your signets use your Fast Casting attribute.

skills.name: Symbolic Posture
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, the next signet you activate recharges 20...80% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Your next signet recharges 20...80% faster.

skills.name: Symbolic Strike
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +12 damage for each signet you have equipped (maximum 70 damage).
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +12 damage (maximum 70) for each signet you have equipped.

skills.name: Symbols of Inspiration
skills.description: For 6...40 seconds, this skill becomes the Elite of target foe. Elite skills you cast use your Fast Casting attribute instead of their normal attributes.
skills.conciseDescription: (6...40 seconds.) This skill becomes the Elite of target foe. Elite skills you cast use your Fast Casting attribute instead of their normal attributes.

skills.name: Sympathetic Visage
skills.description: For 4...10 seconds, whenever target ally is hit by a melee attack, all adjacent foes lose all adrenaline and 3 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...10 seconds.) All adjacent foes lose all adrenaline and 3 Energy whenever a melee attack hits target ally.

skills.name: Tainted Flesh
skills.description: For 20...44 seconds, allies in the area are immune to disease, and anyone striking those allies in melee becomes Diseased for 3...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (20...44 seconds.) Foes who hit allies in the area in melee become Diseased (3...15 seconds); this ally is immune to Disease.

skills.name: Taste of Death
skills.description: Steal up to 100...400 Health from target animated undead ally.
skills.conciseDescription: Steals 100...400 Health from allied undead servant.

skills.name: Taste of Pain
skills.description: If target foe is below 50% Health, you gain 30...150 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals you for 30...150. <gray>No effect unless target foe is below 50% Health.</gray>

skills.name: Tease
skills.description: If target foe is using a skill, that foe and other foes in the area are interrupted and you steal 0...5 Energy from all foes in the area.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts a skill. Interruption effect: also interrupts other foes in the area, and you steal 0...5 Energy from all foes in the area.

skills.name: Technobabble
skills.description: Target foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 30...40 damage. If target foe is not a boss, that foe and all adjacent foes are Dazed for 3...5 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 30...40 damage to target and adjacent foes. Inflicts Dazed condition (3...5 seconds) on these foes if target was not a boss.

skills.name: Teinai's Crystals
skills.description: Target foe takes 20...40 damage. If target foe has a Water Magic hex, this spell strikes target and nearby foes for an additional 20...40 damage, and nearby foes also suffer Cracked Armor for 5...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 20...40 damage to target. Deals +20...40 more <sic/> damage and causes Cracked Armor (5...15 seconds) nearby if that foe had a Water Magic hex.

skills.name: Teinai's Heat
skills.description: Place a ward of Teinai's Heat at your location for 10...15 seconds. Foes within the ward suffer 2...5 health <sic/> degeneration. Weakened foes attack 33% slower. This skill is disabled for 20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...15 seconds.) Causes -2...5 health <sic/> degeneration. Weakened foes in the ward attack 33% slower. Disabled for 20 seconds.

skills.name: Teinai's Prison
skills.description: For 1...8 second[s], target foe's legs are encased in ice, causing the foe to move 66% slower. If that foe has Cracked Armor, the chill seeps through causing 5...9 Health degeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...8 second[s].) Target foe moves 66% slower. Foes with Cracked Armor have 5...9 Health degeneration.

skills.name: Teinai's Wind
skills.description: Target foe and all adjacent foes take 10...40 cold damage. Burning foes struck by Teinai's Wind take an additional 40...80 damage and are interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...40 cold damage. Burning foes take +40...80 damage and are interrupted. Also strikes adjacent.

skills.name: Temple Strike
skills.description: Must follow a lead attack. If this attack hits, target foe is Dazed and Blinded for 1...10 seconds, and if target foe is casting a spell, that foe is interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: Interrupts a spell. Inflicts Dazed and Blindness conditions (1...10 seconds). <gray>Must follow a lead attack.</gray>

skills.name: Test of Faith
skills.description: Deals 15...75 cold damage and takes 1 enchantment from target foe. If that foe was not enchanted, that foe is Dazed for 2...6 second[s].
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Spell. Deals 15...75 cold damage and removes 1 enchantment. Target foe is Dazed for 2...6 second[s] if that foe was not enchanted.

skills.name: Thrill of Victory
skills.description: If this blow hits, you deal +20...40 damage. If you have more Health than target foe, you gain 1...2 strike[s] of adrenaline.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +20...40 damage. If you have more Health than your target, you gain 1...2 adrenaline.

skills.name: Throw Dirt
skills.description: Target touched foe and foes adjacent to your target become Blinded for 3...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Inflicts Blindness condition (3...15 seconds). Also affects foes adjacent to target foe.

skills.name: Thunderclap
skills.description: Create a massive shockwave at target foe's location. Deals 10...50 lightning damage to target and all nearby foes. Struck foes are interrupted and suffer from Cracked Armor and Weakness for 5...20 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...50 lightning damage. Also strikes nearby foes. Inflicts Cracked Armor and Weakness (5...20 seconds). Causes interrupt. 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Tiger Stance
skills.description: For 4...10 seconds, you attack 33% faster. Tiger Stance ends if any of your attacks fail to hit.
skills.conciseDescription: (4...10 seconds.) You attack 33% faster. <gray>Ends if you fail to hit.</gray>

skills.name: Tiger's Fury
skills.description: All your non-attack skills are disabled for 5 seconds. For 5...11 seconds, you attack 25% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) You attack 25% faster. <gray>Disables your non-attack skills (5 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Time Ward
skills.description: You create a Time Ward at your location. For 6...20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area cast spells 15...20% faster and recharge skills 15...20% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (6...20 seconds.) Allies in this ward cast spells 15...20% faster and recharge skills 15...20% faster. <gray>Allied spirits are not affected. PvE Skill</gray>

skills.name: Touch of Agony
skills.description: Target touched foe takes 20...58 shadow damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Deals 20...58 damage.

skills.name: Toxic Chill
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 15...75 cold damage. If that foe is under the effects of a hex or enchantment, that foe becomes Poisoned for 10...25 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 15...75 cold damage. Inflicts Poisoned condition (10...25 seconds) if target foe is hexed or enchanted.

skills.name: Toxicity
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. Poisoned or Diseased creatures within its range suffer -2 Health degeneration. This spirit dies after 30...180 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...180 second lifespan.) Poisoned or Diseased creatures within range have -2 Health degeneration.

skills.name: Trampling Ox
skills.description: Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If you a <sic/> hit a Crippled foe, that foe is knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage; causes knock-down if target foe is Crippled. <gray>Must follow an off-hand attack.</gray>

skills.name: Tranquil Was Tanasen
skills.description: Hold Tanasen's ashes for up to 5...20 seconds. While you hold his ashes, you have +10...25 armor and cannot be interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) You have +10...25 armor. You cannot be interrupted.

skills.name: Tranquility
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. Enchantments cast by non-spirit creatures within its range expire 20...50% faster. This spirit dies after 15...120 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (15...120 second lifespan). Enchantments expire 20...50% faster on creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.

skills.name: Trapper's Focus
skills.description: For 12...36 seconds, your trap skills are not easily interruptible and your Wilderness Survival attribute is increased by +0...4.
skills.conciseDescription: (12...36 seconds.) Your trap skills are no longer easy to interrupt. You gain +0...4 to your Wilderness Survival attribute.

skills.name: Trapper's Speed
skills.description: For 5...30 seconds, your Traps recharge 25% faster and activate 25% faster. This Stance ends if you successfully hit with an attack.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...30 seconds.) Your traps recharge 25% faster and activate 25% faster. <gray>Ends if you hit with an attack.</gray>

skills.name: Triple Chop
skills.description: Attack target foe and adjacent foes. Each attack that hits deals +10...40 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage. Also hits adjacent foes.

skills.name: Triple Shot (Kurzick)
skills.description: Shoot 3 arrows simultaneously at target foe. These arrows deal 40...25% less damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Shoot 3 arrows simultaneously at target foe. <gray>These arrows deal 40...25% less damage</gray>

skills.name: Triple Shot (Luxon)
skills.description: Shoot 3 arrows simultaneously at target foe. These arrows deal 40...25% less damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Shoot 3 arrows simultaneously at target foe. <gray>These arrows deal 40...25% less damage</gray>

skills.name: Tripwire
skills.description: When Tripwire is triggered, all nearby foes are struck for 5...20 piercing damage. Any Crippled foes are knocked down. Tripwire ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: (90 seconds.) Deals 5...20 piercing damage to nearby foes. Causes knock-down to Crippled foes. <gray>Easily interrupted.</gray>

skills.name: Troll Unguent
skills.description: For 13 seconds, you gain +3...10 Health regeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (13 seconds.) You have +3...10 Health regeneration.

skills.name: Tryptophan Signet
skills.description: For 14...20 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes move and attack 23...40% slower.
skills.conciseDescription: (14...20 seconds.) Target and adjacent foes move and attack 23...40% slower.

skills.name: Twin Moon Sweep
skills.description: You lose 1 Dervish enchantment and gain 10...50 Health. If an enchantment is lost in this way, you cannot be blocked, you strike twice, and you gain an additional 10...70 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Gain 10...50 Health. Removal effect: unblockable, attack twice, and gain 10...70 more Health.

skills.name: Twisting Fangs
skills.description: Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, Twisting Fangs strikes for +10...20 damage and struck foe suffers from Bleeding and Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...20 damage. Inflicts Bleeding and Deep Wound conditions (5...20 seconds). <gray>Must follow an off-hand attack.</gray>

skills.name: Ulcerous Lungs
skills.description: For 10...30 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer from -4 Health degeneration when Bleeding, and whenever they use a shout or chant, they Bleed for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes near your target (10...30 seconds). Causes -4 Health degeneration to any of these foes that are Bleeding. Inflicts Bleeding (5...20 seconds) whenever these foes use a shout or chant.

skills.name: Unblockable Throw
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +10...40 damage. This attack cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage. Unblockable.

skills.name: Unholy Feast
skills.description: Steal up to 10...65 Health from up to 1...4 foes <sic/> in the area.
skills.conciseDescription: Steals 10...65 Health from 1...4 foe[s] in the area around you.

skills.name: Union
skills.description: Create a level 1...12 spirit. Whenever a non-spirit ally in its range takes damage or life steal, it is reduced by 15 and the spirit takes 15 damage. This spirit dies after 30...60 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...12 spirit (30...60 second lifespan). Whenever a non-spirit ally within range takes damage or life steal, it is reduced by 15 and the spirit takes 15 damage.

skills.name: Unnatural Signet
skills.description: Target foe takes 15...75 damage. If that foe is under the effects of a hex or enchantment, foes adjacent to your target take 5...50 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 15...75 damage. Deals 5...50 damage to other adjacent foes if the target is hexed or enchanted.

skills.name: Unseen Fury
skills.description: All adjacent foes are Blinded for 3...10 seconds. For 10...30 seconds, you cannot be blocked by Blinded foes.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Blindness condition on adjacent foes (3...10). You cannot be blocked by Blinded foes for 10...30 seconds.

skills.name: Unsteady Ground
skills.description: You create Unsteady Ground at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, nearby foes take 10...40 earth damage each second. Attacking foes struck by Unsteady Ground are knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...40 earth damage each second (5 seconds) and causes knock-down to attacking foes. Hits foes near target's initial location.

skills.name: Unsuspecting Strike
skills.description: If this attack hits, you strike for +19...31 damage. If your target was above 90% Health you deal an additional 15...75 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +19...31 damage. Deals 15...75 more damage if target foe's Health is above 90%.

skills.name: Unyielding Aura
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, your Monk spells heal for +15...60% more Health. When this enchantment ends one random other party member is resurrected with full Health and Energy and teleported to your location.
skills.conciseDescription: Your Monk spells heal for +15...60%. End effect: a random other party member is resurrected with full Health and Energy and teleported to your location.

skills.name: Ursan Blessing
skills.description: You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the bear. For 60 seconds, you have 100 armor and 750...800 Health. All your attributes are set to 0 and bear attacks replace your skills.
skills.conciseDescription: You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the bear (60 seconds). All your attributes are set to 0 and bear attacks replace your skills, and you have 100 armor and 750...800 Health.

skills.name: Vampiric Assault
skills.description: Must follow an off-hand attack. If this attack hits, you steal 10...40 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Steals 10...40 Health if this attack hits. <gray>Must follow an off-hand attack.</gray>

skills.name: Vampiric Bite
skills.description: Touch target foe to steal up to 29...74 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Steals 29...74 Health.

skills.name: Vampiric Gaze
skills.description: Steal up to 18...60 Health from target foe.
skills.conciseDescription: Steals 18...60 Health.

skills.name: Vampiric Spirit
skills.description: Steal up to 15...60 Health from target foe. For 10 seconds, you have +5...10 Health regeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: Steal 15...60 Health from target foe. You have +5...10 Health regeneration (10 seconds).

skills.name: Vampiric Swarm
skills.description: Vampiric Swarm steals up to 15...60 Health from up to three foes in the area.
skills.conciseDescription: Steals 15...60 Health. Hits 2 additional foes in the area.

skills.name: Vampiric Touch
skills.description: Touch target foe to steal up to 29...74 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Steals 29...74 Health.

skills.name: Vampirism
skills.description: Create a level 4...14 spirit that dies after 75...150 seconds. Attacks by this spirit steal up to 10...20 Health, and you are healed for 10...20 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 4...14 spirit (lifespan 75...150 seconds). Its attacks steal 10...20 Health, and you are healed for 10...20.

skills.name: Vapor Blade
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 15...135 cold damage. Vapor Blade deals half damage if that foe has any enchantments on them.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 15...135 cold damage. Half damage if target foe is enchanted.

skills.name: Veil of Thorns
skills.description: When you cast this enchantment, all nearby foes are struck for 5...50 piercing damage. For 5...25 seconds you take 5...35% less damage from spells.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...25 seconds.) Spell damage is reduced by 5...35%. Initial Effect: nearby foes are struck for 5...50 piercing damage.

skills.name: Vengeance
skills.description: Bring target dead party member back to life at full Health and full Energy. For 30 seconds, that party member deals 25% more damage. When this enchantment ends, target party member dies. Deaths while under the effects of this enchantment do not incur a death penalty.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Resurrects target party member (full Health, full Energy). This ally deals 25% more damage and does not incur death penalty. <gray>End effect: this ally dies.</gray>

skills.name: Vengeful Was Khanhei
skills.description: Hold Khanhei's ashes for 5...11 seconds. Whenever a foe strikes you in combat while you are holding Khanhei's ashes, you steal 10...45 Health from that foe.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) You steal 10...45 Health from every foe that hits you with an attack.

skills.name: Vengeful Weapon
skills.description: For 8 seconds, the next time target ally takes damage or life steal from a foe, that ally steals up to 15...60 Health from that foe.
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) Steals 15...60 Health from the next foe that deals damage or life steal to target ally.

skills.name: Verata's Aura
skills.description: All hostile animated undead in the area become bound to you. Verata's Aura ends after 120...300 seconds. When Verata's Aura ends, you lose your bond with any undead bound to you. (50% failure chance with Death Magic 4 or less.)
skills.conciseDescription: (120...300 seconds.) Become master of all hostile undead servants in the area. <gray>End effect: your undead servants become masterless. 50% failure chance unless Death Magic 5 or more.</gray>

skills.name: Verata's Gaze
skills.description: If target hostile animated undead has a master, its bond to its master is broken, making it hostile to all other creatures. If it had no master, you become its master and heal it for 60...80. (50% failure chance with Death Magic 4 or less.)
skills.conciseDescription: Make target undead servant masterless. If it is already masterless, you become its master and heal it for 60...80. <gray>50% failure chance unless Death Magic 5 or more.</gray>

skills.name: Verata's Sacrifice
skills.description: For 5...10 seconds, your undead allies gain +10 Health regeneration. All conditions are removed from those allies and transferred to you. If this spell is successful and you have control of 3 or fewer minions, Verata's Sacrifice instantly recharges.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...10 seconds.) 10 undead allied servants gain +10 Health regeneration. Instantly recharges if you have control of 3 or fewer servants. <gray>Transfers all conditions from those servants to you.</gray>

skills.name: Vicious Attack
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If you land a critical hit with this attack, target foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...15 seconds) with a critical hit.

skills.name: Victorious Sweep
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +5...25 damage. If target foe has less Health than you, you gain 30...80 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...25 damage. You gain 30...80 Health for each foe you hit that has less Health than you.

skills.name: Vigorous Spirit
skills.description: For 30 seconds, each time target ally attacks or casts a spell, that ally is healed for 5...20 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Heals for 5...20 each time target ally attacks or casts a spell.

skills.name: Vile Miasma
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 10...65 cold damage. If suffering from a condition, that foe is hexed with Vile Miasma and suffers -1...5 Health degeneration for 10 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Causes -1...5 Health degeneration (10 seconds). Initial effect: deals 10...65 cold damage. <gray>Hex is only applied if target foe has a condition.</gray>

skills.name: Vile Touch
skills.description: Touch target foe to deal 20...65 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Deals 20...65 damage.

skills.name: Viper's Defense
skills.description: All adjacent foes are Poisoned for 5...20 seconds. Shadow Step to a nearby location directly away from your target.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflict Poisoned condition (5...20 seconds) on all adjacent foes and Shadow Step to a nearby location directly away from your target.

skills.name: Viper's Nest
skills.description: Create a Viper's Nest. When it is triggered, all nearby foes are struck for 5...35 piercing damage and become Poisoned for 5...20 seconds. Viper's Nest expires after 90 seconds. This Trap is easily interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals 5...35 piercing damage. Inflicts Poisoned condition (5...20 seconds). <gray>Easily interrupted.</gray>

skills.name: Virulence
skills.description: If target foe was already suffering from a condition, that foe suffers from Disease, Poison, and Weakness for 3...15 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Inflicts Disease, Poison, and Weakness conditions (3...15 seconds). <gray>No effect unless this foe already had a condition.</gray>

skills.name: Visions of Regret
skills.description: For 10 seconds, target foe and adjacent foes take 15...45 damage whenever they use a skill and 5...50 additional damage if not under the effects of another Mesmer hex.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes adjacent to target (10 seconds). These foes take 15...45 damage whenever they use a skill and 5...50 additional damage if not under the effects of another Mesmer hex.

skills.name: Vital Blessing
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, target ally has +40...200 maximum Health.
skills.conciseDescription: +40...200 maximum Health.

skills.name: Vital Boon
skills.description: For 20 seconds, you have +40...100 maximum Health. When this enchantment ends, you are healed for 75...200 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) You have +40...100 maximum Health. End effect: Heals you for 75...200.

skills.name: Vital Weapon
skills.description: For 5...30 seconds, target ally has a Vital Weapon and has +40...175 maximum Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...30 seconds.) +40...175 maximum Health.

skills.name: Vocal Minority
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes cannot use shouts or chants.
skills.conciseDescription: Also hexes foes near target (5...20 seconds). These foes cannot use shouts or chants.

skills.name: Vocal Was Sogolon
skills.description: For 60 seconds, all shouts and chants you use last 20...50% longer.
skills.conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) Shouts and chants you use last 20...50% longer.

skills.name: Volfen Blessing
skills.description: You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the wolf. For 60 seconds, you have 80 armor, 660...700 Health, and 2...4 Health regeneration. All your attributes are set to 0 and wolf attacks replace your skills.
skills.conciseDescription: You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the wolf (60 seconds). All your attributes are set to 0 and wolf attacks replace your skills, and you have 80 armor, 660...700 Health and 2...4 Health regeneration.

skills.name: Volley
skills.description: All your Preparations are removed. Shoot arrows at target foe and up to 3 foes adjacent to your target. These arrows strike for +1...10 damage if they hit.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +1...10 damage. Hits up to 3 foes adjacent to your target. <gray>All your preparations are removed.</gray>

skills.name: Vow of Piety
skills.description: For 20 seconds, you have +24 armor and +1...4 Health regeneration. Vow of Piety renews whenever an enchantment on you ends.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds) +24 armor and +1...4 Health regeneration. Renewal: Whenever an enchantment on you ends.

skills.name: Vow of Revolution
skills.description: For 3...10 seconds, you have +1...6 energy regeneration. This skill reapplies itself every time you use a non-Dervish skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...10 seconds.) Gain +1...6 energy regeneration. Renewal: whenever you use a non-Dervish skill.

skills.name: Vow of Silence
skills.description: For 5...10 seconds, you cannot be the target of spells, and you cannot cast spells.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...10 seconds.) Spells cannot target you. <gray>You cannot cast spells.</gray>

skills.name: Vow of Strength
skills.description: For 15 seconds, whenever you attack a foe with your scythe, you deal 10...25 slashing damage to all adjacent foes.
skills.conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) When you attack with a scythe, deals 10...25 slashing damage to adjacent foes.

skills.name: Wail of Doom
skills.description: For 2...6 second[s], all of target foe's attributes are set to 0.
skills.conciseDescription: (2...6 second[s].) Target foe's attributes are 0.

skills.name: Wailing Weapon
skills.description: For 3...14 seconds, target ally has a Wailing Weapon. Whenever the Wailing Weapon strikes an attacking foe, that foe is interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...14 seconds.) Attacks interrupt attacking foes.

skills.name: Wallow's Bite
skills.description: Target touched foe takes 20...58 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Deals 20...58 damage.

skills.name: Wandering Eye
skills.description: For 4 seconds, the next time target foe attacks, that attack is interrupted and all nearby foes take 30...110 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (4 seconds.) Interrupts target foe's next attack. Interruption effect: 30...110 damage to nearby foes.

skills.name: Wanderlust
skills.description: Create a level 1...12 spirit. Whenever this spirit's attack hits a stationary foe, that foe is knocked down and the spirit loses 70...50 Health. This spirit dies after 30...60 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...12 spirit (30...60 second lifespan). Its attacks against stationary foes cause knock-down. <gray>Knock-down cost: this spirit loses 70...50 Health.</gray>

skills.name: Ward Against Elements
skills.description: You create a Ward Against Elements at your current location. For 8...20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area gain +24 armor against elemental damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) Allies in this ward have +24 armor against elemental damage. <gray>Spirits are unaffected.</gray>

skills.name: Ward Against Foes
skills.description: You create a Ward Against Foes at your current location. For 8...20 seconds, non-spirit foes in this area move 50% slower.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) Foes in this ward move 50% slower.

skills.name: Ward Against Harm
skills.description: Create a Ward Against Harm at this location. For 5...15 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area have +1...3 health regeneration, +12...24 armor, and an additional +12...24 armor against elemental damage. This spell is disabled for 20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: <sic/>(5...15 seconds.) Allies in this ward have +1...3 Health regeneration, +12...24 armor, and +12...24 additional armor against elemental damage. <gray>Spirits are unaffected. This spell is disabled for 20 seconds.</gray>

skills.name: Ward Against Melee
skills.description: You create a Ward Against Melee at your current location. For 5...20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area have a 50% chance to block melee attacks.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Allies in this ward have a 50% chance to block melee attacks. <gray>Allied spirits are not affected.</gray>

skills.name: Ward of Stability
skills.description: Create a Ward of Stability at your current location. For 10...25 seconds, non-spirit allies cannot be knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...25 seconds.) Allies in this ward cannot be knocked-down. <gray>Allied spirits are not affected.</gray>

skills.name: Ward of Weakness
skills.description: You create a Ward of Weakness at your current location. For 5...20 seconds, foes in this area become Weakened for 5...20 seconds whenever they take elemental damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds). Inflicts Weakened condition (5...20 seconds) to any foes that take elemental damage in this ward.

skills.name: Warmonger's Weapon
skills.description: For 3...13 seconds, if target ally attacks a foe who is not attacking, that foe is interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...13 seconds.) Attacks interrupt an action. Does not interrupt attacking foes.

skills.name: Warrior's Cunning
skills.description: For 5...11 seconds, your melee attacks cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) Your melee attacks are unblockable.

skills.name: Warrior's Endurance
skills.description: For 5...35 seconds, you gain 3 Energy each time you hit with a melee attack. Warrior's Endurance cannot raise your Energy above 10...25.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...35 seconds.) You gain 3 Energy each time you hit with a melee attack. <gray>No Energy gain if you have more than 10...25 Energy.</gray>

skills.name: Wary Stance
skills.description: For 1...6 second[s], you block any attack skills used against you. For each successful block, you gain adrenaline and 5 Energy. Wary Stance ends if you use a skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...6 second[s]). You block attack skills. Gain adrenaline and 5 Energy for each block. <gray>Ends if you use a skill.</gray>

skills.name: Waste Not, Want Not
skills.description: If target foe is not casting a spell or attacking, you gain 8...13 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: You gain 8...13 Energy if target foe is not attacking or casting a spell.

skills.name: Wastrel's Collapse
skills.description: Shadow Step to target foe. If target foe is not using a skill, that foe is knocked down. All of your non-dagger attack skills are disabled for 10 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Shadow Step to target foe. Causes knock-down if target foe is not using a skill. <gray>Disables your non-dagger attack skills (10 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Wastrel's Demise
skills.description: For 5 seconds, target foe is hexed with Wastrel's Demise. Each second while hexed, target foe and all foes adjacent to that foe take 1...10 damage and an additional 1...10 damage for each second this spell is in effect. This hex ends prematurely if target foe uses a skill.
skills.conciseDescription: (5 seconds.) Each second while hexed, target foe and all foes adjacent to that foe take 1...10 damage. Foes take +1...10 damage each second this hex is in effect. <gray>Ends early if target foe uses a skill.</gray>

skills.name: Wastrel's Worry
skills.description: After 3 seconds, target foe takes 20...100 damage and all adjacent foes take 75% of that damage. If that foe successfully uses a skill, Wastrel's Worry ends prematurely and does no damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (3 seconds). End effect: causes 20...100 damage to target and 75% of that damage to adjacent foes. <gray>No effect and ends early if target foe uses a skill.</gray>

skills.name: Watchful Healing
skills.description: For 10 seconds, target ally gains +1...4 Health regeneration. If this skill ends prematurely, that ally gains 30...120 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Target ally has +1...4 Health regeneration and gains 30...120 Health if this enchantment ends early.

skills.name: Watchful Intervention
skills.description: For 60 seconds, the next time damage drops target ally's Health below 25%, that ally is healed for 50...200 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) Heals for 50...200 the next time damage drops target ally's Health below 25%.

skills.name: Watchful Spirit
skills.description: While you maintain this enchantment, target ally gains +2 Health regeneration. That ally is healed for 30...180 Health when Watchful Spirit ends.
skills.conciseDescription: +2 Health regeneration. End effect: heals for 30...180.

skills.name: Water Attunement
skills.description: For 36...60 seconds, you are attuned to Water. You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the base Energy cost of the skill each time you use Water Magic.
skills.conciseDescription: (36...60 seconds.) You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the Energy cost when you use a Water Magic skill.

skills.name: Water Trident
skills.description: Send out a fast-moving Water Trident, striking target foe and up to 2 adjacent foes for 10...90 cold damage if it hits. If it hits a moving foe, that foe is knocked down.
skills.conciseDescription: Fast Projectile: deals 10...90 cold damage and knocks-down moving foes. Shoots 2 additional projectiles at adjacent foes.

skills.name: Way of Perfection
skills.description: For 60 seconds, whenever you successfully land a critical hit, you gain 10...40 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) Your critical hits heal you for 10...40.

skills.name: Way of the Assassin
skills.description: For the next 20 seconds while wielding daggers, you attack 5...20% faster and have a +5...35% chance to land a critical hit.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) While wielding daggers, you attack 5...20% faster and have +5...35% chance to land a critical hit.

skills.name: Way of the Empty Palm
skills.description: For 5...15 seconds, off-hand and dual attacks cost no Energy and recharge 25...50% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.) Your off-hand and dual attacks cost no Energy and recharge 25...50% faster.

skills.name: Way of the Fox
skills.description: For 10...35 seconds, your next 1...6 attack[s] cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) Your attacks are unblockable. <gray>Ends after 1...6 attack[s].</gray>

skills.name: Way of the Lotus
skills.description: For 20 seconds, the next time you hit with a dual attack skill, you gain 5...20 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) You gain 5...20 Energy the next time you hit with a dual attack.

skills.name: Way of the Master
skills.description: For 60 seconds, while holding a non-dagger weapon, you have an additional 3...33% chance to land a critical hit.
skills.conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) While holding a non-dagger weapon, you have +3...33% chance to land a critical hit.

skills.name: Weaken Armor
skills.description: Target foe and foes adjacent to your target have Cracked Armor for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Also affects adjacent foes. Inflicts Cracked Armor condition (5...20 seconds).

skills.name: Weaken Knees
skills.description: For 1...16 second[s], target foe suffers -1...4 Health degeneration and takes 5...20 damage while moving.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...16 second[s].) Target foe has -1...4 Health degeneration and takes 5...20 damage while moving.

skills.name: Weakness Trap
skills.description: When Weakness Trap is triggered, all nearby foes are Weakened for 10...20 seconds and take 24...50 lightning damage. All Charr are knocked down. Weakness Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
skills.conciseDescription: (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals 24...50 lightning damage. Inflicts Weakness condition (10...20 seconds). Knocks-down Charr. <gray>Easily interrupted.</gray>

skills.name: Weapon of Aggression
skills.description: For 5...15 seconds, you attack 25% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.) You attack 25% faster.

skills.name: Weapon of Fury
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, target ally gains 100% more adrenaline and 1 Energy whenever that ally successfully hits with an attack.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) 100% more adrenaline gain and +1 Energy whenever target ally hits with an attack.

skills.name: Weapon of Quickening
skills.description: For 5...25 seconds, target ally has a Weapon of Quickening, and spells and binding rituals recharge 33% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...25 seconds.) Spells and binding rituals recharge 33% faster.

skills.name: Weapon of Remedy
skills.description: For 8 seconds, the next time target ally takes damage or life steal from a foe, that ally steals up to 20...80 Health from that foe and loses 2 conditions.
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) The next time target ally takes damage or life steal from a foe, this ally steals 20...80 Health from that foe and loses 2 conditions.

skills.name: Weapon of Renewal
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, the next time target ally hits with an attack skill, that ally gains 1...7 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Target ally gains 1...7 Energy the next time this ally hits with an attack skill.

skills.name: Weapon of Shadow
skills.description: For 1...7 second[s], target ally has a Weapon of Shadow. Whenever that ally is struck by an attack, that ally's attacker becomes Blinded for 5 seconds. The next 1...3 times <sic/> that ally hits with an attack, his target is Blinded for 5 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...7 second[s].) Inflicts Blindness condition (5 seconds) on anyone who attacks target ally. Target ally's next 1...3 attack[s] inflict Blindness (5 seconds) if they hit.
