skills.name: Weapon of Warding
skills.description: For 3...8 seconds, target ally has a Weapon of Warding that grants target ally +2...4 Health regeneration and a 50% chance to block.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...8 seconds.) +2...4 Health regeneration. 50% chance to block.

skills.name: Weapons of Three Forges
skills.description: For 3...20 seconds, each non-spirit ally in earshot gains the effect of a random Weapon Spell.
skills.conciseDescription: (3...20 seconds.) Allies in earshot gain the effect of a random Weapon Spell. <gray>Allied spirits are not affected. PvE Skill</gray>

skills.name: Wearying Spear
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +10...40 damage. You are Weakened for 5 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage. <gray>You are Weakened (5 seconds).</gray>

skills.name: Wearying Strike
skills.description: You remove 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed, you inflict a Deep Wound for 3...10 seconds. You suffer from Weakness for 10 seconds if an enchantment is not removed.
skills.conciseDescription: Remove 1 Dervish Enchantment. Removal Effect: Inflicts Deep Wound condition (3...10 seconds). <gray>You are Weakened (10 seconds) if an enchantment is not lost.</gray>

skills.name: Web of Disruption
skills.description: Interrupt target foe. For 10 seconds, target foe is hexed with Web of Disruption. When this hex ends, that foe is interrupted again.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Initial effect: interrupts a skill. End effect: interrupts a skill.

skills.name: Well of Blood
skills.description: Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Blood at its location. For 8...20 seconds, allies in that area receive +1...6 Health regeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) Allies in this well have +1...6 Health regeneration. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse or sacrifices 66% health.</gray>

skills.name: Well of Darkness
skills.description: Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Darkness for 5...50 seconds. Hexed foes within the Well of Darkness miss 50% of the time.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...50 seconds.) Hexed foes in this well have 50% chance to miss. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse or sacrifices 66% health</gray>.

skills.name: Well of Power
skills.description: Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Power at that location. For 10...30 seconds, allies within the area of Well of Power gain +1...6 Health regeneration and +2 Energy regeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...30 seconds.) Allies in this well have +1...6 Health regeneration and +2 Energy regeneration. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse or sacrifices 66% health.</gray>

skills.name: Well of Ruin
skills.description: Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Ruin at its location. For 5...30 seconds, whenever a foe in the well takes physical damage, that foe has Cracked Armor for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...30 seconds.) Inflicts Cracked Armor condition (5...20 seconds) to any foe in the well that takes physical damage. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse or sacrifices 66% health.</gray>

skills.name: Well of Silence
skills.description: Exploit target corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Silence for 10...30 seconds. Foes within the well cannot use shouts or chants and suffer -1...4 Health degeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...30 seconds.) Foes in this well cannot use shouts and chants and have -1...4 Health degeneration. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse or sacrifices 66% health.</gray>

skills.name: Well of Suffering
skills.description: Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Suffering at its location. For 10...30 seconds, foes in that area suffer -1...6 Health degeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...30 seconds.) Foes in this well have -1...6 Health degeneration. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse or sacrifices 66% health.</gray>

skills.name: Well of the Profane
skills.description: Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of the Profane at its location. For 8...20 seconds, foes in that area are stripped of all enchantments and cannot be the target of further enchantments. (50% failure chance with Death Magic 4 or less.)
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) Foes in this well lose all enchantments and cannot be the target of further enchantments. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse or sacrifices 66% health. 50% failure chance unless Death Magic 5 or more.</gray>

skills.name: Well of Weariness
skills.description: Exploit target corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Weariness for 10...55 seconds. Enemies within the Well of Weariness suffer -1 Energy degeneration.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...55 seconds.) Foes in this well have -1 Energy degeneration. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse or sacrifices 66% health.</gray>

skills.name: Whirling Axe
skills.description: If Whirling Axe hits, you strike for +5...20 damage and any stance being used by your target ends. This attack cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage and removes a stance. Unblockable.

skills.name: Whirling Charge
skills.description: For 1...6 second[s], you move 33% faster than normal. The next time you strike a foe, all other nearby foes take 10...60 cold damage and this enchantment ends.
skills.conciseDescription: (1...6 second[s].) You move 33% faster. Deal 10...60 cold damage to all other nearby foes the next time you hit a foe and this enchantment ends.

skills.name: Whirling Defense
skills.description: For 8...20 seconds, you have 75% chance to block attacks. Whenever you block a projectile in this way, adjacent foes take 5...11 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block. Deals 5...11 damage to adjacent foes whenever you block a projectile attack.

skills.name: Whirlwind
skills.description: All adjacent foes take 15...75 cold damage. Attacking foes struck by Whirlwind are knocked down. If you are Overcast, this spell strikes nearby instead of adjacent.
skills.conciseDescription: Hits foes adjacent to you. Deals 15...75 cold damage. Causes knock-down to attacking foes. Strikes nearby instead of adjacent if Overcast.

skills.name: Whirlwind Attack
skills.description: Attack target and adjacent foes. Each attack that hits deals +13...20 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +13...20 damage to target and adjacent foes.

skills.name: Wielder's Boon
skills.description: Heal target ally for 15...60 points. If that ally is under the effects of a weapon spell, Wielder's Boon heals for an additional 15...75 Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 15...60. Heals for 15...75 more if this ally is under a Weapon <sic/> spell.

skills.name: Wielder's Remedy
skills.description: For 10...30 seconds, whenever you cast a weapon spell on an ally, that ally loses 2 conditions.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...30 seconds.) Whenever you cast a weapon spell, the targeted ally loses two conditions.

skills.name: Wielder's Strike
skills.description: Target foe is struck for 10...60 lightning damage. If you are under the effects of a weapon spell, you deal an additional 10...50 lightning damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 10...60 lightning damage. Deals 10...50 more lightning damage if you are under a weapon spell.

skills.name: Wielder's Zeal
skills.description: For 10...40 seconds, whenever you cast a Weapon Spell on an ally, you gain 1...5 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (10...40 seconds.) You gain 1...5 Energy whenever you cast a weapon spell.

skills.name: Wild Blow
skills.description: Lose all adrenaline. If it hits, this attack will result in a critical hit and any stance being used by your target ends. This attack cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: Always a critical hit. Removes a stance. Unblockable. <gray>Lose all adrenaline.</gray>

skills.name: Wild Strike
skills.description: Must follow a lead attack. If it hits, this attack strikes for +10...35 damage and any stance being used by target foe ends. This attack cannot be blocked.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +10...35 damage. Removes target foe's stance. Unblockable. <gray>Must follow a lead attack.</gray>

skills.name: Wild Throw
skills.description: If this attack hits, it deals +5...20 damage, and any stance being used by your target ends. This attack cannot be blocked. All of your non-spear attack skills are disabled for 3 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Unblockable. Ends target's stance.<gray>Disables <sic/> your non-spear attack skills for 3 seconds.</gray>

skills.name: Windborne Speed
skills.description: For 5...13 seconds, target ally moves 33% faster.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...13 seconds.) Target ally moves 33% faster.

skills.name: Winds
skills.description: Create a level 4...10 Spirit. All foes within its range have 15% chance to miss with ranged attacks. This spirit dies after 54...90 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 4...10 spirit (54...90 second lifespan.) Affects foes within range. 15% chance to miss with ranged attacks.

skills.name: Winds of Disenchantment
skills.description: Lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If a Dervish enchantment was removed in this way, all nearby foes lose 1 enchantment and take 20...80 cold damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Remove one of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: all nearby foes lose 1 enchantment and take 20...80 cold damage.

skills.name: Winnowing
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within range take 4 additional damage whenever they take physical damage. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). Increases physical damage by +4 for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.

skills.name: Winter
skills.description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. For creatures within its range, all elemental damage is cold damage instead. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). Converts elemental damage to cold damage for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.

skills.name: Winter's Embrace
skills.description: For 2...6 seconds, target foe moves 66% slower and takes 5...15 damage while moving.
skills.conciseDescription: (2...6 seconds.) Target foe moves 66% slower and takes 5...15 damage while moving.

skills.name: Withdraw Hexes
skills.description: Remove all hexes from target ally and all adjacent allies. This spell takes an additional 2 seconds to recharge for each hex removed in this way. (50% failure chance with Divine Favor 4 or less.)
skills.conciseDescription: Removes all hexes. Also affects adjacent allies. <gray>Removal cost: +2 seconds recharge for each hex removed. 50% failure chance unless Divine Favor 5 or more.</gray>

skills.name: Wither
skills.description: For 5...35 seconds, target foe suffers -2...4 Health degeneration and -1 Energy degeneration. If target foe's Energy reaches 0, that foe takes 15...75 damage and Wither ends.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...35 seconds.) Causes -2...4 Health degeneration and -1 Energy degeneration. Deals 15...75 damage if target foe's Energy drops to 0. <gray>Ends if this foe's Energy drops to 0.</gray>

skills.name: Withering Aura
skills.description: For 5...20 seconds, target ally's melee attacks cause Weakness for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Target ally's melee attacks cause Weakness condition (5...20 seconds.)

skills.name: Word of Censure
skills.description: Target foe takes 30...130 holy damage. If your target was below 50% Health, Word of Censure takes 20 additional seconds to recharge.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals 30...130 holy damage. <gray>+20 recharge time if target foe is below 50% Health.</gray>

skills.name: Word of Healing
skills.description: Heal target ally for 5...100 Health. Heal for an additional 30...115 Health if that ally is below 50% Health.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 5...100. Heals for 30...115 more if target ally is below 50% Health.

skills.name: Words of Comfort
skills.description: Target ally is healed for 20...65 Health and an additional 20...50 Health if that ally is suffering from a condition.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 20...65. Heals for 20...50 more if target ally has a condition.

skills.name: Wounding Strike
skills.description: If this attack hits, you do +5...20 damage, target foe suffers from Bleeding for 5...20 seconds, and you lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment is removed, target foe also suffers from a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage and inflicts Bleeding condition (5...20 seconds). Remove 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal Effect: inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds).

skills.name: Xinrae's Weapon
skills.description: For 8 seconds, the next time target ally takes damage from a foe that damage is limited to 5% of that ally's max Health and that ally steals up to 20...80 Health from that foe.
skills.conciseDescription: (8 seconds). The next time target ally takes damage from a foe, that damage is limited to 5% of target ally's max Health and that ally steals 20...80 Health from that foe.

skills.name: Yeti Smash
skills.description: Lose all adrenaline. Attack all adjacent foes. If this attack strikes a foe suffering from a condition, that foe is knocked down. (50% failure chance with Hammer Mastery 4 or less.)
skills.conciseDescription: Attack all adjacent foes. Knocks down foes suffering from a condition. <gray>You lose all adrenaline. 50% failure chance unless Hammer Mastery is 5 or more.</gray>

skills.name: Zealot's Fire
skills.description: For 60 seconds, whenever you use a skill that targets an ally, all foes adjacent to that target are struck for 5...35 fire damage and you lose 1 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) Whenever you use a skill on an ally, all foes adjacent to that ally are hit for 5...35 fire damage. <gray>Damage cost: you lose 1 Energy.</gray>

skills.name: Zealous Anthem
skills.description: For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses an attack skill, that ally gains 1...8 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot gain 1...8 Energy with their next attack skill.

skills.name: Zealous Benediction
skills.description: Heal target ally for 30...180 Health. If target was below 50% Health, you gain 7 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: Heals for 30...180. You gain 7 Energy if target ally was below 50% Health.

skills.name: Zealous Renewal
skills.description: All nearby foes take 5...30 holy damage. For 5...25 seconds, you have -1 Energy regeneration, and gain 1 Energy whenever you hit a foe. If this enchantment ends prematurely, you gain 1...5 Energy.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...25 seconds.) Initial effect: deals 5...30 holy damage to nearby foes. You have -1 Energy regeneration and gain 1 Energy when you hit. Gain 1...5 Energy if this enchantment ends early.

skills.name: Zealous Sweep
skills.description: If this attack hits, you deal +5...20 damage. You gain 3 Energy and 1 adrenaline for each foe you hit.
skills.conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. You gain 3 Energy and 1 adrenaline for each foe you hit.

skills.name: Zealous Vow
skills.description: For 20 seconds, you have -2 Energy regeneration, and you gain 1...6 Energy every time you hit with an attack.
skills.conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) You gain 1...6 Energy each time you hit with an attack. <gray>You have -2 Energy regeneration.</gray>

skills.name: Zojun's Haste
skills.description: For 5...11 seconds, you move 33% faster and have a 27...75% chance to block incoming projectiles. Zojun's Haste ends if you attack.
skills.conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) You move 33% faster and have 27...75% chance to block projectiles. <gray>Ends if you attack.</gray>

skills.name: Zojun's Shot
skills.description: Shoot an arrow that has half the normal range, but strikes for +10...40 damage.
skills.conciseDescription: Half Range Bow Attack. Deals +10...40 damage.
